items.description: SENIOR DATA SCIENTIST ------------------------ Peerspace is the leading and category defining online marketplace for venue rentals for meetings, productions, and events. We open doors to the most inspiring spaces around the world, from lofts and mansions to storefronts and studios. Over $500M has been transacted through the platform, and our investors include GV (Google Ventures) and Foundation Capital. Our people are the heart of Peerspace. We are a team that values inclusion and working cross functionally. Our strategy and objectives are clear and we support one another to exceed expectations. We believe that a healthy company culture creates an environment where people are excited to come into work everyday and contribute to building a successful organization. The Role We are looking for a senior data scientist to partner with our PED (Product, Engineering, Design) teams and our diverse business units to help them understand our users, our product performance and our marketplace as a whole. This role sits on our Analytics team and will report directly to the Head of Analytics. The ideal candidate: Has a strong interest in using data to understand and address business and user problems Can manage a diverse set of stakeholders and drive cross-functional alignment on analytical priorities Is curious about how users engage with a product, and what this might mean for what the business should build or prioritize next Is self motivated and can unblock themselves when the perfect dataset isn’t readily available or the business question isn’t clearly articulated Dives deeply into ambiguous questions, and refines them into clear problem statements that address what the business really cares about or what really matters to our users Responsibilities: Work closely with PED to set goals, understand how users are engaging with our product, and learn from experiments in our two-sided marketplace Develop measurement frameworks and institute new metrics or reporting systems to help us understand our marketplace and users Align cross-functional stakeholders on the priorities and analytical roadmap for critical areas of our business Design and analyze experiments Dive deep on user behavior and the dynamics of our marketplace Unpack business trends and diagnose drivers of business performance Collaborate with the rest of the Analytics and Data Engineering teams and the broader data community to grow and nurture data culture at Peerspace Technical Environment: - Databases: Google BigQuery - Tooling: dbt Cloud, Airflow, Git - BI Tool: Tableau, Statsig (for A/B testing) - Languages: SQL, Python Qualifications: 5+ years of experience in data science, product analytics, or similar functions Strong SQL skills and comfort working with large datasets Experience building visualizations with Tableau, Looker or similar BI platforms Proficient in communicating insights to business partners Ability to manage cross-functional stakeholders and prioritize an analytics roadmap in a dynamic environment with competing priorities Experience applying statistics and experiment design in a business context Experience in at least one data-oriented language like Python, R or Julia Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or technical field (e.g., Statistics, Economics, Math, Computer Science, Engineering) Preferred Qualifications: Experience with another two-sided marketplace Experience applying causal inference, predictive modeling or other advanced statistical methods in a business context Working At Peerspace The annual salary range for this role is $165,000 to $175,000. The actual salary amount will vary depending on the applicant’s experience, skills, and abilities as well as internal equity and market data. Peerspace is proudly certified as a Great Place to Work™ and we're a remote first company with team members located in cities around the globe. Beyond competitive salary and equity compensation, we provide a range of benefits and perks, including: ● 100% employee coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance ● Discount on all Peerspace bookings ● Laptop, high res display, and stipend to setup home office ● Monthly cell phone and internet credit ● Annual In person all company offsite and team-building events (in Peerspace locations, of course) ● Wellness Days observed company wide Diversity At Peerspace, we're dedicated to creating a team that's diverse, equitable and inclusive. Our workplace is a space where all team members are empowered to blaze their own trail, make things happen, and take pride in their work. We believe bringing people together from different backgrounds and identities makes us stronger and better serves the Peerspace community. We'd especially like to encourage applicants from different backgrounds, locations, and experiences. At Peerspace, we are committed to maintaining a secure and transparent hiring experience. Please be aware that scammers sometimes impersonate companies like ours by posting fake job listings or reaching out to job seekers in misleading ways. All legitimate communication from Peerspace will come from an official @peerspace.com email address. We do not contact candidates through personal email accounts, third-party messaging apps such as WhatsApp or Microsoft Teams, or through the Peerspace platform's internal messaging system. All interviews are conducted only by phone or Zoom, and we will never ask for sensitive personal or financial information such as your Social Security number or bank details during the early stages of the hiring process. If you receive any message that seems suspicious or does not align with these practices, please contact us immediately at help@peerspace.com so we can investigate. We only post our job openings and process applications, through our official careers page at https://jobs.lever.co/peerspace . Compensation Additional Information

GATEWAY FLEET SPECIALIST: Starlink is building the world’s largest fl
items.description: Data and Analytics SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars. GATEWAY FLEET SPECIALIST: Starlink is building the world’s largest fleet of satellite ground stations. These gateways are the critical link between our satellites and the global internet backbone, and their reliability directly determines the quality of service for millions of users. We are seeking fleet specialists to own the reliability, growth, and sustainment of our fleet of Gateway antennas and sites across a region of the world. This is a true owner-operator role, managing everything from technical troubleshooting and spare parts strategy to international logistics, contractor performance, and field execution. This role is ideal for someone who excels at building operational excellence in fast-moving and internationally complex environments. You must be equally comfortable managing heavy equipment deployments in remote locations as you are negotiating with customs authorities and coaching contractors toward higher performance standards. RESPONSIBILITIES: Own the maintenance, operations, health, and growth for our fleet of Starlink Gateway Antennas and Sites for a region of the world Manage spare parts strategy, inventory planning, and materials movement across the region, to maintain rapid response readiness for both planned and emergency maintenance Monitor fleet health using dashboards and telemetry data to identify issues, diagnose software and hardware failures, drive timely repairs, and identify emerging degradation trends. Partner with engineering teams to execute fleetwide campaigns and perform root cause analysis on antenna and site failures across electrical, fiber optic, radiofrequency, and mechanical systems Coordinate with logistics providers, customs authorities, and regional partners to ensure timely and compliant international shipping of critical parts and equipment Manage relationships with contracted labor in the region, including training and capability development Analyze operational data and field feedback to identify systemic pain points and drive improvements in processes and tools Share ownership of the team’s growth: work with engineers and specialists to build scalable organizational structures that can support the rapid expansion of the world’s largest fleet of satellite ground stations. Basic Qualifications: High school diploma or equivalency certificate 2+ years of experience operations, logistics, technical support, field service, data analytics, project management, or a similar role involving distributed assets PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: 1+ years of experience in a customer support associate, technical support associate, quality specialist, process planner, business analyst, or leadership role Hands on experience with satellite ground stations, antennas; electrical, fiber optic, radiofrequency, or mechanical systems Experience supporting geographically distributed technical equipment or infrastructure Experience querying and analyzing data using SQL and/or other data visualization tools Background in root cause analysis and cross-functional collaboration with engineering teams Experience managing contractors or third-party vendors, particularly in international or remote environments Familiarity with MRP/ERP systems and spare parts/inventory management Proficiency in one or more of the following languages (in addition to English): Portuguese, French, Punjabi, Hindi, Japanese, Bengali, Kazakh, Arabic, Urdu, Vietnamese, Swahili, Sesotho, Swati, Tagalog. Knowledge of local business culture is a plus Experience troubleshooting or working with IT/network infrastructure (UPS, PDUs, servers, or networking equipment) Demonstrated ability to design efficient processes and systems, especially defining requirements for software tools Experience autonomously managing projects with minimal supervision ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS: Willing to travel 10-15% of the time Willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed Willing to work outside of normal business hours 20-40% if the time COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS: Pay Range: Level 1: $27.00 - $40.00 Level 2: $31.00 - $45.00 Level 3: $36.00 - $51.00 Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience. Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees in Washington State accrue paid sick time in compliance with state and federal law. Company shuttles are offered to employees for roundtrip travel from select Seattle locations to the SpaceX Redmond office Monday to Friday. ITAR REQUIREMENTS: To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here . SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status. Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com .

We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it. Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator. Our Team Members: We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond! We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca 's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply. About the Role: We are seeking an Analytics Engineer to own and execute the vision for our data transformation layer. You will be at the heart of our data platform, which processes hundreds of millions of events daily from a wide array of sources, including transactional databases, API logs, CRMs, payment systems, and marketing platforms. You will join our 100% remote team and work closely with Data Engineers (who manage data ingestion) and Data Scientists and Business Users (who consume your data models). Your primary responsibility will be to use dbt and Trino on our GCP-based, open-source data infrastructure to build robust, scalable data models. These models are critical for stakeholders across the company—from finance and operations to the executive team—and are delivered via BI tools, reports, and reverse ETL systems. What You'll Do: Own the Transformation Layer: Design, build, and maintain scalable data models using dbt and SQL to support diverse business needs, from monthly financial reporting to near-real-time operational metrics. Set Technical Standards: Establish and enforce best practices for data modelling, development, testing, and monitoring to ensure data quality, integrity (up to cent-level precision), and discoverability. Enable Stakeholders: Collaborate directly with finance, operations, customer success, and marketing teams to understand their requirements and deliver reliable data products. Integrate and Deliver: Create repeatable patterns for integrating our data models with BI tools and reverse ETL processes, enabling consistent metric reporting across the business. Ensure Quality: Champion high standards for development, including robust change management, source control, code reviews, and data monitoring as our products and data evolve. What You Need (Must-Haves): 4+ years of experience in analytics engineering or data engineering with a strong focus on the "T" (transformation) in ELT. Proven track record of owning data products end-to-end, applying analytics and data engineering best practices to ensure data quality, scalability, and robust data models. Comfortable working with ambiguity and collaborating with stakeholders to define requirements; able to take ownership with minimal oversight in a fast-paced environment. Experience proactively identifying and implementing improvements to data warehouse performance and ETL efficiency. Technical Versatility: Expert-level SQL and DBT skills for complex queries and data transformations. Proficiency in Python for transformations that extend beyond SQL. Hands-on experience with query optimization across OLTP and OLAP systems (e.g., Postgres, Iceberg). Proficiency with Semantic Layer modelling (e.g. Cube, dbt Semantic Layer). Experience owning CI/CD workflows and establishing team-wide standards for version control and code review (e.g., Git). Familiarity with cloud environments (GCP or AWS). Nice to Haves: Experience with data ingestion tools (e.g., Airbyte) and orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow). Domain experience for brokerage operations or a passion for financial markets and modelling financial datasets. How We Take Care of You: Competitive Salary & Stock Options Health Benefits New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500 Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce. items.title: Customer Manager - Quality & Insights
items.summary: What are we building? Hard Rock Digital is a team focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world.
items.description: What are we building? Hard Rock Digital is a team focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world. We're building a team that resonates passion for learning, operating, and building new products and technologies for millions of consumers. We care about each customer interaction, experience, behavior, and insight and strive to ensure we're always acting authentically. Rooted in the kindred spirits of Hard Rock and the Seminole Tribe of Florida, Hard Rock Digital taps a brand known the world over as the leader in gaming, entertainment, and hospitality. We're taking that foundation of success and bringing it to the digital space — ready to join us? What's the position? As Customer Quality & Insights Manager, you will build and lead how Hard Rock Digital understands and acts on customer sentiment. This is a zero-to-one role: the function doesn't exist yet, and you will be the one to organize various efforts into one cohesive strategy — the reporting, the process, and eventually the team. At the center of the role is a closed loop, and running that loop well is the actual job: identify where sentiment is slipping, diagnose what's driving it, get the finding to the team who can fix it, and then track what happens after the fix ships to confirm it actually moved the needle. Anything short of closing the loop is just reporting; closing it is what makes the role valuable. You will organize diagnosis around three pillars that drive customer sentiment: Person (how interactions are handled), Product (how our app and platform perform for customers), and Policy (how our processes and rules affect the experience). Your job is to find the story in the data and hand stakeholders something specific they can act on — not to audit or score individual performance. When a finding touches an individual interaction, your role is to surface the pattern and hand it to the team that owns coaching or process change, not to run that conversation yourself. This role reports directly to the Senior Manager, Operations Strategy & Insights. There are no direct reports today, but as the function grows, so will this team. You will work alongside the existing BI Operations function — the two teams are parallel, and you'll partner closely with them on shared data and stakeholder context. Responsibilities Building the function Stand up the customer sentiment/insights function: the reporting, the classification taxonomy, and the closed-loop process end to end. Define and own how the loop works across the org — from issue identification through post-implementation impact tracking — so stakeholders know how to engage with findings and recommendations. Build the case for future headcount and, if approved, onboard and manage a Quality & Insights Analyst. Represent the Insights function in cross-functional forums as the org's point of contact for customer sentiment. Sentiment measurement & reporting Build and maintain CSAT and sentiment reporting that gives stakeholders a clear, ongoing view of customer sentiment trends. Design and evolve a sentiment taxonomy that reliably classifies feedback into the Person, Product, and Policy pillars. Mine reviews, support tickets, surveys, and other qualitative feedback sources for sentiment signal, using AI tools to accelerate classification and pattern detection. Track sentiment trends over time and proactively surface emerging issues before they show up as escalations. Diagnosing what's driving sentiment When sentiment dips or a pattern emerges, dig into the underlying story: is it how an interaction was handled, a product friction point, or a policy/process design issue? Distinguish one-off incidents from systemic patterns, and prioritize investigations toward the issues with the greatest sentiment impact. Turn what you find into a clear, specific narrative stakeholders can act on — the goal is to explain what's driving the pattern, not to audit or score any individual's performance. Closing the loop Route findings to the team best positioned to act on them (people leadership, product, policy/process owners) with a specific, actionable recommendation. Maintain a running view of every open issue's status in the loop: identified, diagnosed, routed, and resolved. Track outcomes after a fix ships to confirm whether it actually moved sentiment, and close the loop back to the original finding. Present findings and loop status clearly to stakeholders, including team leads and cross-functional partners who own the Product and Policy pillars. Build data-backed business cases when a recommendation requires investment, prioritization, or a change to an existing process. Data foundation Write and optimize SQL queries to extract, transform, and validate sentiment and CSAT data across large, complex datasets. Validate data integrity and ensure sentiment classifications and diagnostic findings are grounded in accurate, well-understood sources. Create and maintain clear documentation for sentiment definitions, classification methodology, and recurring reports. Collaborate with the BI Operations team on shared data, metrics, and stakeholder context to ensure consistency across functions. Requirements What are we looking for? 6–9 years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, customer experience, or a related field, including experience owning a function, workstream, or reporting capability with significant ambiguity. Proficient SQL skills, including the ability to write and join queries across multiple data sources (CSAT, NPS, support systems) to build reporting independently. Experience building and maintaining dashboards or reporting (Tableau or similar) that stakeholders rely on directly. Demonstrated ability to diagnose the underlying driver behind a pattern in customer feedback and turn it into a specific, actionable recommendation. Experience using AI tools within an analytical workflow, including sentiment classification, text analysis, or LLM-assisted review of qualitative feedback. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn analysis into a recommendation and land it with stakeholders who don't report to you. Comfort working across both quantitative data (CSAT scores, trend lines) and qualitative material (reviews, transcripts, case notes). Bachelor's degree in Analytics, Business, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent work experience. Nice to have Prior experience building or standing up a new reporting function or capability from the ground up. People management experience. Familiarity with contact center or customer support operations and workflows. Familiarity with Snowflake or a similar cloud data warehouse. Python experience, particularly for text/sentiment analysis (pandas, NLTK, or similar). Experience in iGaming, online sportsbook, casino, or a regulated industry environment. What’s in it for you? We offer our employees more than just competitive compensation. Our team benefits include: Competitive pay and benefits Flexible vacation allowance A hybrid / remote working environment Startup culture backed by a secure, global brand Roster of Uniques We care deeply about every interaction our customers have with us, and trust and empower our staff to own and drive their experience. Our vision for our business and customers is built on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where regardless of background or beliefs you feel able to be authentic and bring all your talent into play. We want to celebrate you being you (we are an equal opportunity employer). Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Frontend Web Application Developer
items.summary: Location: Remote Availability: 35-40 hours per week Working hours: US East business hours Reporting to: Lead developer KoboToolbox has an immediate opening for a Frontend Web Application Developer to fill a full-time position of approximately 35-40 hours per week, for a commitment of at least 1 year. As a member of our team, you will share in the challenge and excitement of writing code used by over 32,000 organizations around the world. These organizations create data-driven change through the collection and analysis of more than 20 million surveys per month. Only candidates who already have experience working on large web applications will be considered. Beyond technical acumen, we are seeking a team member who demonstrates curiosity, initiative, and a cooperative approach to problem solving and decision-making. If you're passionate about leveraging technology to make a positive impact, we want to hear from you! Responsibilities Searching and reading an extensive, long-lived code base to understand existing behavior and conventions. Recognizing when existing conventions may no longer be the best approach and suggesting improvements aligned with contemporary best practices. Writing robust, concise, and reusable code with accompanying tests and documentation. Reviewing other developers' code and providing constructive feedback. Incorporating feedback from code reviews to improve your skills and align with team standards. Using AI-assisted development tools effectively while maintaining responsibility for code quality and correctness. Efficiently investigating bug reports from the support team, creating well-scoped fixes or actionable plans for resolution. Scoping, prioritizing, estimating, and organizing work into manageably sized tasks. Attending regular video-conference check-ins with other members of the technical team. Communicating with the public in conjunction with our support staff or directly through forums, issue trackers, etc. Contributing to discussions about design and architecture collaboratively with the larger team. Performing other related duties as directed by the lead developer. Requirements Required Qualifications Professional experience writing, deploying, and maintaining client-side code for real-world, API-driven single-page applications. Proficiency with TypeScript, React, and related technologies, including styling, state management, and efficient data exchange over HTTP. Unflinching ability to work with legacy technologies such as Backbone and CoffeeScript. Recent experience giving and receiving code reviews. Ability to independently set up and troubleshoot a local development environment, knowing when to ask for help on genuine roadblocks. Interest in data collection (surveying), particularly in humanitarian emergencies and other challenging contexts, and a desire to improve our platform for our users. Proficiency with spoken and written English. Fluency with Git. Overlap with working hours in the Eastern time zone. Average availability of at least 30 hours per week, preferably 35 hours or more. Preferred Qualifications Experience with the following is preferred but not required to apply: Using Docker and Docker Compose in a development environment. Programming in Python, ideally with Django (and particularly Django REST Framework). Building user-facing LLM integrations. Surveying with XLSForm, ODK XForm, and OpenRosa. Integrating with Stripe for payment processing. An added note on qualifications... We know that people from underrepresented groups including women, people of color, LGBTQ+ individuals, people with disabilities, and others are less likely to apply for a role if they don't meet every qualification listed. We're more interested in your potential and growth mindset than a perfect checklist match. If this role excites you and you meet many, but not all, of the qualifications, we'd still love to hear from you. Equal Opportunity Employer Kobo is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. Benefits Genuine Impact: Contribute directly to projects that impact millions of people around the world globally, working alongside the largest international humanitarian organizations as well as thousands of national and small community based partners in 200 countries. Meaningful Work Environment: Join a team that believes work should be meaningful as well as fun, tackling global challenges through innovative data collection and management tools with a proven impact for lasting change. Diverse Team: Be part of an amazing, progressive, and globally diverse team that values diversity, equity, and inclusion across all spectrums. Flexible Work Culture: Enjoy mutual flexibility supported by a culture that prioritizes work-life balance. Professional Development: Benefit from generous professional development options. Full Time Employee Benefits (U.S. candidates only) : Health & Wellness : 5 medical insurance options, dental, and vision (up to 80% premium covered), plus life insurance and Long Term Disability. Financial Security : 401(k) retirement plan with 100% match up to 2%. Work-Life Balance : 20 days paid time off, 12 floating holidays, unlimited sick days, and paid parental leave. *Please note, if based in the US or Canada this is a full time employee position. In other locations full time employment or contractor positions are options depending on individual circumstances.

items.title: Blockchain Data Analyst & Researcher
items.summary: Why This Role As a Blockchain Data Analyst & Researcher, you will be a pivotal force in our data intelligence efforts, serving primarily as a blockchain data protocol researcher.
items.description: Why This Role As a Blockchain Data Analyst & Researcher, you will be a pivotal force in our data intelligence efforts, serving primarily as a blockchain data protocol researcher. Your core mission will involve a deep dive into the complex internals and mechanics of various blockchain networks, reverse engineering of sophisticated Decentralized Finance (DeFi) protocols, and translating these complex systems into actionable, structured data. Develop new derivative data models and datasets for client insights and competitive advantages. Map, cleanse, and normalize raw, disparate blockchain data (transaction logs, smart contract events, state changes) into consistent, structured relational and non-relational schemes for consumption by analytics, machine learning, and AI tools. This role requires a unique blend of expertise in distributed systems, data engineering best practices, and a profound understanding of the crypto and decentralized ecosystem. What You’ll Do Maintain an AI-native and blockchain-forward mindset, proactively leveraging emerging trends and generative technologies to stay at the vanguard of the crypto revolution while maximizing work efficiency and uncovering novel, high-alpha data opportunities. Architect Intuitive Data Models: Turn the messiness of on-chain data into elegant, unified abstractions. You'll build the models that provide our users with granular, high-integrity insights across various protocols. Deconstruct DeFi Mechanics: Get under the hood of DeFi protocols. You'll reverse-engineer smart contracts and on-chain events, translating complex interactions into clean, production-grade SQL/dbt models. Scale Our Ecosystem Coverage: Lead the charge in indexing new blockchains. You’ll design the schemas that transform raw chain data into our internal "source of truth," ensuring every block is captured with 100% accuracy. Engineer Signal from Noise: Define the metrics that matter (TVL, Volume, Fees). You’ll be the gatekeeper of data quality, proactively identifying and filtering out wash trading, bot activity, and Sybil attacks. What You'll Need: Experience 3+ years hands-on in Data Science, Data Engineering, or a hybrid role; Blockchain or crypto analytics background strongly preferred, familiarity with on-chain data structures, transaction semantics, and asset classification; Streaming & Lakehouse Apache Flink or Spark Streaming building and operating real-time data pipelines; Apache Iceberg or Apache Hudi managing large-scale Data Lakehouses with schema evolution, time travel, and ACID guarantees over petabytes of raw blockchain data; AWS Data Platform S3 for scalable data lake storage; RDS for structured relational workloads; Spark SQL and PySpark for interactive querying and ad-hoc analysis; Caching & Distribution Familiarity with Data Grid technologies (e.g. Hazelcast, Apache Ignite, Redis) for high-throughput, low-latency data access patterns; Languages & Tooling SQL advanced query writing, window functions, query plan analysis, performance tuning at scale; Python Pandas, Polars for data wrangling; Scikit-learn for model development; Proficient in architecting high-throughput ingestion pipelines that leverage external data sources REST/WebSocket APIs, JSON-RPC node queries; Strong grasp of ETL fundamentals (extract, transform, load), including managing schema mismatches between heterogeneous sources and destinations; Engineering Mindset Systematic approach to debugging: reproducing issues, isolating root cause, validating fixes; Comfortable working with large, semi-structured, or undocumented data sources. Why Join Lukka ? Are you looking for a challenge? Lukka solves the most complex data and technology challenges for an industry that is at the forefront of innovation. At Lukka , we strive to anticipate and respond to the needs of this new and ever-changing ecosystem of digital assets. That was true in 2014, while everyone was focused on trading & buying this new asset class, we were thinking about the tax implications of crypto. That innovative foresight continues today as we evolve and iterate on our product suite to address the regulations and educate our customers. We are looking for passionate, collaborative, and strategic individuals who want to help shape the future of, well, everything – starting with making crypto more accountable. We invest in our teammates, promote from within & are responsible to each other by fostering an inclusive space for curious minds to thrive and innovate. What’s life @ Lukka like? We move fast and continue to be ahead of the curve. You could be part of a growing company bridging the gap between business and blockchain. Here’s some insight into why our team members have joined: Ability to own the projects they work on; Less red tape to take ideas from inception to delivery; Being at the forefront of an industry; Small team, big dreams. Of course, let’s discuss some perks: Opportunity to work directly on data for digital assets, an industry-leading product with well-known clients. Working with multiple AI solutions daily. Exposure to both technical problem-solving and customer-facing challenges. A growing Poland-based team with direct collaboration across US and global stakeholders. A startup-style culture where your impact is visible every day. So you’ve scrolled, your interest is piqued and hopefully read all of the important things...now what? This is an exciting time to join a team that’s at the forefront of this rapidly growing industry. We are looking for people who constantly push themselves to think differently, are ready to face new challenges and chart exciting new paths. If this sounds like you, apply! items.title: Data Architect at Massive Rocket | Global Braze & Snowflake Agency
items.summary: Who Are Massive Rocket? Massive Rocket is a rapidly scaling Braze and Snowflake agency on a mission to transform how digital marketing, product, and engineering teams connect. In just five years, we’ve grown at speed and are now gearing up for our next big milestone: hitting $100M in revenue. We build human experiences at scale, powered by cutting‑
items.description: Who Are Massive Rocket? Massive Rocket is a rapidly scaling Braze and Snowflake agency on a mission to transform how digital marketing, product, and engineering teams connect. In just five years, we’ve grown at speed and are now gearing up for our next big milestone: hitting $100M in revenue. We build human experiences at scale, powered by cutting‑edge web, mobile, cloud, data, and AI technologies. If you’re excited by innovation, love solving complex challenges, and want to help shape the future of digital experiences, you’ll feel right at home here. Every role at Massive Rocket is entrepreneurial. The people who thrive here don’t just focus on their own remit — they understand the goals of the teams around them and actively contribute to the success of their colleagues, customers, and partners. We’re building a culture of ownership, collaboration, and growth, and we’re looking for people who want to make a real impact. Who Are We Looking to Add to Our Team? We’re looking for a Data Architect to help transform complex client requirements into scalable, data-driven solutions for global brands. You’ll lead technical discovery, design end-to-end data architectures, and shape roadmaps that connect customer data, identity, and marketing technology. Working closely with client stakeholders and our Data Engineering teams, you’ll combine deep technical expertise with strategic thinking to deliver robust architectures, improve data performance, and drive measurable business outcomes. What Will You Do? Lead client discovery workshops to assess existing data platforms, identity frameworks, integrations, and business requirements. Design scalable data architectures integrating Snowflake, Databricks, mParticle, Hightouch, Braze, and wider MarTech ecosystems. Define data models, identity resolution, consent, governance, and data quality standards across multiple brands and markets. Develop technical roadmaps, scope delivery phases, estimate effort, and secure client approval before implementation. Evaluate data technologies and tools to ensure they meet business requirements, performance expectations, and commercial objectives. Guide Data Engineering teams in implementing and optimising data pipelines, including batch, event-driven, and low-latency data flows. Establish data validation, monitoring, performance optimisation, and engineering best practices.Translate complex data analysis and technical designs into clear recommendations and business value for client stakeholders. Mentor engineers and consultants, conduct technical reviews, and promote continuous improvement across delivery teams. Support proposals, pitches, workshops, and strategic initiatives while identifying opportunities to expand client engagements. What Makes You a Great Fit 8+ years of experience in Data Architecture or Solution Architecture, including at least 5 years in technical leadership. Deep hands-on expertise in Snowflake, Databricks, and customer data platforms, with Hightouch experience being a plus. Proven experience integrating cloud data warehouses with MarTech, CRM, customer engagement, and analytics platforms. Strong understanding of identity resolution, customer profiles, and linking anonymous and known customer activity across multiple sources. Extensive experience in data modelling, pipeline architecture, reverse ETL, data integration, and performance optimisation. Strong SQL and Python skills, with experience in version control, CI/CD, and modern engineering practices. Ability to lead discovery, translate business requirements into technical designs, and communicate architecture decisions to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Experience estimating and documenting technical solutions, managing scope, and securing client sign-off. Proven ability to mentor engineers and guide technical delivery across multiple projects. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with a commercial and outcome-focused mindset. Experience in an agency or consulting environment, managing multiple client engagements. Willingness to travel to client locations when required. Desirable Certifications in Snowflake, data architecture, or relevant CDP and MarTech platforms. Familiarity with Braze, Amplitude, GA4, and marketing automation within modern warehouse-centric architectures. Strong understanding of data privacy, security, consent, and regulatory requirements.Experience developing technical proposals, delivering client presentations, and leading workshops or training sessions. A track record of introducing new technologies or architectural approaches that improve performance, efficiency, and business outcomes. Why You’ll Love Working Here • Rocket‑Fuelled Growth – Big challenges, fast learning, and the chance to level up quicker than anywhere else • A Culture That Actually Gives a Damn – Supportive, positive, and built around people who want to see you win • A Global Crew – Collaborate with brilliant teammates across Europe, the US, and beyond • Remote‑First for Life – Work from wherever you feel your best • Real Career Momentum – Clear progression, real ownership, and space to grow into your next chapter • Moments That Matter – Meetups, events, and team experiences that make the journey unforgettable A Few Things to Know Before We Get Started Bring Your Own Device – We operate a BYOD policy, so you’ll use your own kit for work Right to Work – You’ll need a valid work visa; we’re not able to offer sponsorship at the moment ID Checks – We may ask for proof of identity (passport, ID card, or a recent utility bill) References – We may request two references, so have names, relationships, and contact details ready For Contractors – Proof of incorporation and up‑to‑date insurance is required A Quick Note on Applications We receive a high volume of applications, and while we’d love to reply to everyone personally, it’s not always possible. If you haven’t heard from us within two weeks, it sadly means you haven’t been successful this time. But don’t let that stop you—we’re growing fast, and new opportunities open up all the time. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

items.summary: Join Our Vision: We are building the next generation of Spatial Media - a new way people experience videos through interaction, multi-user presence, haptics, AI, and immersive storytelling.
items.description: Join Our Vision: We are building the next generation of Spatial Media - a new way people experience videos through interaction, multi-user presence, haptics, AI, and immersive storytelling. DeoVR is the leading immersive streaming technology serving multiple enterprise customers and millions of users globally. We are now expanding the boundaries of what video can be - moving from passive watching to active, interactive, multi-user journeys. If this excites you more than it scares you, you are in the right place. The Role We’re looking for a strong Head of Product Analytics who can combine strategic ownership with a very hands-on approach. This is not a pure management role - we expect someone who is individually strong enough to operate at a Senior Product Analyst level and enjoys working deeply with data. We need someone who sees analytics as a product function, not just reporting. Someone proactive, curious, and opinionated. A person who can help shape product decisions, uncover growth opportunities, build reliable tracking systems, and turn data into actionable insights. items.summary: Orchid Software Solutions | Remote, Latin America | Full-time contract About usOrchid Software Solutions builds and operates software for healthcare and family-building services.
items.description: Orchid Software Solutions | Remote, Latin America | Full-time contract About us Orchid Software Solutions builds and operates software for healthcare and family-building services. Our products cover escrow for surrogacy and egg donation, agency management for fertility clinics, medical records retrieval, insurance risk management, and independent dispute resolution for healthcare payments under the federal No Surprises Act. Our engineering team is distributed across the United States and Latin America, with a few colleagues further afield. We work remotely, in writing, and across time zones. About the role This is our first dedicated data and business intelligence role. You will own reporting end to end: the data model, the metric definitions, the dashboards our operations teams run on, and the reporting our enterprise clients see. You will start with our healthcare payments dispute resolution product, which has the largest data footprint and the most immediate reporting need. Once that reporting is running, the role expands across our other products, bringing one set of definitions to metrics that are currently produced product by product. The interesting part of this job is not the dashboards. Much of what our applications display is calculated at read time by application code rather than stored in a column, so the same question can be answered several ways. Your job is to decide what each metric means, document it, prove it reconciles against the systems of record, and defend that definition when someone wants a different number. If you like being the person whose figures nobody argues with, you will like this role. You will work alongside an engineering team of senior fullstack engineers and QA, a product manager, and business leadership in the United States. You will present your numbers directly to executives and to client counterparts, so this is a role for someone comfortable in front of an audience, not only in a query editor. What you will do Build and maintain internal reporting for operational volume, case status and stage, cycle and resolution time, throughput, and service-level metrics. Own payment reconciliation reporting, where the tolerance for an approximate answer is zero. Design and ship scoped, self-service reporting for enterprise clients, so they can answer their own questions without going through our support team. Model data in our analytics warehouse: dimensional models, incremental transformations, and tested, documented pipelines. Own the metric layer. One definition per metric, the query that produces it, the business rule behind it, and a data dictionary anyone can read. Reconcile reporting against the source systems and keep it reconciled as the applications change. Work with role-scoped access and data minimization as a matter of routine. We handle regulated healthcare and payment data, and reporting is built to keep sensitive fields out of it. Improve data quality. Find the defects that make reporting wrong, quantify them, and drive the fixes with the engineering team. Turn ambiguous questions from executives and clients into defined metrics, and say so when a question cannot be answered from the data we hold. Extend the same patterns and definitions to our other products as the function grows. What we are looking for Expert SQL. Complex analytical queries, window functions, and query performance work. You can tell the difference between a number that is surprising and a number that is wrong. Hands-on warehouse experience. ClickHouse, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or Databricks. You have modeled data in one, not only queried someone else’s models. Dimensional and semantic modeling. You have built a reporting layer over a normalized transactional schema and owned the definitions that sat on top of it. Client-facing reporting, shipped. You have built reporting that external customers used, with the scoping and access controls that requires. You write code, not only queries. Production-quality work in Git, code review in both directions, and the ability to build and run your own transformation jobs. Stakeholder judgment. You can sit with an executive or a client, work out what they actually need, and push back when the ask does not hold up. Data governance in a regulated setting. Practical experience with role-based access, handling of personal or health data, and producing evidence for an audit. HIPAA, SOC 2, PCI, or similar. Clear written communication. Our team is distributed and most decisions happen in writing. Professional English, written and spoken. You will present to United States executives and to client counterparts. Fluency is required and is assessed in the first conversation. Time zone overlap. A minimum of four hours of daily overlap with United States Eastern time, 9:00 to 13:00 ET. Able to contract independently. You can invoice and contract as an independent professional in your country of residence, and accept confidentiality and data-handling terms covering regulated healthcare data. Nice to have Healthcare payments, claims, or payer and provider data. Experience with No Surprises Act dispute resolution is a real advantage. dbt or a comparable transformation framework, in production, with tests. Change data capture pipelines and the failure modes that come with them. Financial reconciliation reporting. Python for data work. Enough TypeScript to read an application and trace how a value is calculated. An embedded analytics or BI tool taken to production with external users, including row-level security. AWS, particularly RDS, S3, and IAM as it applies to data access. Prior work with a United States company in a regulated industry. What this role is not It is not a ticket queue for dashboard requests. You own definitions and you are expected to have opinions about them. It is not platform or infrastructure engineering. We have a platform team and you will partner with them. It is not machine learning or model development. That work sits with a separate team. Tech you will work with TypeScript and Next.js applications, MySQL and PostgreSQL as operational stores, ClickHouse as the analytics warehouse, change data capture between them, Python for data work, and AWS throughout. Our older products run on Python and Flask. Originally posted on Himalayas

By combining blockchain’s transparency and efficiency with AI-driven automation, we’ve reimagined how loans are originated,
items.description: About Figure Figure (NASDAQ: FIGR) is transforming capital markets through blockchain. We’re proving that blockchain isn’t just theory - it’s powering real products used by hundreds of thousands of consumers and institutions. By combining blockchain’s transparency and efficiency with AI-driven automation, we’ve reimagined how loans are originated, funded, and traded in secondary markets. From faster processing times to lower costs and reduced bias, our technology is helping borrowers, investors, and financial institutions achieve better outcomes. Together with our 170+ partners, we’ve originated over $22 billion in home equity loans (HELOCs) on our blockchain-native platform, making Figure the largest non-bank provider of home equity financing in the U.S. Figure’s ecosystem also includes YLDS, an SEC-registered yield-bearing stablecoin that operates as a tokenized money market fund, and several other products and platforms that are reshaping consumer finance and capital markets. We’re proud to be recognized as one of Forbes’ Most Innovative Fintech Startups in 2025 and Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies in Finance and Personal Finance. About the Role At Figure, we’re redefining what’s possible at the intersection of finance and technology. Fresh off our IPO, we are building the next generation of financial infrastructure, transforming how capital moves, how credit is assessed, and how customers experience financial products. Our data team sits at the heart of that transformation, serving as the analytical engine that powers the entire business. From architecting the data models that drive risk and capital allocation to delivering the reporting and insights that guide growth strategy and operational excellence, we ensure every department has the intelligence needed to win. As a Senior Data Analyst, you will be a vital driver of our growth and product evolution, partnering closely with Marketing, Product Management, and Engineering to optimize the borrower journey. Your work will directly influence how we acquire customers, the efficiency of our loan application funnel, and the long-term value of our customer base. You will bridge the gap between user behavior and business strategy, combining analytical rigor with product intuition to help leaders understand the “how” and “why” behind the customer experience. While your primary focus is on the front-end growth engine, you are a generalist at heart—capable of architecting data models that serve the entire organization’s need for clear, actionable intelligence from top-of-funnel to capital allocation. What You’ll Do Data Modeling & Architecture: Design and implement robust data models that transform fragmented marketing spend and application event logs into structured, “gold-standard” datasets. You will ensure our product and acquisition data is clean, organized, and optimized for cross-functional use. Funnel Optimization: Build and maintain scalable frameworks to monitor the loan application funnel—identifying friction points, drop-off behaviors, and opportunities to improve conversion from lead to funded loan. Technical Impact: Elevate our analytics toolkit by writing high-performance BigQuery SQL and designing intuitive Tableau dashboards that empower stakeholders to track KPIs like CAC (Customer Acquisition Cost), Approval Rates, and Origination Volume in real-time. Experimental Design: Partner with Product and Marketing to design, execute, and analyze A/B tests, ensuring we make evidence-based decisions on everything from landing page optimization to credit offer presentation. Cross-Functional Insight: Act as the analytical backbone for the business, translating complex user behaviors into repeatable, automated insights that drive measurable growth and product-market fit. What We Look For 3–5+ years of experience using data to drive measurable business impact, specifically within Growth, Product Analytics, or Marketing Science. Deep proficiency in SQL (preferably BigQuery); you are an expert at handling complex joins and window functions to reconstruct user journeys across marketing touchpoints and loan applications. Advanced Data Modeling: Proven ability to design and maintain structured datasets (star schemas, dbt models) that turn messy clickstream and CRM data into reliable tables for the entire business. Expertise with Tableau: You don’t just report data; you build intuitive dashboards that help managers visualize cohort performance, attribution models, and funnel velocity. Statistical Depth: Strong grasp of statistical concepts like survival analysis (to model time-to-repayment or time-to-next-loan), causal inference, and significance testing. Fintech/Lending Context: Understanding of the lending lifecycle—from initial acquisition through underwriting to funding—and how product changes impact portfolio quality. Communication: Clear, confident ability to translate complex data trends into actionable stories for both technical teams and executive leadership. Adaptability: A generalist mindset—you are comfortable navigating the ambiguity of a fast-moving environment and can apply your analytical toolkit to solve problems across different business domains. Adhere to all company security policies and data handling procedures. Complete mandatory security awareness training within required timeframes. Promptly report any suspected security incidents or suspicious activity to the Security team. Salary Base Compensation Range: $110,000 - $140,000 annually 25% annual bonus target, paid quarterly Company equity in the form of RSUs This is the compensation range for the role in the United States. Actual compensation may vary based on a candidate’s experience, skills, location, internal equity, and evolving business needs. While most offers are generally made within the middle of the range, final compensation is determined based on the factors above. Benefits Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% employer-paid premiums for employees and their dependents on select plans Company HSA, FSA, Dependent Care FSA, 401(k), and commuter benefits Employer-paid life and disability insurance 11 observed holidays and PTO plan Up to 12 weeks of paid family leave Continuing education reimbursement Depending on your residential location certain laws might regulate the way Figure manages applicant data. California Residents, please review our California Employee and General Workforce Privacy Notice for further information. By submitting your application, you are agreeing and acknowledging that you have read and understand the above notice. Figure will not sponsor work visas for this position. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. #LI-SB1 #LI-Hybrid

items.title: Senior Manager, Business Performance & Analysis
items.summary: ABOUT ALUALU provides higher education for a higher purpose.
items.description: ABOUT ALU ALU provides higher education for a higher purpose. Our students declare missions, not majors.They develop the real-world skills to take on the world’s most pressing challenges. And they take ownership of their learning from day one through our peer and student-led approach – because ALU believes in the power and agency of young people to start shaping the future right now. Together with a world-class faculty and staff, our students are igniting a ripple of positive impact across Africa and the world. We are dedicated to fostering an open yet secure environment, balancing the safety of students, staff, and visitors with respect for individual rights, and safeguarding responsibilities. HOW WE WORK The ALU Team works in starkly different ways to traditional academic bureaucracies. We approach education from first principles, empower individuals to design, test, and implement creative new ideas, and work closely together to craft transformative learning experiences. We are deeply passionate about our students and excited by the challenge of building something entirely new. The African Leadership University is committed to ensuring the safety and Well-being of all students under our care. As part of this commitment , we have a comprehensive safeguarding policy in place , which outlines our Zero-tolerance approach to any violation of safeguarding. ABOUT THE TEAM The Business Performance & Analysis team is one of ALU ’s core performance intelligence functions, providing the insight, analysis and challenge required to help leaders understand performance, make informed decisions and improve institutional outcomes. Working across academic and professional functions, the team goes beyond reporting what has happened to understand why it happened, what it means, what is likely to happen next, and what action is required. It brings together performance data, analysis and external benchmarks to identify trends, risks, opportunities and areas for improvement. The team connects strategy, performance and execution by strengthening performance measurement, supporting decision-making and helping leaders translate insight into action. Its impact is measured not by the volume of reports produced, but by the quality of decisions informed and the improvements in institutional performance that follow. ABOUT THE ROLE The Senior Manager, Business Performance & Analysis will lead the analysis, interpretation and management of institutional performance information to support evidence-based decision-making across ALU . The role will translate complex business, financial, operational, academic and student data into clear insights, identify performance trends and gaps, assess their underlying drivers, and provide actionable recommendations to improve institutional outcomes. The role will also strengthen ALU 's performance management and business intelligence capabilities, ensuring that leadership has timely, reliable and forward-looking information to guide strategic and operational decisions. Working across functions and with senior leaders, the role will connect institutional strategy, performance targets and operational results, providing the analysis and challenge required to improve execution and organisational performance. ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES Institutional Performance Management Lead the development, implementation and continuous improvement of ALU 's institutional performance framework, including KPIs, targets, scorecards and performance measures. Monitor performance against strategic and operational objectives, identify material variances, emerging risks and areas of underperformance, and recommend appropriate interventions. Lead periodic performance reviews and provide analysis that enables leadership to understand not only what is happening, but why it is happening and what action is required. Analyse performance across key institutional areas including enrolment, recruitment, retention, student progression, programme performance, revenue, costs, resource utilisation and other strategic priorities. Establish appropriate performance benchmarks and support leadership in setting meaningful, measurable and outcome-focused objectives and targets. Business and Strategic Analysis Identify trends, patterns, performance drivers and root causes across multiple sources of institutional data. Develop business cases, investment analyses and decision papers, including assessment of financial, operational and strategic implications. Undertake scenario analysis and modelling to assess the potential impact of strategic and operational decisions. Conduct complex business and institutional analysis to support strategic planning, operational decisions and strategic initiatives and prioritization. Provide objective analysis and constructive challenge where data, assumptions or proposed interventions require further scrutiny. Conduct internal and external benchmarking to assess institutional performance against relevant peer institutions, competitors, sector standards and market trends. Translate analytical findings into clear recommendations, implications and actions for senior leadership. Performance Intelligence and Reporting Lead the development of high-quality management information, executive performance reports, dashboards and analytical products for senior leadership and governance forums. Establish standards for performance reporting, data interpretation, and analytical storytelling. Ensure management reports focus on material performance issues, drivers, trends and decisions rather than simply presenting data. Develop forward-looking analysis and forecasts to support proactive management of institutional performance. Work with data and technology teams to improve access to, integration of and confidence in institutional data. Ensure the accuracy, consistency and appropriate interpretation of performance information used for management decision-making. Analytics Capability and Continuous Improvement Develop clear standards for analytical quality, delivery and stakeholder service. Coach team members in analytical thinking, problem solving, business partnering and effective communication of insights. Develop and continuously improve analytical methodologies, tools and processes. Identify opportunities to automate, simplify and improve performance reporting and analysis. Promote a culture of evidence-based decision-making and stronger use of data across ALU . Partner with other functions to develop integrated views of institutional performance. Executive Stakeholder Engagement Establish and maintain data supply arrangements with the functions that own the underlying data: agreed definitions, cut dates, quality standards, and named counterparts. Resolve definitional inconsistency across campuses, programmes and systems so that the institution reports a single number for each institutional metric. Build effective working relationships with senior leaders, Deans, Directors and functional teams across ALU . Present complex analysis clearly to non-technical audiences and translate findings into practical business implications. Facilitate performance discussions and support leaders in identifying appropriate responses to performance gaps. Influence decisions through evidence, insight and constructive challenge, including where findings may challenge established assumptions or practices. Provide analytical support to strategic, executive and governance forums as required. Maintain a strong understanding of the ALU ’s operating environment, priorities and strategic objectives to ensure analysis remains relevant to institutional needs. Ensure the safety and well-being of all young persons and vulnerable adults with whom we deal, by adhering to ALU ’s comprehensive safeguarding policy, maintaining a zero-tolerance approach to any violations of safeguarding standards REQUIRED EXPERIENCE 10+ years of relevant professional experience in business performance, institutional research, strategy, business intelligence, analytics, planning, consulting, financial analysis or a related field. Demonstrable experience leading, developing and managing organisational or institutional performance frameworks, including KPIs, targets, scorecards and performance reporting. Proven experience analysing complex datasets and translating findings into actionable recommendations for senior decision-makers, forecasting, scenario modelling, business case development and quantitative analysis. Experience producing executive-level performance reports, dashboards and decision-support materials. Experience using data to identify performance drivers, diagnose problems and support measurable improvements in organisational outcomes. Demonstrated experience delivering analytical or performance improvement initiatives that resulted in measurable business, operational, financial or institutional impact. Experience benchmarking organisational or institutional performance against external peers, competitors or sector standards is desirable. REQUIRED COMPETENCIES Functional Competencies Strategic and Performance Analysis: Analyse complex institutional issues, identify performance drivers and translate findings into actionable recommendations. Data & Business Intelligence: Analyse complex datasets and develop clear dashboards, management information and performance insights. Financial & Commercial Acumen: Understand the financial, operational and institutional implications of decisions. Forecasting & Modelling: Develop forecasts, scenarios and business models to support planning and decision-making. Problem Solving: Diagnose root causes, test assumptions and develop practical, evidence-based solutions. Executive Reporting: Distil complex information into clear insights, implications and recommendations for senior leaders. Analytics Tools: Advanced Excel and strong proficiency in Power BI and uses digital and AI-enabled tools effectively to accelerate analysis, improve productivity and generate insight, while independently validating outputs and exercising sound judgement. Behavioural & Leadership Competencies Strategic Thinking: Connect performance trends and analysis to broader institutional priorities. Critical Thinking: Question assumptions and assess evidence objectively. Influencing & Challenge: Build credibility with senior stakeholders and challenge constructively using evidence. Executive Communication: Communicate complex findings clearly and persuasively to varied audiences. Collaboration: Work effectively across academic and professional functions. Leadership & Coaching: Develop people, set high analytical standards and build team capability. Delivery Orientation: Focus on turning insight into action and measurable institutional improvement. Match the ALU Archetype: Alignment with the ALU Archetype, including ownership, courage, and stewardship. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Europe, Remote Hello👋I am Puneet , Co-founder and CPO at Kayzen , and I am now looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our team 🙌 But wait, you have not heard of Kayzen before?😃 Kayzen is a mobile demand-side platform (DSP) dedicated to democratizing programmatic advertising. We enable leading apps, agencies, media buyers, and brands to run programmatic customer acquisition, retargeting, and brand performance campaigns through its self-serve and managed service options. Built on the three core pillars of performance, transparency, and control, Kayzen powers the world’s best mobile marketing teams with bespoke solutions that fuel business growth and deliver a competitive advantage. With an unprecedented scale of 160B+ daily ad requests from 1.6B+ unique users worldwide, we serve up to 1B+ ads per day in 180 countries. Kayzen is accessible through our APIs and user interface. The Team You will work with a carefully selected, diverse and globally distributed Data Science team (like Heiko, Chen) on various machine-learning models that process terabytes of data, serving billions of ad requests and users around the globe in real-time. We are highly motivated and aligned in our quest to disrupt the multi-billion dollar ad-tech industry. We would like you to be part of our journey, as our Senior Data Scientist (m/f/d) . Responsibilities Our day-to-day work in Data Science and Machine Learning encompasses a wide range of activities, including: Enhancing Models: Continuously improving existing models by incorporating new features, fine-tuning parameters, and utilizing additional data. Algorithm Development: Collaborating with our Machine Learning Engineering team to develop and deploy scalable supervised and unsupervised learning algorithms. Data Exploration: Identifying and exploring new data sources while researching innovative ways to leverage both new and existing data effectively. Solution Research: Investigating new Machine Learning solutions to optimize every step of our value chain. A/B Testing: Regularly conducting and evaluating A/B tests to drive insights and refine our strategies. You’ll be a great fit if you resonate with the following principles of Data Science and Machine Learning: Simplicity First: We prioritize finding the best solutions to challenges rather than forcing problems to fit predetermined solutions. Impact-Driven: We leverage Machine Learning to enhance our product and drive performance for our clients, always focusing on tangible business outcomes. Collaborative Spirit: Our teams consist of analysts, engineers, and data scientists, making strong communication skills essential for success. Embrace Experimentation: We believe in the power of experimentation to innovate and refine our approach continually. Requirements Minimum 5 years of experience in developing data science products, from initial research through to production deployment. Strong coding skills with a focus on clean, reproducible, and well-tested code. Proficient in key tools and technologies including Python, Spark, Hadoop, Airflow, Docker, and SQL. Hands-on experience with algorithms for handling sparse and large datasets, including applications in prediction, clustering, and outlier detection. Experience in building neural network-based products for tasks such as classification, regression, and multi-task learning is highly valuable. Bonus skills: Knowledge of reinforcement learning and large-scale optimization problems is a significant asset. Good understanding of dashboards and SQL for developing and enhancing monitoring tools. Previous experience in Ad-Tech is a must. What do we offer? Directly working with Founders and an opportunity to drive direct impact Exceptional career growth and learning opportunity A unique opportunity to be part of an experienced team of industry experts and entrepreneurs who bring massive change to the Adtech market A fun, driven, and multinational team located across Germany, India, Argentina, Canada, Spain, the UK and many more countries. A flexible work-from-home arrangement Opportunity to relocate to our office in Berlin A 500-dollar home-office setup budget A 1000-dollar annual learning and development budget Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Lead Product Analyst, B2C Financial Services
items.summary: Tabby is on a mission to give people power over their money.
items.description: Tabby is on a mission to give people power over their money. For too long, financial systems have worked for the institutions that built them, not the people using them. Runaway interest, fine print and limited access have left many behind, feeling shut out of a system that wasn't setting them up for success. We're building a different kind of system, in a complete money app to send, spend and save. One that's clear, flexible and puts people and businesses in control. Founded in 2019, we serve customers and businesses across Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates and Kuwait. Millions of customers and 65,000 global brands, government services and small businesses rely on us today. What began as a better way to pay at checkout has grown into a financial system working the way it should have all along. About the roleThis role focuses on Tabby Cash , and the growing ecosystem of our debit financial products. You will lead a team of analysts that work on activation, engagement, and profitability , helping shape how the product grows from 1 → 100. The role requires balancing user growth with sustainable economics , working across Product, Risk, and Growth teams. You will play a key role in defining how users adopt and use our cards, and how we optimize the products for long-term value. What you will be doing Lead a team of product analysts to provide support to the product and business teams across all aspects of their work. Generate hypotheses, conduct research and A/B tests, and present your findings clearly and compellingly, which highlights the importance of your insights. Regularly work with several stakeholders, including product and marketing teams, on fundamental research as well as on one-time requests. Support and monitor existing metrics for the Financial Products, identify areas for improvement, and develop new metrics that inform decision-making across the organization. Develop data visualizations and reports that are both informative and easily understood by business and product teams. Assist in the planning of necessary data structures and data quality improvements. What you will need Minimum of 4 years of work experience as a data/product analyst. Experience in leading a team of data analysts of any size. Proficiency in SQL and relational databases. Proficiency in data visualization and BI tools. Experience in planning data structures for new products and features. Strong knowledge of Python (Pandas, Numpy, Statsmodels, Matplotlib, etc.) Experience in product analytics in fintech is a plus. Experience in leveraging LLM/AI for analytical purposes is a plus. Strong quantitative skills and a structured approach to problem-solving. Ability to analyze issues, identify root causes, and recommend solutions. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to interact with business and product teams. At least an upper-intermediate level of English proficiency is required. What we offer: Full-time B2B contract Fully remote setup Up to 20% tax allowance 22 paid leave days annually Stock options (ESOP) in a fast-scaling, pre-IPO company Flexi benefits you can use for wellness, travel, or learning Work alongside a high-performing, international engineering team in a global fintech unicorn Relocation support is available to our hubs in Armenia, Georgia, Serbia, Portugal, and Spain, including flights, temporary accommodation, and legal setup (if needed) What you can expect We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team. A working environment that gives you autonomy and responsibility from day one. You should be comfortable with the idea that the quality of your work will influence the shape of your career. We are passionate about creating an inclusive, high-performing workplace that gives people from all backgrounds the support they need to thrive, grow, and meet their goals. If this sounds exciting to you, we’d love to hear from you! Originally posted on Himalayas
