items.summary: ABOUT ALUALU provides higher education for a higher purpose.
items.description: ABOUT ALU ALU provides higher education for a higher purpose. Our students declare missions, not majors.They develop the real-world skills to take on the world’s most pressing challenges. And they take ownership of their learning from day one through our peer and student-led approach – because ALU believes in the power and agency of young people to start shaping the future right now. Together with a world-class faculty and staff, our students are igniting a ripple of positive impact across Africa and the world. We are dedicated to fostering an open yet secure environment, balancing the safety of students, staff, and visitors with respect for individual rights, and safeguarding responsibilities. HOW WE WORK The ALU Team works in starkly different ways to traditional academic bureaucracies. We approach education from first principles, empower individuals to design, test, and implement creative new ideas, and work closely together to craft transformative learning experiences. We are deeply passionate about our students and excited by the challenge of building something entirely new. The African Leadership University is committed to ensuring the safety and Well-being of all students under our care. As part of this commitment , we have a comprehensive safeguarding policy in place , which outlines our Zero-tolerance approach to any violation of safeguarding. ABOUT THE TEAM The Business Performance & Analysis team is one of ALU ’s core performance intelligence functions, providing the insight, analysis and challenge required to help leaders understand performance, make informed decisions and improve institutional outcomes. Working across academic and professional functions, the team goes beyond reporting what has happened to understand why it happened, what it means, what is likely to happen next, and what action is required. It brings together performance data, analysis and external benchmarks to identify trends, risks, opportunities and areas for improvement. The team connects strategy, performance and execution by strengthening performance measurement, supporting decision-making and helping leaders translate insight into action. Its impact is measured not by the volume of reports produced, but by the quality of decisions informed and the improvements in institutional performance that follow. ABOUT THE ROLE The institution generates a great deal of information and data across campuses, programmes and systems held by functions with different definitions and different reporting rhythms. The Manager, Business Performance & Analysis will assemble it, identify what matters in it and put that in front of the people who have to decide. You are expected to find the insight inside fragmented institutional information and make it usable by the people who have to act on it. This role goes beyond producing analysis to deciding what the analysis means, what can reasonably be concluded from it, and the form in which that meaning will actually land. The role will enable the University to act on what its own information is telling it by bringing together fragmented evidence, establishing what matters and putting it in front of the right person in a form they can use. ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES Research, Economic Analysis and Insight (the core of the role) Produce quantitative and economic analysis underpinning material submitted to the Executive Committee and the Board including scenario work, unit economics, capacity and cost modelling, cost behaviour, and the baseline scenario against which a decision should be judged. Take fragmentary, inconsistent and incomplete inputs from several functions and produce one defensible view, with the areas of remaining uncertainty named rather than smoothed over. This is the central skill of the role. Interrogate the question behind the request. Where the question as asked will not produce a useful answer, clarify the decision that needs to be supported and propose the more useful analytical question. Maintain relevant external evidence, including comparator institutions, sector benchmarks, published research and precedent relevant to current analyses and decisions. Build and maintain the external evidence base: comparator institutions, sector benchmarks, published research, and precedent relevant to decisions in front of ALU . State assumptions explicitly, and state plainly what an analysis does not establish. Where required data does not exist, publish the gap rather than substituting a proxy without saying so. Review recurring analysis and underlying assumptions, identify material gaps or inconsistencies, and raise findings where further scrutiny is required. Communication and Decision-Ready Output Design data and insight presentations so the key finding is immediately visible rather than presenting the dataset in full. Treat chart selection, sequencing and emphasis as analytical choices. Determine the appropriate format for each piece of work, whether a written memo, one-page decision brief, chart, dashboard, model walkthrough or verbal briefing, based on the decision, audience and complexity involved. Write for senior readers with limited time: lead with the finding or decision required, support it with the relevant evidence, and state what remains unknown and what would resolve it. Adjust the level of detail, language and presentation across audiences including the Executive Committee, Board, departmental leaders and technical counterparts. Present analysis clearly and confidently, including the assumptions, limitations and implications of the work. Automation and tooling Support the development and maintenance of automated workflows for data extraction, reconciliation, monitoring and reporting, reducing recurring manual effort. Use AI-enabled tools, agents and scripted workflows to accelerate recurring analytical tasks, including drafting, summarisation, exception detection, data preparation and scheduled checks. Apply judgement to AI-generated outputs, validate results and identify where automation should not replace human review. Build and maintain escalation triggers within recurring analytical and monitoring processes so that exceptions, overdue actions or material changes generate timely alerts. Document analytical tools and workflows to a standard that allows another team member to operate, understand and modify them without reliance on the original author. Analytics Capability and Continuous Improvement Improve analytical methodologies, templates, reporting processes and tools used by the Business Performance & Analysis function. Identify recurring requests and manual processes that can be standardised, automated or redesigned. Establish practical quality checks for recurring analysis and reporting. Share analytical methods, tools and lessons learned across the team and support the development of analytical capability. Performance Tracking and Follow-through Maintain accurate records of key decisions, actions, owners, assumptions and review dates arising from performance and planning activities. Monitor agreed actions and escalation triggers and raise overdue or off-track items appropriately through appropriate and well suited digital tools. Maintain the document repository to support continuity, transparency and effective handover. Executive and cycle coordination Coordinate engagement requirements against the University's planning, review and reporting calendar, including committee dates, planning cycles, statutory requirements and reporting deadlines. Prepare the analysis, briefing material and supporting information required for those engagements. Track actions and commitments arising from key meetings and ensure they are reflected in the appropriate working records and follow-up mechanisms. Coordinate inputs across functions to ensure materials are complete, consistent and ready for review. Ensure the safety and well-being of all young persons and vulnerable adults with whom we deal, by adhering to ALU ’s comprehensive safeguarding policy, maintaining a zero-tolerance approach to any violations of safeguarding standards REQUIRED EXPERIENCE 6 to 8 years of relevant professional experience, with demonstrated experience producing analysis that informs decisions taken by people more senior than yourself, in a research institution, consultancy, financial institution, policy body, university, or comparable analytical function. Economic reasoning, evidenced by training or by practice. You think in terms of opportunity cost, marginal effects, incentives and counterfactuals, and you state your assumptions before your conclusions. A degree in economics or experience across consulting, policy research, financial analysis or a quantitative discipline. Demonstrated ability to turn complex analysis into concise executive communication, including decision briefs, presentations, dashboards or written recommendations. Working competence in Python or R for data analysis and evidence of having built or supported an analytical workflow that can run with limited manual intervention. Practical experience using AI-enabled tools, including large language models, agents or scripted workflows, to improve analytical productivity, automation or decision support. Demonstrated ability to take incomplete and conflicting inputs from multiple sources and produce a single defensible view. Demonstrated ability to become productive quickly in an unfamiliar subject area and build sufficient domain understanding to analyse it effectively. Experience working across functions with different data sources, priorities and perspectives is strongly preferred. Exposure to executive, Board or committee reporting is desirable. REQUIRED COMPETENCIES Functional Competencies Analytical Reasoning: Break down complex questions, identify the relevant variables and determine the analysis required to support a decision. Data Interpretation and Judgement: Analyse information critically, identify patterns and anomalies, test assumptions and assess what can reasonably be concluded. Economic and Financial Acumen: Understand opportunity cost, incentives, cost behaviour, revenue, contribution and the financial implications of decisions. Modelling and Forecasting: Build and interpret scenarios, forecasts and sensitivity analyses to support planning and decision-making. Digital and AI Fluency: Use analytical, automation and AI-enabled tools confidently to improve speed and quality while independently validating outputs. Executive Communication: Distil complex analysis into clear findings, implications and recommendations appropriate to the audience and decision required. Behavioural & Leadership Competencies Judgement: Recognise what matters, make sound calls with imperfect information and know when further analysis is warranted. Constructive Challenge: Question assumptions, identify weaknesses and raise material concerns directly and objectively. Ownership: Take responsibility for analytical quality, timeliness and usefulness from problem definition through to delivery. Collaboration: Work effectively across Finance, Data/IT, academic and professional functions while respecting ownership of underlying data and business processes. Delivery Discipline: Manage competing demands, coordinate contributors and deliver high-quality work to agreed timelines. Continuous Improvement: Improve processes, tools and ways of working so that recurring work becomes more efficient, reliable and scalable. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Federated Registry Data Scientist
items.summary: Company Overview Rhythm is a global, commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company committed to transforming the lives of patients living with rare neuroendocrine diseases.
items.description: Company Overview Rhythm is a global, commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company committed to transforming the lives of patients living with rare neuroendocrine diseases. We develop medicines for previously untreatable or undertreated diseases. We recognize the courage it takes for patients and their caregivers to begin their journey of advocacy to find the answers they need. Their courage inspires us to challenge convention, ask bold questions and seek answers for them. Every day, we strive for excellence through our willingness to adapt, learn, and our tenacity to overcome barriers, together. Opportunity Overview The Federated Registry Data scientist will contribute to the design, development and operation of a multi-country federated registry platform based on the Observational Medical Outcomes Partnership Common Data Model (OMOP CDM), in collaboration with specialized vendors for Extract-Transform-Load (ETL), hosting, and federated analyses. The role will serve as a primary point of contact between Rhythm, the selected vendors, and participating registries for data-related activities. The Data Scientist will oversee the local registry data collection (mapping, transformation, quality-check) and the federated analyses specifications and outputs within a federated OMOP CDM-based environment provided and maintained by the vendors. Responsibilities & Duties Federated analyses Oversee and supervise the vendor’s technical and analytical deliverables Oversee data collection, data quality check, ETL logic and data mapping to OMOP CDM Lead preparation and review of the statistical analysis plan, cohort definitions, variable definitions, and federated query specifications supported and executed by the vendors based on research questions proposed by the Scientific Committee, the participating centers or internally Perform external research proposals’ feasibility assessment before review by the Scientific Committee Ensure analytical outputs are clear and consistent with research questions, develop report for review by the scientific committee, and support the drafting of related publications Collaboration with vendors Collaborate with the vendor on source data review, OMOP mapping, ETL logic, and data quality checks, helping to identify, prioritize, and resolve quality issues Help with data-related questions raised by the vendor and coordinate timely responses from centers when local input is required Ensure that data-related discussions remain aligned with Rhythm’s scientific objectives, project scope, timelines, and budget Collaboration with sites/registries owners Support sites in understanding project data requirements, minimum datasets, expected formats, timelines, and quality control processes Coordinate with sites and the vendor to investigate data quality issues such as missing data, inconsistent values, duplicate records, etc. Collaborate with research teams (scientific committees, internal stakeholders, participating sites) to develop insights and drive evidence generation Perform any other relevant tasks as needed to support the team and company objectives. Qualifications & Skills Advanced degree in Life Sciences, Data Science, Information Systems, or an equivalent scientific or technical discipline Strong experience with healthcare data sources, including clinical registries, electronic health records, claims databases, healthcare databases, and real-world evidence projects Strong proficiency in R and/or Python Knowledge of healthcare standards, including OMOP CDM, Fast Health Interoperability Resources (FHIR), Systemized Nomenclature of Medicine Clinical Terms (SNOMED CT), etc. Knowledge of statistical methods in real-world evidence (RWE) Strong communication and interpersonal skills, capable of engaging with senior leadership and key stakeholders. Not accepting the status quo, working with a sense of urgency to deliver results Self-starter mentality who feels comfortable working in a fast-paced environment Cross-functional mindset focused on a seamless collaboration with internal and external partners Fluent in English This role is home office based. Rhythm operates in a hybrid-work model. Candidates applying must be willing and able travel internationally. More about Rhythm We are a dynamic and growing global team spanning more than a dozen countries. At Rhythm we are dedicated to transforming the lives of patients living with rare melanocortin-4 receptor (MC4R) pathway diseases by rapidly advancing care and precision medicines that address the root cause. Our team is passionate about expanding access to reach more patients and developing novel therapies for other rare neuroendocrine diseases, including congenital hyperinsulinism. At Rhythm Our Core Values Are We are committed to advancing scientific understanding to improve patients’ lives We are inspired to tackle tough challenges and have the courage to ask bold questions We are eager to learn and adapt We believe collaboration and ownership are foundational for our success We value the unique contribution each individual brings to furthering our mission Inherent in our core values is the commitment to act ethically and with integrity in all we do. items.title: Lead Vulnerability Intelligence Analyst (Europe or LATAM, Remote)
items.summary: Company Overview:Intel 471 empowers enterprises, government agencies, and other organizations to win the cybersecurity war using near-real-time insights into the latest malicious actors, relationships, threat patterns, and imminent attacks relevant to their businesses.
items.description: Company Overview: Intel 471 empowers enterprises, government agencies, and other organizations to win the cybersecurity war using near-real-time insights into the latest malicious actors, relationships, threat patterns, and imminent attacks relevant to their businesses. Founded in 2014, Intel 471 provides comprehensive intelligence and monitoring on threat actors. The company’s centralized TITAN platform enables intelligence and security professionals to access structured information, dashboards, timely alerts and intelligence reporting via web portal or API integration. Our pedigree is unmatched and we count upon a team with experience operating in the intelligence services, military, law enforcement and private threat intelligence companies in nearly every continent on earth. The Role: You own the technical depth of our vulnerability intelligence practice. When a new CVE drops, you're the person who determines what's actually true and decides what our customers should do about it. This is a team lead role where you'll set the technical standard for how we validate, assess, and communicate vulnerability risk. You'll also build and maintain the tooling that lets a small team cover the ever-growing world of vulnerability research. What You'll Do: Design, build, and deploy honeypot systems to monitor for exploitation activity. Acquire, test, and validate proof-of-concept exploits in virtual environments to confirm or refute claims about exploitability. Develop practical mitigations for cases where patching is delayed, impossible, or insufficient. These mitigations could include configuration hardening, network segmentation, ACLs, disabling features, or other controls. You'll devise techniques for detecting both attempted and successful exploitation by illuminating the artifacts defenders should hunt for. You'll write vulnerability reports that dive into the details about an exploit such as how it works, who is using it and who is being targeted. Automation is a key component of the role; you will build and maintain the systems we use to streamline vulnerability assessment and automate triage of vulnerability alerts. Required Qualifications: Every candidate must be able to: - Validate and test PoCs to verify the validity of exploitation claims. - Devise mitigation techniques beyond patching. - Devise techniques for detecting exploit activity, attempted or successful. - Write vulnerability reports such as Vulnerability Spotlights. - Identify new sources of vulnerability intelligence. - Train and mentor junior team members. Technical foundation: - Proficiency with at least one programming language (Python, Go, C/C++, or similar) sufficient to read exploit code, modify PoCs, and build tooling. - Hands-on fluency with virtual machines, containers, and re-usable lab environments for safe detonation and analysis. - Solid computer science fundamentals. - Thorough understanding of computing and internet fundamentals: TCP/IP, HTTP, DNS, TLS, authentication and authorization models, and how real systems are actually deployed. - Demonstrated subject-matter-expert-level depth. - A working bias toward automation. Strong candidates additionally bring: - Experience building honeypot or sensor systems to monitor real-world exploitation activity. - Experience building systems that streamline or automate PoC testing and validation. - Demonstrated ability to integrate a new intelligence source end-to-end, from evaluation and ingestion to normalization, enrichment and delivery. Also valuable: original vulnerability research or CVE credits; reverse engineering skills; detection engineering (Sigma, Snort/Suricata, YARA); SOC experience; familiarity with CVSS, CWE, EPSS, and the KEV catalog; public speaking or published writing. Benefits: Competitive compensation Remote-friendly culture Wellness programs A variety of professional development opportunities Inclusive culture focused on people, customers and innovation Our Culture: The Intel 471 team is constantly growing and is always on the lookout for talented professionals who seek to operate on the forefront of the fight against threat actors impacting our customers and partners. Our culture of humility and quiet professionalism is a core attribute of Intel 471 and everyone within it. Our culture is collaborative, supportive and fast-paced. We're a mission-driven company. We're looking for talented, 'can-do' minded people with a passion for always doing the right thing. We believe in supporting a progressive culture that allows all our people to be themselves, enjoy exciting opportunities and grow with us. That's why our culture is founded on our core values of openness, inclusion, integrity and client focus, which set the tone for how we work together and treat each other in order to empower us all – and foster a unique team spirit. Salary: Market competitive Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: About Freshpaint: Healthcare is a $4+ trillion industry in the U.S. alone, and it’s undergoing a rapid digital transformation. Hospitals, digital health companies, and life sciences organizations rely on analytics and advertising tools to reach patients, measure performance, and grow. But those tools weren’t built for regulated healthcare data. That creates real compliance risk and forces teams to choose between growth and privacy. Freshpaint eliminates that trade-off. We’re a privacy-first data platform that helps healthcare organizations use modern marketing and analytics tools without exposing protected health information (PHI). Freshpaint sits between a company’s website or app and the third-party tools they use, automatically detecting and controlling sensitive data before it’s shared. In short: we let healthcare teams move fast, safely. Backed by Top Investors Freshpaint is backed by some of the most respected names in technology, including: Y Combinator (OpenAI, Stripe, Airbnb, Coinbase, DoorDash) Intel Capital (Broadcom, Astera Labs, VMware, RedHat, MongoDB) We’ve raised tens of millions of dollars in funding to build the privacy infrastructure layer for healthcare’s digital future. Overall Summary Our success is defined by the success of our customers. We’re looking for an Implementation Engineer to help our customers take a privacy-first approach to healthcare marketing while improving performance, measurement, and growth. The Customer Success team at Freshpaint helps our customers reach their goals while keeping privacy, data quality, and marketing performance front and center. We help customers move beyond compliance-only implementations to restore visibility, improve campaign measurement, optimize marketing performance, and identify opportunities across the customer journey. We focus on delivery excellence, industry expertise, efficiency, and customer outcomes, so customers keep getting value and keep growing. Implementation Engineers own one of the very first touchpoints of the customer lifecycle: getting Freshpaint live on customers’ websites and applications. You’ll turn customer requirements into a clear implementation plan, guide customers through technical setup and validation, and build trust through clear communication and disciplined execution. The goal is to get every customer live, deeply adopted, and running on a reliable, privacy-conscious configuration that supports both compliance and marketing performance optimization. Primary responsibilities Drive customer value through implementation and adoption Manage a portfolio of 20–30 clients representing $2–4MM in ARR, owning the technical execution of their implementations and driving onboarding, adoption, and growth. Efficiently implement the Freshpaint solution in partnership with our customers, owning time to first value from the beginning to the end of onboarding. Ensure all product features available to the customer are onboarded, and work with Account Management to accelerate adoption of those features. Maintain high NPS scores for both implementation and account satisfaction. Help customers navigate the data privacy landscape and Freshpaint’s relevant offerings Achieve operational excellence. Ensure all communication and activities with assigned customers are consistently documented in our systems of record Validate implementation behavior against agreed requirements and expected data flows. Maintain accurate documentation, uses metrics or evidence to assess progress, and reliably closes loops with customers and internal partners. Become knowledgeable about healthcare data privacy. Have complete context on our product and become an expert in the larger healthcare data privacy space. Educate our customers on the value and associated positive business outcomes of the healthcare data privacy platform Communicate technical concepts clearly. Convey sound data principles to a wide variety of audiences: marketers, product managers, data scientists, engineers, and VP/C-level executives. Form close relationships with our customers. Serve as the voice of the customer internally at Freshpaint by providing customer feedback to product, creating customer case studies with marketing, facilitating referrals for technical or services partnerships, or coordinating customer referrals for sales. Expand existing customers. Proactively identify where and how Freshpaint capabilities can deliver incremental business value. Work with Account Management to drive expansion opportunities with clear objectives, technical requirements, and action plans. Constantly iterate on our process. Be part of a growing team at Freshpaint and help inform our approach to our customer lifecycle processes. Work cross functionally and manage special projects internally to help Freshpaint scale as fast as possible. Contribute to our team growth by creating new content, playbooks, and processes for peers to use as winning strategies. Occasional Travel. Drive customer attendance to Freshpaint in person events and attend industry events to engage customer stakeholders Visit customers onsite where possible for partnership reviews and relationship building Desired skills & experience Previous experience and expertise developing, implementing, or managing digital solutions. At least 3-4 years of experience in a Customer Success Engineering, Solutions Consulting, Solutions Architecture, or a similar client-facing role Clear understanding of web technologies, analytics, and front-end development Experience implementing, onboarding, supporting, and troubleshooting platform configurations Working proficiency with tag management platforms like Google Tag Manager Working proficiency with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript Technical Proficiency & Stakeholder Alignment. Proficient in aligning technical concepts and features with required capabilities, effectively presenting to diverse stakeholders and engaging with senior executives on technical and business topics Analytical & Operational Excellence. Exceptional oral and written communication skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally Facilitate kickoff calls and implementation scoping discussions as necessary with multiple stakeholders, including our customer’s agency partner(s). Team Collaboration. Demonstrated ability to excel in a collaborative, geographically distributed team environment while also working independently with minimal supervision, managing multiple tasks and requests with outstanding organizational and project management skills Passion for Customer Success. Deep commitment to customer success and service mentality, with diplomacy, tact, and poise under pressure when addressing customer issues Ability to drive adoption and sell new product offerings and services Nice to haves Experience working with customer data and/or marketing technology products Experience with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SQL Experience working with integrating data using front-end and server-side APIs Experience in analytics tools or warehouses (Looker, Tableau, Snowflake, Redshift, etc.) Experience working with demand-side platforms like The Trade Desk, StackAdapt, or similar Domain expertise in Healthcare Marketing, Data Privacy, or Enterprise Healthcare (B2B and/or B2C) Experience working with customers in the Healthcare industry Deep knowledge of customer data, product analytics, and common vendors in the space Perks & Benefits We take care of our team—here’s a peek at what you get when you join: Competitive pay + generous equity Half-day Fridays, every Friday 16 weeks fully paid parental leave (eligible after 6 months; commission-based roles receive 100% base salary during leave) Flexible PTO with a required 2-week minimum Top-tier health, dental & vision (100% covered for you, 80% for dependents) Intentional & engaging company offsites (past trips: Arizona, Jackson Hole, Nashville, New Orleans & more) And more! This role can be filled in the Northeast (New York, NJ, Philadelphia, Boston), our San Francisco headquarters, OR other remote locations in the U.S. As a Commercial Data Scientist , you’ll work within cross-functional delivery teams alongside other analysts, engineers, and commercial stakeholders in discovering data insights to help improve healthcare. How you’ll make an impact: Deliver novel and impactful insights for client organizations using machine learning and AI technologies. Work closely with our Product, Platform Data, Insights & Strategy, and Sales teams to create client-facing analyses. Showcase your engineering skills by creating data products from scratch and automating code so they can be re-used by other teammates and future projects. Leverage Doximity's extensive datasets to identify and classify behavioral patterns of medical professionals on our platform. Embrace the challenge of a fast-paced environment to exceed client expectations The Core Values of the Client Intelligence team As an organization we value diversity - in backgrounds and in experiences. Healthcare is a universal concern, and we need people from all backgrounds to help build a better future for all. Below are additional core values specific to the Insights Team. Collaboration —The best candidates and teammates are not only strong in their own aptitudes but care deeply about supporting each other's growth. Passion for Data —You’re going to help our clients and team members with data-driven decision making. We need someone that can manipulate millions of rows of data and also ask the right questions to find the important insights. Reliability – Our team is efficient, flexible, and agile only because we trust the reliability of each member. We need self-starters and goal-oriented individuals for our continued success. Curiosity – Continuous learning is a cornerstone at Doximity, and curious individuals thrive in our environment. We’re looking for someone who is curious enough about data to go above-and-beyond the task for the true insight. Respect – A key dynamic that allows our team to flourish is respect: for ourselves and our quality of work, for our teammates, and for our internal clients who are under the pressure of deadlines and finance goals. About you: At least 4 years of professional experience as a Data Scientist or other related roles working with complex, high-volume, structured and unstructured datasets. Prior experience in a data science consulting role at firms such as ZS, Trinity, IQVIA, BlueMatter, etc., where you thrived in a fast-paced environment Advanced knowledge of statistical concepts — particularly exploratory data analysis, experimental design, and probability theory. Deep understanding of modern machine learning techniques Proven ability to design, train, and evaluate large-scale production models using frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow. Advanced SQL proficiency — skilled at writing and optimizing complex queries across multiple tables and data relationships. Advanced Python skills, including understanding of object-oriented programming, production-grade code design, and modern data science libraries. Hands-on experience with distributed data processing tools and concepts for scalable analysis and model training. Excellent data visualization and storytelling abilities, with the capacity to translate technical insights into clear, compelling narratives for internal and client stakeholders. Curious, fast learner with a demonstrated passion for data, continuous learning, and staying current with advances in machine learning research. Fun Facts About the Client Intelligence team We have access to one of the richest healthcare datasets in the world, with deep information on hundreds of thousands of clinicians and their connections. Business decisions at Doximity are driven by our data, analyses, and insights. The members of our team bring a diverse set of technical and cultural backgrounds. We like to have fun - company outings, team lunches, and other social events! Compensation The anticipated total compensation for this role is $119,333 - $172,800 depending on factors such as experience, skills, location, and internal equity. Our total compensation package may include: Base salary Equity (where applicable) Annual bonus or incentive compensation (where applicable) Specific compensation details will be discussed during the interview process. Benefits In addition to competitive compensation, Doximity offers a comprehensive benefits package for full time employees. Some of our offerings include: Medical, dental, and vision insurance 401(k) with company match Flexible paid time off and company holidays Paid parental leave Professional development and learning opportunities Wellness and mental health resources Remote work support and home office stipend (where applicable) Why You'll Love Working Here At Doximity, you'll join a mission-driven company where your work has a meaningful impact on healthcare. We believe great ideas come from empowered teams, and we're committed to creating an environment where people can do their best work. Make a real impact. Help build products that support over a million healthcare professionals and ultimately improve patient care. Work with exceptional teammates. Collaborate with thoughtful, talented colleagues who value curiosity, humility, and continuous learning. Enjoy flexibility and trust. We support flexible ways of working and empower employees with the autonomy to own their work. Grow your career. Take on meaningful challenges, develop new skills, and shape your career through mentorship and professional development. Bring your authentic self. We're committed to fostering an inclusive culture where diverse perspectives are welcomed, respected, and celebrated. Our Hiring Process & AI Tools Doximity may use artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled tools throughout the hiring process to help improve the candidate experience and support our recruiting team. These tools may assist with administrative tasks such as scheduling, general communication, interview coordination, note-taking, or summarizing interview feedback. Human recruiters and hiring managers make all hiring decisions. We are committed to using AI responsibly, transparently, and in accordance with applicable laws. items.title: Analytics Lead, Deposit Fraud Risk
items.summary: At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most. The Fraud team at Affirm Bank works cross-functionally with Machine Learning, Product, Engineering, Operations to combat fraudulent activities to foster a safe platform. This…
items.description: At Affirm , we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most. The Fraud team at Affirm Bank works cross-functionally with Machine Learning, Product, Engineering, Operations to combat fraudulent activities to foster a safe platform. This role requires abundant cross-functional partnership. This individual will be the representative of the Credit Risk org, leading the charge on refining our Identity Verification and Fraud processes as well as our Application flow. Additionally, this role will work closely with the Product and Engineering teams to improve our Fraud solution. Come join us in our mission to change consumer finance through better technology, lower costs, and increased transparency while providing the best customer experience. What You'll Do This role will take charge of owning fraud performance for depository products, including monitoring fraud losses, approval rates, false positives, customer friction, and other key risk metrics Data Pipeline, Analytics & Monitoring Build and maintain scalable data models and transformation pipelines, using tools (such as DBT) to standardize depository product, transaction, customer, fraud, and operational data. Define trusted fraud performance metrics and analytical datasets, including fraud loss rates, approval and decline rates, false-positive rates, customer friction, and operational efficiency. Develop recurring dashboards, scorecards, and monitoring frameworks to provide clear visibility into fraud performance, portfolio health, and emerging risks. Conduct deep-dive analyses to diagnose fraud losses, control gaps, false positives, portfolio shifts, and unexpected performance changes, translating findings into actionable recommendations. Fraud Strategy Building & Optimization Develop and optimize fraud rules, policies, thresholds, models, and decision strategies that balance loss prevention, customer experience, operational capacity, and product growth. Evaluate new data sources and signals to improve detection of identity risk, account takeover, device risk, transaction risk, and other fraud typologies relevant to depository products. Lead testing and performance measurement of fraud strategy changes, including rule launches, model updates, policy changes, and new product controls, with clear pre- and post-implementation evaluation. Partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Machine Learning, Data Engineering, Fraud Operations, and Risk to improve fraud strategies, strengthen operational feedback loops, and support new product launches. What We Look For EXPERIENCE - 7+ years’ of Analytics experience PRODUCT KNOWLEDGE - Passion to understand how Affirm product works and a curious mindset to help change and make it more effective TECHNICAL SKILLS - Fluent in SQL and Python PEOPLE SKILLS - A team player with ability to collaborate and influence across many different teams in the organization COMMUNICATION - Ability to communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences EXECUTION - Able to thrive in a fast-paced environment and be responsive and available during times of peak fraud activity MULTI-TASKING - Strong time management skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities RISK KNOWLEDGE - Working knowledge of the fundamentals of payment processing and an understanding of industry risk trends, including familiarity with fraud strategy development We also encourage you to read our Chief Risk Officer’s views on what makes Credit Risk Managers influential and on a Modern Risk Management System . Base Pay Grade - M Equity Grade - USA 8 Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range . Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills. Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.) USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT): $185,000 - $245,000 USA base pay range (all other U.S. states): $164,000 - $224,000 Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position. #LI-Remote Remote-first with flexibility built in Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience. Benefits designed for you Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights: Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents. Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you. Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to. Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount. We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help. For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law. By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

items.title: Senior Client Services Specialist
items.summary: About PlanITROIAt PlanITROI, we believe technology should create opportunities, not waste.
items.description: About PlanITROI At PlanITROI, we believe technology should create opportunities, not waste. Through industry-leading IT Asset Disposition (ITAD), refurbishment, repair, redeployment, and resale services, we help organizations maximize the value of their technology investments while extending device lifecycles and making affordable technology accessible to schools, families, nonprofits, businesses, and communities around the world. Behind every successful client relationship is a team committed to responsiveness, accountability, professionalism, and operational excellence. Our Client Services team serves as the critical link between our clients and our operations, ensuring every engagement delivers an exceptional experience from start to finish. We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and client-focused Senior Client Services Specialist who thrives in a fast-paced environment and takes ownership of client communication, service execution, reporting, problem-solving, and follow-through. This is not an entry-level position. We are looking for an experienced professional who understands how to manage client relationships, coordinates across multiple departments, analyzes information, solves problems proactively, and supports business growth through exceptional service delivery. The ideal candidate is a true “rock star” who combines professionalism, urgency, analytical thinking, strong communication skills, and technology proficiency to elevate the client experience and serve as a trusted partner. Position Summary The Senior Client Services Specialist is a senior-level, client-facing professional who serves as the operational backbone of the Client Services team. This role owns the day-to-day execution of client account management — from answering client emails and coordinating logistics to auditing operational data, running client calls, and generating quotes — while also leading strategic account activities such as business reviews and growth conversations. This individual acts as the central coordination point between clients and internal departments including Operations, Logistics, Sales, Finance, and Leadership. They are responsible for ensuring that every client commitment is tracked, communicated, and executed and that nothing falls through the cracks. Mission of the Role To deliver an exceptional client experience by ensuring proactive communication, flawless follow-through, operational alignment, and data-driven decision-making while supporting PlanITROI’s mission of transforming retired technology into affordable technology solutions that change lives. Engagement Type: Remote - Contractor Location: Latin American countries within the Eastern Standard Time (EST) zone. Key Responsibilities Client Email & Daily Communications Serve as the primary point of contact for all client email communications across assigned accounts, responding with accuracy, urgency, and professionalism. Manage a high-volume inbox across multiple client relationships simultaneously, ensuring no request, inquiry, or escalation goes unaddressed. Draft clear, polished, and client-appropriate correspondence for a wide range of situations from routine status updates to complex issue resolution. Client Onboarding Guide new clients through the full onboarding process including system access setup, process walkthroughs, documentation completion, and initial operational coordination. Serve as the client's main point of contact during the onboarding period, ensuring a smooth transition from contract to active service delivery. Proactively identify and resolve onboarding friction points before they become service issues. Client Portal Demonstrations & Training Conduct live demonstrations of the PlanITROI client portal for new and existing clients, walking them through reporting capabilities, data access, and self-service tools. Ensure clients are fully equipped to utilize the portal effectively and provide ongoing support as platform features evolve. Logistics Coordination Coordinate equipment pickup scheduling between clients and the internal Logistics team, managing timelines, confirmations, and last-minute schedule changes. Serve as the communication bridge between clients and Logistics, ensuring both sides have accurate, timely information on pickup windows, carrier details, and exceptions. Track open pickup requests and escalate delays proactively before client expectations are impacted. Operations Team Coordination Maintain close, ongoing communication with the Operations team regarding unit statuses, locked or held inventory, SLA performance, and service delivery timelines. Translate operational updates into clear, client-ready communications that set accurate expectations and maintain trust. Flag and escalate operational issues that impact client commitments, driving internal accountability for resolution. Receiving Data Review & Error Resolution Regularly review inbound receiving data for accuracy, identifying discrepancies, missing information, or errors made during the Operations intake process. Communicate findings to the Operations team and follow through to ensure corrections are made in a timely manner. Maintain a quality-focused mindset when auditing data, understanding that receiving accuracy directly impacts client settlement outcomes. Settlement Report Review Review client settlement reports for accuracy prior to distribution, reconciling data discrepancies and flagging issues for internal resolution. Communicate settlement details, variances, and resolutions clearly to clients, maintaining a high level of transparency and accuracy. Operational Calls with Clients Facilitate and lead recurring and ad hoc operational calls with clients and internal Operations teams, ensuring discussions are structured, productive, and action-oriented. Prepare call agendas, document meeting notes, capture action items, and own follow-through on all commitments made during calls. Ensure that client-facing operational calls reflect PlanITROI's professionalism, responsiveness, and commitment to service excellence. Quote Creation for Transactional Clients Generate accurate pricing quotes for transactional clients, coordinating with Sales and Operations as needed to confirm scope, pricing, and logistics requirements. Ensure quotes are delivered promptly and professionally, supporting timely client decision-making and order processing. Business Reviews & Strategic Reporting Prepare and deliver Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and periodic account reviews, presenting service performance data, trends, operational highlights, and strategic recommendations. Create executive-quality presentations and reports that position PlanITROI as a proactive, data-driven partner. Use account data and operational insights to drive meaningful, forward-looking client conversations. Meeting Coordination & Client Engagement Plan and coordinate client meetings including agenda preparation, stakeholder alignment, and timely follow-up documentation. Maintain a consistent cadence of strategic touchpoints with key client stakeholders to strengthen relationships and stay ahead of evolving needs. Upsell & Cross-Sell Identify organic opportunities to introduce clients to additional PlanITROI services including refurbishment, repair, redeployment, resale, and other program offerings. Position upsell and cross-sell conversations as value-added extensions of the existing relationship, not as sales pitches. Coordinate with Sales leadership when account growth opportunities require formal proposal development. Client Retention & Satisfaction Monitor client satisfaction signals proactively, identifying risks to retention and addressing them before they escalate. Support renewal activities and long-term account planning in partnership with Sales and Leadership. Serve as a trusted advisor to client stakeholders — someone they turn to not just for issues, but for insights. Perform other duties as assigned Qualifications Required Experience & Skills 3–7+ years of experience in one or more of the following: Client Services, Customer Success, Account Management, Operations Support, Service Delivery, or Business Operations in an operational environment. Demonstrated experience in a role where the majority of daily responsibilities were operational and execution-focused — not primarily strategic or oversight-oriented. Industry experience in IT Asset Disposition (ITAD), Reverse Logistics, Technology Services, Supply Chain Operations, Asset Management, or comparable operations-intensive environments is strongly preferred. Proven ability to manage high-volume email communications across multiple client accounts simultaneously. Experience coordinating between client-facing and internal operations functions (logistics, warehouse, operations, finance). Hands-on experience with data review, reporting, or reconciliation functions. Experience creating client-facing quotes, reports, or business review presentations. Demonstrated success managing competing priorities in a fast-paced, detail-intensive environment. B2B client management experience required. Skills & Competencies Exceptional written and verbal communication skills — able to represent PlanITROI professionally in all client-facing interactions. Advanced English proficiency (C1 level or higher) required. High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy in all data and client-facing outputs. Strong organizational and time management skills — able to track multiple open items across multiple accounts without dropping the ball. Proactive problem-solver who anticipates issues before they escalate. Self-directed and accountable — does not require handholding to execute consistently. Comfortable leading client calls and internal coordination meetings. Professional presence and communication style suitable for executive and client audiences. Strong analytical and critical thinking capabilities — comfortable reviewing data, identifying anomalies, and drawing accurate conclusions. Technical Skills Microsoft Office Suite — advanced proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Word. Salesforce CRM experience required. Google Workspace, SharePoint, Power BI — desired. Virtual meeting platforms (Microsoft Teams). Ability to use AI productivity tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, or similar) to improve communication quality and workflow efficiency. Reporting and dashboard tools. Process improvement or project management experience a plus. Why Join PlanITROI? At PlanITROI, your work directly supports our mission of Changing Lives with Affordable Technology. You will join a passionate, growth-oriented team committed to innovation, operational excellence, and creating meaningful impact through sustainable technology solutions. If you are a highly organized, client-focused professional who thrives on solving problems, building relationships, driving accountability, and delivering exceptional service, we encourage you to apply and become part of the team behind the world's greatest repair and refurbishment operation. PlanITROI is an equal opportunity employer . We prohibit discrimination/harassment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws Explore more about us: PlanITROI.com | NextraTech.com | BuyRefurbished.com Originally posted on Himalayas

The role is responsible for supporting and optimizing day-to-day operations, collaborating with Marketing, engaging with carriers and partners, and coordinating events and programs that advance key strategic initiatives. By maximizing field support, identifying efficiencies across markets, and implementing innovative solutions, this role ensures seamless execution of business processes and continuous improvement in service delivery. The Lead works cross-functionally to coordinate efforts among teams, enhance client retention, and enable cross-sale opportunities, ultimately benefiting both organizations and their employees and fostering a collaborative, results-driven environment. Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Growth, Retention & Cross‑Sale Enablement Develop and manage programs that support sales and client management teams with resources, reporting, and coordination to drive new business, renewals, and client retention. Marketing, Campaigns & Communications Partner with Marketing to design and execute national campaigns, manage content calendars, and develop EB‑specific messaging and materials aligned with practice strategy. Review and interpret engagement metrics and qualitative feedback to inform future initiatives and optimize communication strategies. Regional & Local Market Support Coordinate regional initiatives, visits, and events, ensuring alignment with national standards and strategic priorities and ensuring timely follow‑up on action items. Carrier & Partner Engagement Collect, analyze, and organize carrier performance data; prepare materials and recommendations for advisory meetings and track action items to completion. Coordinate and help shape initiatives with carrier and vendor partners to align with practice strategy and performance goals. Training & Learning Oversee scheduling, logistics, and resource planning for EB training programs and field development curricula. Maintain and organize training resources for ongoing team reference and recommend enhancements based on participation, feedback, and evolving business needs. Analytics & Performance Management Use Power BI and other tools to extract, organize, and report on key metrics (e.g., revenue, pipeline, retention, cross‑sales). Develop standard reporting templates and dashboards and surface insights and recommendations to leadership to inform decision‑making and performance improvement. Product & Technology Support Support rollout, adoption, and optimization of EB‑specific products and technology solutions, serving as an operational point of contact for the practice. Coordinate user communications, training, and feedback collection, and recommend enhancements to improve utilization and user experience. Practice Communications & Knowledge Management Assist with planning, content development, and execution for town halls, newsletters, and internal communications that support practice priorities. Event Support Plan and execute EB‑related events, including agenda development, content collection, speaker coordination, and logistics. items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Phoenix, Arizona URL: https://adventuretravel365.com/ Senior Full-Stack Developer - Marketplace Web & Mobile Platform We have a big idea, and we’re looking for a top-notch Senior Full-Stack Developer to help us bring it to life. We’re building a new contractor referral and services marketplace, think Thumbtack or Angi , where clients can easily find and connect with contractors and service providers. The vision includes both an interactive web platform and mobile app, with everything from user accounts and referrals to job tracking, payments, advertising, and more. This is a fully remote, full-time, ongoing position, and we’re open to applicants worldwide. There are a lot of moving pieces, which is exactly why we’re looking for someone who has built something like this before and gets excited about taking a platform from an idea to a working product, then continuing to grow it with us. What You’ll Help Us Build The platform will have two main sides: clients looking for services and contractors/vendors looking for business. Some of the functionality we’re planning includes: Client and contractor/vendor accounts and profiles Contractor listings, categories, search, and filtering Service requests, inquiries, referrals, and lead management Job and project tracking Client and vendor dashboards Online payments and transaction tracking Reviews and ratings Notifications and communications Banner advertising and paid promotional opportunities Admin tools for managing the platform Reporting and analytics Secure management of user, job, and transaction data And probably more! We have a strong vision for where we want this to go, but we also want the right developer to help us determine the smartest way to build it. This will be an evolving platform, so we’re looking for someone who wants to grow with it, not simply complete a checklist of features. Who We’re Looking For We’d love to find someone with strong experience in full-stack web and mobile development , especially someone who has worked on a marketplace, booking platform, service-provider network, or another multi-user platform. You should be comfortable with: Full-stack web development Mobile or cross-platform app development Strong front-end and back-end development Multi-user marketplace platforms User authentication and account management Payment gateway integrations Databases and APIs Third-party integrations Dashboards and reporting Secure, scalable application architecture Cloud hosting and deployment Testing, maintenance, and optimization Using modern AI-powered development tools and integrating AI capabilities into web and mobile applications If you’ve worked on something similar to Thumbtack, Angi, TaskRabbit, Upwork, or another two-sided marketplace , we definitely want to hear about it. More Than Just Coding We’re not looking for someone who simply waits for a list of instructions and starts coding. We want someone who can look at the big picture, ask the right questions, recommend the best technical approach, flag potential challenges, and help turn our ideas into a platform that’s intuitive, scalable, and built to grow. You’ll also be expected to study established platforms like Thumbtack and Angi , understand how their user journeys and marketplace functionality work from both the client and service-provider sides, and use those learnings to help us determine the best approach for our own platform. You should be able to take the project through planning, architecture, development, testing, launch, and beyond , while communicating clearly with a non-technical team along the way. Strong spoken and written English communication skills are important. You should be comfortable discussing ideas, explaining technical decisions clearly, and communicating regularly with a non-technical team. This is not a short-term build-and-leave project. We’re looking for someone who can stay with the platform as it grows, helping us continually improve, expand, and maintain it over time. Interested? Tell Us About Yourself Please send us: A quick introduction Your resume or LinkedIn profile Your portfolio and links to websites/apps you’ve built Examples of marketplaces, booking platforms, referral systems, or payment-enabled platforms you’ve worked on What you personally worked on for those projects Your experience using AI in development What technologies/frameworks you’d recommend for a project like this and why Your availability A short video introduction would be great, too! Nothing overly formal, just a quick introduction so we can get to know you, hear about your experience, and get a feel for how you communicate. Most importantly, show us what you’ve built. If you’ve helped create a multi-sided marketplace similar to Thumbtack or Angi, tell us about it. We’d love to see it. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/adventure-travel-365-senior-full-stack-developer-marketplace-web-mobile-platform

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: San Francisco, CA or Remote (U.S.) Commercial Data Scientist Doximity is the leading clinical AI company with the largest network of U.S. clinicians. Doximity’s AI-powered workflow platform is trusted by over 85% of U.S. physicians and 300+ health systems. Doximity's mission is to help clinicians be more productive so they can provide better care for their patients. At Doximity, we value curiosity, ownership, inclusion, and a commitment to making a meaningful impact. If you're excited about solving complex problems that improve healthcare, we'd love to hear from you. This role can be filled in the Northeast (New York, NJ, Philadelphia, Boston), our San Francisco headquarters, OR other remote locations in the U.S. As a Commercial Data Scientist , you’ll work within cross-functional delivery teams alongside other analysts, engineers, and commercial stakeholders in discovering data insights to help improve healthcare. How you’ll make an impact: Deliver novel and impactful insights for client organizations using machine learning and AI technologies. Work closely with our Product, Platform Data, Insights & Strategy, and Sales teams to create client-facing analyses. Showcase your engineering skills by creating data products from scratch and automating code so they can be re-used by other teammates and future projects. Leverage Doximity's extensive datasets to identify and classify behavioral patterns of medical professionals on our platform. Embrace the challenge of a fast-paced environment to exceed client expectations The Core Values of the Client Intelligence team As an organization we value diversity - in backgrounds and in experiences. Healthcare is a universal concern, and we need people from all backgrounds to help build a better future for all. Below are additional core values specific to the Insights Team. Collaboration —The best candidates and teammates are not only strong in their own aptitudes but care deeply about supporting each other's growth. Passion for Data —You’re going to help our clients and team members with data-driven decision making. We need someone that can manipulate millions of rows of data and also ask the right questions to find the important insights. Reliability – Our team is efficient, flexible, and agile only because we trust the reliability of each member. We need self-starters and goal-oriented individuals for our continued success. Curiosity – Continuous learning is a cornerstone at Doximity, and curious individuals thrive in our environment. We’re looking for someone who is curious enough about data to go above-and-beyond the task for the true insight. Respect – A key dynamic that allows our team to flourish is respect: for ourselves and our quality of work, for our teammates, and for our internal clients who are under the pressure of deadlines and finance goals. About you: At least 4 years of professional experience as a Data Scientist or other related roles working with complex, high-volume, structured and unstructured datasets. Prior experience in a data science consulting role at firms such as ZS, Trinity, IQVIA, BlueMatter, etc., where you thrived in a fast-paced environment Advanced knowledge of statistical concepts — particularly exploratory data analysis, experimental design, and probability theory. Deep understanding of modern machine learning techniques Proven ability to design, train, and evaluate large-scale production models using frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow. Advanced SQL proficiency — skilled at writing and optimizing complex queries across multiple tables and data relationships. Advanced Python skills, including understanding of object-oriented programming, production-grade code design, and modern data science libraries. Hands-on experience with distributed data processing tools and concepts for scalable analysis and model training. Excellent data visualization and storytelling abilities, with the capacity to translate technical insights into clear, compelling narratives for internal and client stakeholders. Curious, fast learner with a demonstrated passion for data, continuous learning, and staying current with advances in machine learning research. Fun Facts About the Client Intelligence team We have access to one of the richest healthcare datasets in the world, with deep information on hundreds of thousands of clinicians and their connections. Business decisions at Doximity are driven by our data, analyses, and insights. The members of our team bring a diverse set of technical and cultural backgrounds. We like to have fun - company outings, team lunches, and other social events! Compensation The anticipated total compensation for this role is $119,333 - $172,800 depending on factors such as experience, skills, location, and internal equity. Our total compensation package may include: Base salary Equity (where applicable) Annual bonus or incentive compensation (where applicable) Specific compensation details will be discussed during the interview process. Benefits In addition to competitive compensation, Doximity offers a comprehensive benefits package for full time employees. Some of our offerings include: Medical, dental, and vision insurance 401(k) with company match Flexible paid time off and company holidays Paid parental leave Professional development and learning opportunities Wellness and mental health resources Remote work support and home office stipend (where applicable) Why You'll Love Working Here At Doximity, you'll join a mission-driven company where your work has a meaningful impact on healthcare. We believe great ideas come from empowered teams, and we're committed to creating an environment where people can do their best work. Make a real impact. Help build products that support over a million healthcare professionals and ultimately improve patient care. Work with exceptional teammates. Collaborate with thoughtful, talented colleagues who value curiosity, humility, and continuous learning. Enjoy flexibility and trust. We support flexible ways of working and empower employees with the autonomy to own their work. Grow your career. Take on meaningful challenges, develop new skills, and shape your career through mentorship and professional development. Bring your authentic self. We're committed to fostering an inclusive culture where diverse perspectives are welcomed, respected, and celebrated. Our Hiring Process & AI Tools Doximity may use artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled tools throughout the hiring process to help improve the candidate experience and support our recruiting team. These tools may assist with administrative tasks such as scheduling, general communication, interview coordination, note-taking, or summarizing interview feedback. Human recruiters and hiring managers make all hiring decisions. We are committed to using AI responsibly, transparently, and in accordance with applicable laws. Equal Employment Opportunity Doximity is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know so we can support your participation. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/doximity-commercial-data-scientist

items.description: Who we are At Twilio , we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences. Our dedication to remote-first work , and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands. . Hiring and how we work We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings. . See yourself at Twilio Join the team as Twilio’s next Compliance Operations Specialist. About the job At Twilio, our mission is to power the future of communications. We believe that communication should be at the heart of every product and customer experience. In this role you will be monitoring the use of Twilio products, voice, SMS and KYC, to ensure that the traffic on Twilio’s platform is legal, compliant, and wanted. To do this you will also ensure that all traffic is following Tiwlio’s Voice Policy, Messaging Policy, Acceptable Use policy and meets CTIA requirements. We are looking for someone that is passionate about preventing fraud and abuse. The ideal candidate has some intermediate to advanced research and investigation skills and enjoys challenging and complex case work. Responsibilities In this role, you’ll: Investigate cases quickly and efficiently, perform analysis to understand bad actor behavior and demonstrate willingness to learn and become a subject matter expert in compliance investigations Protect Twilio customers and consumers through ongoing identification of bad actors, non-compliant activity and evolving tactics - taking action daily to stop bad actors/ activity while minimizing false positives. Identify trends, root cause gaps and recommend appropriate preventative solutions to stop bad actors from being successful. Use call detail records & aggregate traffic data to identify patterns and trends that determine a set list of actions. Resolve urgent issues impacting businesses, carriers and consumers worldwide. Use Twilio’s tools and your own investigative powers to detect and prevent non-compliant activity. Provide support for customers by email, to ensure customers have an excellent experience with Twilio. Qualifications Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table! Required: Willingness to work a non-traditional schedule (Tue-Sat), holidays may be required You have 1-2 years experience in KYC, fraud, abuse or compliance in ecommerce, FinTech, or telecommunications Experience working in a fast paced, ambiguous environment, with a strong bias for action You’re empathetic and love working with customers and carriers to solve their problems and questions, backed with data. You are detail-oriented with good organizational skills and comfortable with ambiguity. You have above average written and verbal communication skills and are able to articulate concepts/ideas in a clear, concise manner. You are willing to collaborate with communications partners and players in the industry to resolve issues, troubleshoot, and build trust. You have good time management and organizational skills and are comfortable working under pressure. Desired: Basic knowledge of SQL, Looker, Tableau or similar data extraction and data visualization tools Basic understanding APIs and related technologies Background in telecommunications is desired. Location This role will be based in Estonia (remote position). Shift time: Tue-Sat 9am-6pm. Travel We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings. What We Offer Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location. Compensation In accordance with local pay transparency requirements, the base salary range for this role is provided below. The successful candidate’s final compensation will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills and experience. Base Salary Range: €23,680.00 -€29,600.00 Twilio thinks big. Do you? We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic . Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts. So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions. . Stay alert to recruitment fraud We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps. . Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

The Visitor Squad is responsible for the funnel from the first visit to the paid lesson: landing pages, registration and booking, blog, and the visitor’s personal account. A core role within the team: approximately 70% frontend and 30% backend. Your area of responsibility includes the visitor’s personal account, attribution and funnel tracking, server-side integrations with ad platforms, and supporting experiments. You will work within the squad's processes: planning, grooming, code reviews, sprints, and releases. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain the visitor’s personal account and parts of the funnel from landing pages to booked lessons Own attribution: end-to-end visit tracking chains, UTM parameters, and diagnosing gaps in V2L/V2B tracking Build server-side integrations with ad platforms (e.g., Meta CAPI, TikTok Events API, and similar) Write and debug backend code in Python/Node: endpoints, caching, and server-side rendering Support A/B testing: rollouts, feature flags, and post-experiment code cleanup Investigate production incidents via Sentry and drive them through to resolution Monitor and optimize public page speed: Core Web Vitals Requirements 3+ years of production experience with TypeScript and React Python and Node.js: ability to work independently on the backend—endpoints, caching, SSR debugging—beyond just a thin BFF (Backend-For-Frontend) layer Experience with analytics and tracking: GTM, event tracking, server-side conversion delivery. Understanding how data travels from click to report, and the ability to locate data leaks/loss Product mindset: working with metrics and hypotheses rather than just closing tickets English proficiency Nice to Have GDPR and consent mechanism implementation on public pages Headless WordPress End-to-end testing with Playwright or Cypress SQL and BigQuery—ability to self-verify hypotheses using data CDN and edge caching (CloudFront or similar) Hands-on experience with Sentry and handling production errors Our Tech Stack TypeScript, React, Python, Next.js, Node.js, Express with server-side rendering via Pug, Sass and PostCSS, Vite and Gulp, MUI and an in-house design system in Storybook, Vitest, Jest, Cypress, and Playwright for E2E testing. What we offer: Fully remote work. A chance to shape the future of AI-driven education. A fun, dynamic team that loves building innovative products.
