items.description: Software Engineering Job Requisition ID # 25WD93193 English posting follows 25WD93193 Architecte logiciel, Plateforme de données AEC Aperçu du poste Chez Autodesk, nous sommes des pionniers dans le domaine des logiciels de conception 3D, d'ingénierie et de divertissement. Nous développons des outils qui permettent à certains des esprits les plus créatifs de la planète de résoudre des problèmes concrets. Reconnus par Fortune, Forbes, Glassdoor et d'autres comme l'un des meilleurs employeurs, nous nous engageons à créer un milieu de travail diversifié et inclusif où l'innovation et la créativité s'épanouissent. L'organisation Autodesk chargée des données en architecture, ingénierie et construction (AEC) est à la recherche d'un architecte logiciel expérimenté pour se joindre à l'équipe AEC Data et définir les services natifs du nuage ainsi que l'architecture des systèmes distribués qui sous-tendent le modèle de données AEC (AECDM) et les nombreux services qui l'entourent. Bien que le domaine soit celui des données, ce poste relève fondamentalement de l'architecture du nuage et des services - API, contrats de service, intégrations, conception de systèmes distribués et modèle de données connecté qui les relie entre eux - et s'étend à plusieurs équipes. Il ne s'agit pas d'un poste de spécialiste en entrepôt de données ou en analyse de données. L'organisation AEC Data met en place l'infrastructure de données fondamentale qui sous-tend la vision d'Autodesk en matière de construction connectée : les plateformes, les services et les modèles de données unifiés qui couvrent l'ensemble du cycle de vie des actifs bâtis, de la conception et de la construction jusqu'à l'exploitation et à l'entretien. Ce travail permet la circulation continue des données AEC (modèles 3D, dessins 2D, suivi des problèmes, coûts, flux de capteurs, etc.) entre les produits Autodesk et les intégrations tierces. L'architecte contribuera à façonner la prochaine génération de fonctionnalités pour le nuage industriel Autodesk Forma, en collaborant avec des architectes logiciels, des experts du domaine et les équipes de produit de Revit, Civil 3D, AutoCAD, Autodesk Construction Cloud et Autodesk Forma. Il s'agit d'un poste de contributeur senior dans un parcours d'architecture bien établi, relevant de l'architecte émérite de l'équipe AEC Data, qui occupe également le poste d'architecte logiciel principal. La responsabilité principale consiste à définir la manière dont plusieurs équipes conçoivent et développent - par le biais de normes, d'architectures de référence, d'ADR et de la gouvernance de la révision de conception - plutôt que de gérer un service unique. L'orientation précise du poste s'adapte aux points forts du candidat et aux besoins de l'organisation. Responsabilités Conception et évolution des API : Concevoir et faire évoluer les interfaces API des services AEC Data - modélisation des ressources, adressage, gestion des versions et évolution rétrocompatible, API de requête, et unification des interfaces qui se chevauchent en un seul contrat cohérent Architecture système : Définir et faire évoluer une architecture inter-équipes et native du nuage pour l'ensemble des services AEC Data; concevoir des systèmes distribués, y compris les contrats de service et les flux pilotés par les événements Conception et évolution des schémas : Concevoir, documenter et faire évoluer les schémas de données pour les entités du domaine AEC (bâtiments, infrastructures, espaces, systèmes, composantes, relations) - y compris les modèles sémantiques, les ensembles de propriétés, les systèmes de classification et les hiérarchies de relations. Assurer la gestion des versions, de la compatibilité ascendante et descendante, de la dépréciation et de la migration; maintenir le registre des schémas, les règles de validation et les contrôles de qualité Normes et gouvernance : Établir des normes, des architectures de référence et des composantes réutilisables; rédiger des propositions d'architecture et des comptes rendus de décision (ADR) pour examen par un conseil d'architecture interorganisationnel, et mener des revues de conception interéquipes Prototypage et faisabilité : Évaluer différentes orientations architecturales par la modélisation et le prototypage, afin de réduire les risques liés aux décisions clés avant leur adoption à grande échelle Mentorat et leadership technique : Encadrer les développeurs et les autres architectes sur les technologies émergentes et établies ainsi que sur les pratiques architecturales; approfondir les compétences techniques au sein des équipes Fiabilité et performance : Assurer la fiabilité, la sécurité et la performance des systèmes; définir les SLO et favoriser l'observabilité (métriques, traçage, journalisation) Communication : Communiquer sur l'architecture à l'aide de vues et de diagrammes clairs (p. ex., C4) ainsi que de présentations adaptées à la haute direction; produire une documentation exhaustive et du matériel d'intégration Qualifications Minimales Baccalauréat en informatique, ou expérience équivalente Au moins 10 ans d'expérience dans la conception de systèmes distribués natifs du nuage, dont au moins 5 ans à un niveau d'architecte inter-équipes (architecte logiciel, développeur principal, Staff+ ou équivalent). Le titre est flexible; l'étendue de l'impact est le critère principal Expertise approfondie des services en nuage (de préférence AWS), de la conception d'API et de services, ainsi que des modèles de systèmes distribués (microservices, architecture orientée événements, résilience) Solides bases en modélisation de données et en conception de schémas - y compris les langages de définition de schémas (p. ex., JSON Schema), la gestion des versions, ainsi que la compatibilité ascendante et descendante et les stratégies d'évolution - telles qu'appliquées tant aux schémas de données autonomes qu'aux contrats d'API. Une spécialisation en architecture d'entrepôt de données ou d'analyse n'est pas requise Excellente connaissance de la conception logicielle et des modèles d'architecture Capacité démontrée à exercer une influence sans autorité hiérarchique et à favoriser la coordination entre les équipes ne relevant pas de la gestion directe du candidat Solides compétences en leadership et en mentorat, avec une expérience avérée dans l'encadrement et le développement d'équipes diversifiées et interfonctionnelles Maîtrise de la communication d'idées complexes de manière concise et convaincante, avec d'excellentes compétences verbales, écrites et de présentation auprès d'un large éventail de parties prenantes Capacité à collaborer avec une équipe internationale Qualifications Souhaitées Les qualifications souhaitées constituent un éventail de compétences plutôt qu'une liste de critères à cocher : une expertise approfondie dans quelques domaines clés importe davantage qu'une connaissance superficielle de l'ensemble d'entre eux. Les compétences émergentes en IA/apprentissage automatique (IA/ML) énumérées ci-dessous constituent un atout et peuvent être développées en cours d'emploi; elles ne sont pas des conditions préalables. Domaines clés Services en nuage : AWS et ses services clés (EC2, ECS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, RDS) Systèmes distribués : décomposition des services orientée domaine, modèles de cohérence des données (CQRS, event sourcing, sagas) et conception multi-locataires/multi-régions Conception d'API et de services : conception et évolution des API REST; GraphQL (y compris la fédération) Architecture de bases de données : relationnelles et NoSQL (p. ex., DynamoDB, PostgreSQL) Observabilité/SRE : OpenTelemetry, traçage distribué, métriques/SLO pour les services de données Bonus Technologies sémantiques : graphes de connaissances, RDF/OWL ou graphes de propriétés - particulièrement pertinents pour l'AECDM connecté/sémantique Expertise BIM : concepts de modélisation de l'information du bâtiment (BIM), familles Revit ou systèmes de modélisation paramétrique similaires Systèmes d'IA : RAG, agents/MCP, orchestration agentique (LangGraph, Semantic Kernel), observabilité des grands modèles de langage (LLM), et gouvernance des données / sécurité de l'IA (renseignements personnels identifiables [PII], injection de prompts, filtrage de contenu) IA spécifique au domaine de l'AEC : extraction BIM/IFC, traitement CAO ou de nuages de points B Architectures orientées événements B : Kafka ou Kinesis; registres de schémas (Confluent, AWS Glue); traitement exactly-once Connaissance du secteur de l'AEC : Expérience dans le secteur de l'architecture, de l'ingénierie et de la construction; connaissance des normes de l'industrie (IFC, COBie, gbXML, CityGML, LandXML, UniFormat, OmniClass). Une formation d'intégration au secteur est offerte ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 25WD93193 Software Architect, AEC Platform Data Position Overview At Autodesk, we are pioneers in 3D design, engineering, and entertainment software, building tools that empower some of the most creative minds on the planet to solve real-world problems. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Glassdoor, and others as a top place to work, we are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where innovation and creativity thrive. Autodesk's Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) Data organization is seeking an experienced Software Architect to join the AEC Data team and define the cloud-native services and distributed-systems architecture that power the AEC Data Model (AECDM) and the many services around it. Data is the domain, but the role is fundamentally one of cloud and services architecture - APIs, service contracts, integrations, distributed-systems design, and the connected data model that ties them together - spanning multiple teams. It is not a data-warehouse or analytics-specialist role. The AEC Data organization is building the foundational data infrastructure behind Autodesk's vision for connected construction: the platforms, services, and unified data models that span the entire built-asset lifecycle, from design and construction through operation and maintenance. This work enables the continuous flow of AEC data (3D models, 2D drawings, issue tracking, cost, sensor streams, and more) across Autodesk products and third-party integrations. The architect will help shape the next generation of capabilities for the Autodesk Forma Industry Cloud, collaborating with software architects, domain experts, and product teams across Revit, Civil 3D, AutoCAD, Autodesk Construction Cloud, and Autodesk Forma. This is a senior individual-contributor role on an established architecture track, reporting to the Distinguished Architect of the AEC Data team, who also serves as the Lead Software Architect. The primary responsibility is to shape how multiple teams design and build - through standards, reference architectures, ADRs, and design-review governance - rather than to own a single service. The exact focus flexes to the candidate's strengths and organizational need. Responsibilities API Design & Evolution : Design and evolve API surfaces across the AEC Data services - resource modeling, addressing, versioning and backward-compatible evolution, query APIs, and unifying overlapping surfaces into a single coherent contract System Architecture : Define and evolve cross-team, cloud-native architecture across the AEC Data services; design distributed systems including service contracts and event-driven flows Schema Design & Evolution : Design, document, and evolve data schemas for AEC domain entities (buildings, infrastructure, spaces, systems, components, relationships) - including semantic models, property sets, classification systems, and relationship hierarchies. Own versioning, backward/forward compatibility, deprecation, and migration; maintain the schema registry, validation rules, and quality checks Standards & Governance : Establish standards, reference architectures, and reusable components; author architecture proposals and decision records (ADRs) for review by a cross-org architecture council, and run cross-team design reviews Prototyping & Feasibility : Evaluate alternative architectural directions through modeling and prototyping, de-risking key decisions before broad adoption Mentorship & Technical Leadership : Mentor developers and fellow architects on emerging and established technologies and on architectural practice; grow technical depth across teams Reliability & Performance : Ensure reliability, security, and performance of systems; define SLOs and drive observability (metrics, tracing, logging) Communication : Communicate architecture with clear views and diagrams (e.g., C4) and executive-ready narratives; produce comprehensive documentation and onboarding materials Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or equivalent experience 10+ years designing cloud-native, distributed systems, including 5+ years at cross-team architect altitude (Software Architect, Principal Developer, Staff+, or equivalent). Title is flexible; scope of impact is the primary consideration Deep expertise in cloud services (ideally AWS), API/service design, and distributed-systems patterns (microservices, event-driven, resilience) Solid grounding in data modeling and schema design - including schema definition languages (e.g., JSON Schema), versioning, and backward/forward-compatibility and evolution strategies - as applied both to standalone data schemas and to API contracts. Specialist data-warehouse or analytics architecture is not required Excellent knowledge of software design and architecture patterns Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and drive alignment across teams outside the candidate's direct management Strong leadership and mentoring skills, with a track record of guiding and growing diverse, cross-functional teams Mastery of conveying complex ideas concisely and persuasively, with excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills across a range of stakeholders Ability to collaborate with a global team Preferred Qualifications Preferred qualifications are a menu rather than a checklist: depth in a few core areas matters more than breadth across all of them. The emerging AI/ML capabilities below are advantageous and can be developed on the job; they are not prerequisites. Core Cloud Services : AWS and its core services (EC2, ECS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, RDS) Distributed Systems : Domain-driven service decomposition, data consistency patterns (CQRS, event sourcing, sagas), and multi-tenant/multi-region design API & Service Design : REST API design and evolution; GraphQL (including federation) Database Architecture : Relational and NoSQL (e.g., DynamoDB, PostgreSQL) Observability/SRE : OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, metrics/SLOs for data services Bonus Semantic Technologies : Knowledge graphs, RDF/OWL, or property graphs - particularly relevant to the connected/semantic AECDM BIM Expertise : Building Information Modeling concepts, Revit families, or similar parametric modeling systems AI Systems : RAG, agents/MCP, agentic orchestration (LangGraph, Semantic Kernel), LLM observability, and data governance / AI safety (PII, prompt-injection, content filtering) Domain-Specific AI for AEC : BIM/IFC extraction, CAD or point-cloud processing Event-Driven Architectures : Kafka or Kinesis; schema registries (Confluent, AWS Glue); exactly-once processing AEC Domain Knowledge : Experience in the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction industry; familiarity with industry standards (IFC, COBie, gbXML, CityGML, LandXML, UniFormat, OmniClass). Domain onboarding is provided Plus d'information/ Learn More À propos d'Autodesk/ About Autodesk Bienvenue chez Autodesk ! Nos logiciels créent chaque jour des choses extraordinaires : des bâtiments les plus écologiques aux voitures les plus propres, en passant par les usines les plus intelligentes et les films à succès. Nous aidons les innovateurs à concrétiser leurs idées, transformant non seulement la façon dont les choses sont fabriquées, mais aussi ce qui peut l'être. Nous sommes très fiers de notre culture chez Autodesk ; elle est au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons. Notre culture guide notre façon de travailler et de nous comporter les uns envers les autres, influence nos interactions avec nos clients et nos partenaires, et définit notre image au monde. En tant qu'Autodeskien, vous pouvez accomplir un travail significatif qui contribue à bâtir un monde meilleur, conçu et réalisé pour tous. Prêt à façonner le monde et votre avenir ? Rejoignez-nous ! Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software - from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made. We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk - it's at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world. When you're an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us! items.description: Product Headquarters: Czech Republic - Remote Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work. Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you. Our vision: A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together. About the Role: You'll help build the very AI-powered platform you use every day, with real autonomy over the features you ship. As the leading collaborative work management platform, Wrike generates an enormous amount of rich, interconnected data, including work item content, relationships between entities, complex business processes, user interactions, and direct user input. The mission of the DS/ML department is to transform this data into intelligent, AI-powered capabilities that help users gain deeper insights, automate routine work, enhance productivity, and create a more seamless work experience. As a Data Scientist in the Work Intelligence Unit, you will play a key role in product development through the application of state-of-the-art AI and machine learning technologies with a particular focus on leveraging Large Language Models and other emerging technologies. You will work on both user-facing AI features and foundational intelligence platform that power intelligent experiences across the product. Your Impact: Creating new and improving existing AI solutions Involvement in the whole process of data-driven development from analyzing product requirements to launching the feature or system to production (with the help of MLOps specialists) and improving it based on results of monitoring and feedback Communicating with fellow data scientists, product owners, and developers Applying best software engineering practices to build a reliable codebase Performing code reviews Working in agile environment and presenting the results of your work on regular sprint reviews Your Qualifications: 4+ years of experience in AI, Data Science, and Machine learning Experience in LLMs, LLM-based APIs, prompting techniques, metric-driven development of prompt-based features, agentic systems, and other related topics Experience in building complex multipart and multistep LLM-based and ML systems Proficiency in Python (including pure Python, and not only jupyter notebooks) Experience in using reproducible research techniques Experience in developing AI solutions for production usage Full professional proficiency in English Standout Qualities: Experience in AI and ML solutions related to one of the areas: social networks, recommendation systems, ranking, entity matching, process mining, system personalization, risk estimation Confident statistical and machine learning skills Experience in creating core AI systems that are foundational to the product and are used in many parts of it Experience in classical software development and architecture Interpersonal skills: Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills required with the ability to work within all levels of an organization. You are proactively pushing yourself to develop your skills and knowledge Decision making and argumentation skills Open to feedback and ready to react on it Ability to work autonomously on a project level Our Work Style: Code: Python, Jupyter, mypy, uv, black, flake8 Data: pandas, SQL, BigQuery GenAI & LLMs: Langchain, Azure OpenAI, Gemini, Vertex AI, Braintrust LLM Platform: Versioned Prompt Registry(jinja2), Declarative LLM Feature Configs (multi-step workflows, model routing) ML: scikit-learn, lightgbm, pytorch Cloud: GCP, Dagster, MLFlow Coding Agents: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor Team Dynamics: As part of Wrike’s AI center of excellence — you will help scale AI feature development across teams by collaborating closely with product, engineering, design, research, and other departments across the organization. You will explore new AI-driven opportunities, validate hypotheses through experimentation, and drive innovations from research prototypes to production-ready capabilities that deliver tangible value to millions of users. Benefits & Perks: 5 Weeks of paid vacation Sick Leave Compensation 5 Paid Uncertified Sick Days 2 weeks fully paid w/ medical certificate, additional 4 weeks paid at 80% salary rate Parental Leave (fully paid): 18 Weeks Maternity / 4 Week Paternity 2 Volunteer Days Meal Vouchers (CZK 220 per working day) Annual Prague Travel Card (Lítačka) Hybrid Working Model Benefit budget with flexible options, including a MultiSport card, Canadian Medical membership, contributions to a pension savings plan and additional choices available through Benefit Plus What’s Next? Introduction Call with a Recruiter Technical interview Cultural interview Your recruitment buddy will be Alexandra Vorobyova , Lead Recruiter. #LI-AV1 Who Is Wrike and Our Culture We’re a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow. Hybrid work mode Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations. While flexibility looks different across teams and regions, employees located near certain hubs — particularly in Prague (CZ), Nicosia (CY), Bangalore (IN), and Rennes (FR) — are generally expected to collaborate in person around 2–3 days per week, balancing the flexibility of distributed work with opportunities for in-person collaboration and connection. Our persona Smart: We love what we do, and we’re great at it because this is our domain. Our combined knowledge in this space is unmatched. Dedicated: We get up every day focused on helping our customers win. We’re committed to helping our teammates win, too! Approachable: We're friendly, easy to get along with, considerate, and helpful. Our culture and Values Customer-Focused We care about our customers. We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision-making and action-taking are done with the customer in mind. Collaborative We work as one and win together, each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Leveraging our own work management platform, we foster an environment of creative collaboration and shared achievement. Creative We strive to succeed through continuous innovation. It’s our pursuit of novel concepts that helped us create a market category. We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions. Committed We believe in ownership at all levels of the organization, by owning workflows from start to finish. Each member of our team is an integral part of this commitment, establishing work as a platform for personal growth and transformation, as well as collective success and growth. Check out our LinkedIn Life Page , Company culture page , Instagram , Wrike Engineering Team , Medium , Meetup.com , Youtube for a feel for what life is like at Wrike. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/wrike-senior-data-scientist

items.description: Design Headquarters: Remote - North America Why AssemblyAI AssemblyAI builds the best-in-class Voice AI models powering the next generation of voice applications. Our models serve 600M+ inference calls monthly, process 1M+ hours of audio daily, and power 2 billion+ end-user experiences. The Voice AI space is at an inflection point; we’re looking for folks truly excited to join a small team and help define the future of the industry. We are one of the most capital-efficient AI companies on the planet - with under 100 people generating roughly $600K ARR per employee, we sit among the top 5 most revenue-dense teams within the fastest-growing AI companies today. That's not an accident; it's a deliberate choice to stay lean, move fast, and give every person on the team outsized ownership and impact. With thousands of customers including Granola, Fireflies, Figure AI, and CallRail, the company has real scale - processing over 2 million hours of audio daily and handling more than 1 million API calls every day. This is a rare growth-stage opportunity where the business is proven and the trajectory is steep, but the team is still small enough that your fingerprints are on everything. If you've ever felt buried under layers of bureaucracy, starved of real ownership, or frustrated watching your work disappear into a slow-moving org, AssemblyAI is built differently. The company operates as a true meritocracy, with no heavy planning or approval processes and no gatekeeping on the tools or information you need. For anyone who genuinely cares about voice AI, not as a trend to chase, but as a technology to build, this is the place where the most interesting problems at the most interesting scale are being solved by a team small enough that you'll actually know everyone's name. We’re committed to creating a space where our employees can bring their full selves to work and have equal opportunity to succeed. No matter your race, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, origin, ability, age, veteran status, if joining this mission speaks to you, we encourage you to apply! About the Role We're hiring our first Senior GTM AI Engineer . This is a software engineering job inside the revenue org. You will build the pipelines, internal tools, and agents that decide which companies we go after, how we reach them, and what our sellers see when they open their laptop in the morning. Most of what a sales ops team used to do by hand is now something you can write software to do. Finding every company building voice AI before they contact us. Researching an account and drafting the first email. Watching product usage and telling an AE when a customer is about to expand or churn. Keeping the CRM clean without anyone filling in forms. You will build those systems, run them in production, and be judged on whether pipeline and revenue move. Your users are our AEs, SDRs, and GTM leaders. Your job is to make a small team perform like one three times its size. What You'll Do Write code every day. Python services, SQL models, scheduled jobs, and small internal apps are most of the job. You'll use Claude Code and similar tools to ship in days what used to take a quarter. Build agents that do the work: account research, lead qualification, outreach drafting, CRM hygiene, and usage monitoring. Design them, give them tools and data, evaluate their output, and keep them running. Turn product usage data in BigQuery and Looker into signals sellers act on: usage alerts, expansion triggers, and account health scores. Build the account targeting machine: sourcing, enrichment, dedupe, and ICP scoring, from raw data to a ranked list in a rep's queue. Integrate the systems the team already uses (our CRM, enrichment providers, outbound tools) so data moves between them without a human in the loop. Keep funnel data trustworthy: routing rules, field governance, and attribution. Prototype fast, measure what works, kill what doesn't, and work directly with Sales and Marketing leadership on what to build next. Document what you build so it keeps running without you. What You'll Need 4+ years as a software engineer, data engineer, or growth/GTM engineer, with time spent shipping systems that other people depend on. Strong Python and SQL. You have owned production automations end to end: APIs, webhooks, scheduled jobs, retries, error handling, and monitoring. Experience building with LLMs beyond a single prompt: multi-step agents, tool use, retrieval, and evaluation. You can tell whether an agent's output is good, and you know when a plain script is the better tool. AI-assisted development is how you work. You use Claude Code or similar tools daily, and you have the engineering judgment to review, test, and stand behind what they produce. Solid fundamentals: clean code, version control, code review, debugging, and a habit of thinking in systems. You do not need an engineering team to ship. Curiosity about how a sales org works. You don't need a RevOps background, but you need to care about how deals get found and closed, and be willing to learn our CRM and the tools around it quickly. A builder's mindset with an operator's judgment: you scope for business impact, ship iteratively, and measure results in pipeline and revenue. Low ego, high ownership, and comfort being the single-threaded owner of an entire domain. Nice to Have Hands-on Salesforce or other CRM work at the object and API level, or experience with enrichment and outbound tools like Clay. dbt, BigQuery, and Looker, or an equivalent warehouse and BI stack. Time at a developer-facing or API-first company, or selling to technical buyers. You've been the first engineer in a sales or growth org and built the function from scratch. items.description: Design Headquarters: Remote US At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most. About the Risk & Analytics Team The Risk & Analytics (R&A) team makes crucial decisions that direct Affirm’s business strategy. We partner with Machine Learning, Product, Engineering, Capital Markets, and Commercial teams to grow Affirm responsibly by optimizing approval, conversion, losses, and profitability. Operating across the entire customer and merchant lifecycle, we tackle a diverse array of challenges, from optimizing checkout conversion and mitigating fraud risk to building scalable data foundations and enabling international growth. We analyze performance not just to report on it, but to determine where to invest resources for maximum impact through building tools, scalable data infrastructure, and analytical frameworks. We improve the analytics experience across Affirm by streamlining workflows and fostering a culture of learning and documentation. By taking ownership of the entire analytical lifecycle, from initial question to final business decision, we turn complex data and systems into clear, actionable signals that ensure Affirm grows efficiently and intelligently. One Role, Multiple Teams We are hiring multiple Analyst I roles across Affirm's Risk & Analytics organization through this single job posting. Rather than interviewing for one specific team, candidates will go through a shared interview process designed to assess the core skills we look for across R&A. If selected, we will work with you to determine the best team match based on your interests, experience, strengths, and current business needs. You will have the opportunity to learn more about our teams and share your preferences as you move through the process. Potential team placements include: Point of Sale (POS): Optimize merchant and checkout performance to improve conversion, approvals, and unit economics across the purchase funnel. Direct to Consumer (DTC) / Card: Drive engagement, repeat usage, and lifecycle health across Affirm's app, web, and card experiences. Fraud: Prevent and reduce fraud losses across the customer journey while maintaining a frictionless user experience. Core Analytics: Build the quantitative research, machine learning models, performance monitoring, and scalable data foundations that enable fast, economically sound decisions. Servicing: Enhance the post-origination customer experience by analyzing repayment behavior, collections strategies, and operational efficiency. International Expansion: Build the measurement and decision foundations needed to sustainably launch and scale Affirm in new global markets. About the Role As an Analyst I in Affirm's Risk & Analytics organization, you will join one of several analytical teams working across the customer and merchant lifecycle. While the specific problems you tackle will depend on your eventual team placement, all Analyst I roles share a common foundation: using data to understand business performance, identify opportunities, and help Affirm make better decisions. You will learn the fundamentals of consumer lending while executing scoped analytical work under the guidance of senior analysts and managers. You will leverage SQL, Python, and modern analytical tools to help optimize business strategies, monitor performance, and turn complex data into actionable insights. You are a thoughtful, driven individual eager to build a strong technical foundation, learn how to navigate exogenous market changes, and integrate modern AI tooling to solve hard problems efficiently. What You Will Do Derive Insights & Support Strategy: Leverage data analytics to uncover insights that help optimize product, risk, or growth strategies across geographies. Monitor Portfolio Health: Assist in tracking performance metrics, user behavior, and macroeconomic trends that impact business outcomes, flagging risks and anomalies to senior team members. Technical Execution: Write clean, working SQL and Python to build scalable reporting and partner with Engineering to support the deployment of machine learning and risk models. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Legal, and Compliance to understand evolving consumer lending regulations and market requirements, assisting in translating them into foundational data models and operational policies. Drive Launch Alignment: Support cross-functional discussions to ensure new product launches and market entries align with our operational capabilities and risk appetite. AI Fluency & Efficiency: Integrate AI tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, and copilots into your daily workflows to accelerate data mining and routine tasks, while carefully verifying outputs. What We Look For 1–3 years of experience in an analytically driven role. Relevant internships or prior experience in consumer lending, fintech, or the broader financial services industry are highly valued. Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, or a related quantitative field. Solid working knowledge of SQL, Python, or other scripting languages. Familiarity with data mining, data visualization, and foundational statistical modeling. Basic understanding of, or deep curiosity about, consumer lending regulations, fair lending principles, and how machine learning techniques apply to real-world business problems. Exceptional communication skills, humility, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional peers. Pay Grade - I Equity Grade - 5 Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range . Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills. Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company). USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $115,000 - $165,000 USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $101,000 - $151,000 #LI-Remote Remote-first with flexibility built in Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience. Benefits designed for you Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights: Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents. Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you. Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to. Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount. We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help. For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law. By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/affirm-analyst

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Netherlands URL: https://www.testgorilla.com/careers ✨ Where do we hire from? Find out if we're hiring in your location from hiring at TestGorilla Hi there, I'm Mehak , interim Head of Marketing at TestGorilla. We’re excited to share more about the Sr. Demand Generation Manager role and our team. About the role As our Sr. Demand Generation Manager , you'll be essential in achieving TestGorilla's vision of helping one billion people land their dream job. You'll own our largest acquisition lever, a multi-six-figure monthly Google Ads investment, along with the lifecycle, enrichment, and website systems that turn that spend into revenue. This isn't just a role, it's your chance to make a real difference by proving, with data, that every dollar of spend becomes pipeline. You'll directly contribute to sustainable, cost-efficient growth as TestGorilla scales. Responsibilities In this role, your responsibilities will include but not limited to: Upholding TestGorilla's behaviors and fostering an inclusive, supportive culture. Owning the demand generation number across paid and organic channels, including managing and scaling paid spend across Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, Display, YouTube) and adjacent channels, while testing and developing emerging acquisition opportunities such as advertising on ChatGPT and other AI-native platforms. Setting the channel mix, budget allocation, and account structure required to hit MQL, SQO, and pipeline targets. Building and owning source-of-truth reporting across paid and organic funnel performance, including SQL, dashboards, attribution modeling, and incrementality testing, so channel investment decisions are backed by evidence rather than platform screenshots. Owning the roadmap for paid landing pages, ad creative, and offers, and running rapid A/B tests to lift conversion with proper statistical rigor. Designing and owning automated nurture workflows and enrichment infrastructure (n8n, Make, HubSpot, Clay) so paid-sourced leads convert, and feeding that data back into targeting and ICP decisions. Partnering with Sales and RevOps on lead quality and conversion by campaign, and presenting performance and recommendations to marketing and GTM leadership in clear, business-first language. Staying ahead of advertising platform, AI ecosystem, and privacy changes, and turning successful tests into repeatable, automated systems rather than one-off wins. What you’ll bring We're looking for someone who: Is passionate about TestGorilla's mission to help one billion people find their dream jobs. Has excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Thrives in a fast-paced, async-first, remote-only environment. Has proven experience in performance or growth marketing, including hands-on ownership of a Google Ads budget of at least six figures per month (B2B SaaS strongly preferred), and a track record of scaling spend while holding or improving CAC and ROAS. We typically expect 7+ years of experience in performance or growth marketing to have developed the core skills necessary for this position. But it may be more or less than that, according to your career journey so far. Has deep expertise across the Google Ads stack, including Search, Performance Max, Display, YouTube, Smart Bidding, conversion tracking, and Google Tag Manager. Working knowledge and hands-on expertise of Clay, HubSpot (or a comparable CRM) and GA suite. Has a solid grasp of funnel and unit economics (CAC, LTV:CAC, ROAS, payback period, cohort analysis) and comfort with experimentation design, including significance, sample sizing, and reading results honestly. Has hands-on experience using AI/LLM tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) to build real growth workflows, from lead scoring to automation logic, not just surface-level use. Has an ownership mentality: treats this budget like their own P&L, ships the workflow, dashboard, and test themselves, and is comfortable with ambiguity and fast iteration as pipeline needs shift. We seek diversity and encourage applications from everyone. Studies show that women and underrepresented groups can be hesitant to apply unless they meet every requirement. If you're interested in this role but your experience doesn't perfectly match the description, please still apply. Bonus skills While these skills aren’t a requirement, we’d be very interested to hear from you if you have: Experience managing an agency or freelancers alongside in-house execution. Exposure to PLG or hybrid PLG/sales-led GTM. Experience presenting to VP/C-level stakeholders on performance and budget. Experience owning SEO or content-led demand generation programs alongside paid channels. Has strong working SQL, fluency in GA4 and at least one BI tool What’s in it for you? Please note: Some specifics, particularly around leave, may vary depending on your country of residence. This will be discussed during the hiring process. Global Team: Join a fully remote, mission-driven team from around the world Competitive compensation: Receive a competitive pay (€65,650-€84,500 per annum) + Share Appreciation Rights (SARs) Remote & flexible work: Work from almost anywhere*. Enjoy flexible hours and asynchronous work to balance work and life. * Check out the countries we currently hire from here Remote work budget: €1,000 available each year or up to €2,000 from day 1 if you're buying a laptop! Growth & development: Invest in yourself and your career with a 3.5% L&D budget per year and clear growth opportunities Parent/Caregiver support: We provide a caregiver-friendly work environment with paid 8-16 week parental leave and tailored return-to-work approaches Work-life balance: Our unlimited and flexible time off policy empowers you to take the time you need to recharge and maintain your well-being Interested? At TestGorilla, we believe your skills speak louder than your resume. That's why we champion a skills-first approach, using cutting-edge, AI-powered assessments to uncover your true potential. Forget traditional biases; we're building the world's largest skills-tested talent pool, making hiring fairer, faster, and smarter for everyone! When you apply, you'll get to experience our platform firsthand by taking an assessment – it's your chance to shine and show us what you can do! While our platform is powered by AI, every hiring decision is made by humans, ensuring a truly unbiased and thoughtful process. Check out our Applicant Privacy document to see how we protect your data. We're passionate about building diverse teams where every voice is heard. We genuinely welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences. Concerned about test anxiety? We've got you covered. Accommodations are readily available as part of the assessment setup, and requesting support will never impact your application. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/testgorilla-senior-demand-generation-manager

In this role, the Consultant will partner with Project Managers, Operations, and Clinical teams to turn real operational challenges into effective, user-friendly tools built on Microsoft 365, Power Platform, and large language models. Note that compliance, pharmacovigilance, DPIA, and patient data handling fall outside the scope of this role — those responsibilities sit entirely with the client's internal teams. What You'll Be Doing The Consultant will own the end-to-end delivery of focused, high-value MVPs and automations across 2–3-week sprints, with structured demos and knowledge transfer at each cycle. The engagement will span across 6-8 weeks, and full-time work may be available after this period. Work will span: Building a Trust Engagement Database leveraging tools such as Notion, SharePoint, or equivalent platforms. Developing Power Automate workflows and Copilot Agent assets — covering prompt libraries, lightweight agent frameworks, automated SLA reminders, email and Teams-based triggers, tracking dashboards, and recurring or on-demand reporting. Prototyping LLM-assisted Adverse Event (AE) triage workflows (non-PHI), encompassing classification and summarization logic, intelligent routing, and retrieval from approved content sources. Wrapping up solutions as reusable, well-documented components: data models, deployment runbooks, and step-by-step how-to guides. Working hand-in-hand with Project Managers and Operations to make sure every solution lands well and can scale. Contributing to the client's AI-driven Digital Transformation initiatives. What We're Looking For Proven track record delivering production-ready automations within the Microsoft 365 ecosystem (SharePoint, Teams, Power Automate, Power BI). Hands-on experience working with LLM-based tools, prompts, or agent frameworks (Azure OpenAI, Copilot, Claude, or similar). Strong command of data modeling using Notion, Excel, CSV, and Microsoft Graph. History of shipping MVPs on tight, sprint-based timelines. Comfortable working in a contract/consultancy capacity. You must be available for 6 to 8 weeks of work, with the potential of staying on as a full-time staff member afterward. Background in pharma or healthcare — particularly familiarity with industry terminology — is a significant plus. Nice to Have Experience integrating HubSpot or Microsoft Graph into existing workflows. Knowledge of evaluation frameworks for classification and summarization tasks. A portfolio of reusable internal tooling built for external clients. Working Style & Values Able to navigate non-PHI environments confidently and responsibly. Highly organized with a sharp ability to prioritize under pressure. Thrives in dynamic, fast-moving settings. Our client is a values-driven organization in the healthcare space, guided by the principles of caring, candor, and high performance. They are seeking someone who welcomes feedback, adapts their approach based on team input, and brings both conviction and humility to collaborative problem-solving. if this sounds right for you, use the form below to apply! items.title: Service contract for endline population-based representative survey on menstrual
items.summary: I. GENERAL FRAMEWORK OF REFERENCE 1. 1 BackgroundFòs Feminista is an intersectional feminist organization centred around the sexual and reproductive rights and needs of women, girls, and gender-diverse people.
items.description: I. GENERAL FRAMEWORK OF REFERENCE 1.1 Background Fòs Feminista is an intersectional feminist organization centred around the sexual and reproductive rights and needs of women, girls, and gender-diverse people. Led and governed by the Global South, Fòs Feminista works as an alliance of organizations in 40+ countries worldwide to advance sexual and reproductive health, rights, and justice. Fòs Feminista is both the connective tissue that links these diverse partners in an alliance and an active participant in the broader ecosystem of actors working on sexual and reproductive health, rights, and justice (SRHRJ). Fòs Feminista orchestrates transnational and transregional action by connecting partners throughout the SRHRJ ecosystem, amplifying innovative partner-led solutions to SRHRJ issues, and catalysing funding and political will for an intersectional feminist agenda on SRHRJ. We recognize that the ability of women, girls, and gender-diverse people to make free and informed choices about their sexual and reproductive lives, including to access safe and legal abortion, is central to their life plans and to achieving gender and reproductive justice. Together with partners in the Alliance, we provide access to sexual and reproductive health care and services, including contraception, abortion, and care for victims of gender-based violence, and we reach young people with comprehensive sexuality education. We are at the forefront of advocating for sexual and reproductive health, rights, and justice from an intersectional lens in national, regional, and global spaces, coordinating with our partners to ensure that diverse experiences, priorities, and voices of the Global South are represented in these spaces. We also strengthen intersectional feminist movements and organizations by creating and holding space for partners to participate in an international community built on feminist values of sharing power, diversity, mutual learning, and solidarity and to access resources to strengthen their work. Fòs Feminista is leading the Sang pour Sang consortium project to challenge the structural drivers of menstrual discrimination in nine countries in Sub-Saharan Africa, Asia, and the Caribbean so that women, girls, and gender-diverse individuals have the information, services, products, infrastructure, and supporting environment to exercise their right to menstruate with dignity. Sang pour Sang is a consortium project of four international organisations. The project is funded by AFD (Agence Française de Développement) and has a duration of three years. II. SCOPE OF WORK 2.1 Objective & Role of the Consultancy The main objective of this consultancy is to design, conduct, and analyse the results of an endline population-based representative survey to measure changes from baseline in the structural factors of menstrual discrimination experienced by menstruators in the nine Sang pour Sang project countries: Benin, Cameroon, Côte d'Ivoire, Dominican Republic, Guinea, Haiti, Nigeria, Pakistan, and the Philippines. The endline population-based survey will replicate the baseline survey of menstruators methodology as closely as possible to ensure comparability of results over time, including consistency in the sampling approach, survey instrument, indicator definitions and calculations, data collection procedures, and analytical methods. Any necessary methodological changes will be agreed upon with Fòs Feminista , documented, and assessed during a pilot phase to assess their potential implications for comparability. The consultant will ensure a representative sample of the target population of menstruators in each country that is comparable to the baseline sample. In addition, the consultant will include a targeted sample of approximately 450 systematically excluded menstruators, approximately 50 per country, using selection criteria and survey approaches consistent with the baseline to ensure inclusivity. To maximize comparability with the baseline population-based survey of menstruators, the consultant will use the same or similar local survey partners and fieldwork networks where feasible. This will support the consultant in maintaining survey implementation procedures that are as consistent as possible with the baseline population-based survey. Required Endline Indicators The primary outcome of interest for the endline population-based survey is the prevalence of menstrual discrimination among menstruators. This outcome will be measured as the percentage of surveyed menstruators who report experiencing at least one restriction on regular activities during their last menstrual period and/or being teased about their menstrual period in the previous six months. The endline survey must also measure a set of key secondary outcomes aligned with core components of the Sang pour Sang project’s logical framework. The following indicators are required to measure the priority primary and secondary outcomes: Primary Outcome Indicator: Domain: Menstrual Health and Dignity Impacts % of menstruators who report menstrual discrimination % of menstruators whose participation in regular daily activities was restricted by their last period Factors that facilitated or prevented participation in regular activities during menstruation % of menstruators who experienced teasing related to menstruation in the last six months % who experienced teasing from men and boys Key Secondary Outcome Indicators: Domain: Knowledge and Awareness: % of menstruators who are aware of more than 1 type of menstrual product Domain: Product Use and Preference % of menstruators using purposely-made menstrual products from local social and solidarity enterprises (SSEs) Domain: Access to Menstrual Products % of menstruators who report that their preferred menstrual product is available and affordable $US in monthly cost per menstruator using menstrual products The endline survey must also measure the following supplementary indicators on important project domains and compare results against baseline: Domain: Knowledge and Awareness: % of menstruators with correct knowledge of the fertile period during the ovulatory cycle % of menstruators who know how often to change menstrual products % of individuals with knowledge of menopause Domain: Menstrual Attitudes % of menstruators who believe menstruation is dirty or impure % of menstruators who think menstruation should be discussed openly with everyone % of menstruators who believe that women are inferior to men because they menstruate % of menstruators who feel proud to menstruate Domain: Supportive Environment and Behaviors % of menstruators who believe that others in their community think that menstruation is dirty or impure % of menstruators who feel confident that they have the skills to manage their menstruation % of menstruators who would feel comfortable seeking help for menstrual problems from a health-care provider % of menstruators who report that they were able to reduce their menstrual (abdominal/back/cramping) pain when they needed to during their last menstrual period. % of menstruators who have someone they feel comfortable asking for support (advice, resources, emotional support) regarding menstruation Domain: WASH % of menstruators who had a space that was clean, private, and where they feel safe to change their menstrual materials during their last menstrual period % of menstruators who have consistent access to water for washing during menstruation % of menstruators who have hygienic options for disposal of used menstrual products Domain: Access to Menstrual Products % of menstruators who experienced barriers in having their need for menstrual products/materials met % of menstruators that used menstrual products during their last period, by type % of menstruators who are satisfied with factor All results must be disaggregated by country and age group, along with other factors relevant to the local context. An intersectional feminist lens is expected to be applied to all processes and deliverables. 2.2 Consultancy Deliverables In collaboration with the project consortium members, particularly the Business Intelligence, Evaluation & Research Cluster of Fòs Feminista , the contracted consultant will complete the following deliverables: - Inception report. The consultant will submit a brief inception report by December 15, 2026, outlining the proposed methodology for the endline survey, including the sampling strategy (with confirmation that replicating the baseline sample size provides adequate statistical power to detect meaningful change in the primary outcome, including at the country level), data collection approach, baseline-endline statistical comparison plan (including the approach to weighting and significance testing), and intersectional feminist analysis. The report will also include a work plan specifying key activities, timelines, and level of effort. The inception report will be subject to review and approval by Fòs Feminista . - Institutional Review Board (IRB) approval. Prior to the start of any data collection, the consultant must develop ethics procedures to protect respondents and obtain all required ethical approvals for the research. Documentation of IRB approval will be submitted to Fòs Feminista before December 31, 2026. - Documentation of methodological adjustments, pilot results, and finalized survey instruments. The consultant will document any proposed changes from the baseline methodology, including the rationale for each change and its potential implications for baseline-endline comparability. Proposed adjustments to the survey methods and instruments will be pretested with key informants and then pilot tested with a separate sample of menstruators in selected project countries to assess validity, appropriateness, and consistency with baseline measures. The deliverable will summarize the pilot methodology and findings, document any resulting revisions, and include the finalized survey instruments. This deliverable will be submitted by March 31, 2027. - Cleaned datasets and indicator calculations. By June 30, 2027, the consultant will submit complete, cleaned, deidentified, translated, and merged respondent-level datasets covering all nine countries, with all data provided in English. In addition to these respondent-level datasets, the consultant will provide the calculated result for each survey indicator, both overall and by country, based on the underlying respondent data. A codebook and calculation guide will document all indicator definitions, formulas, numerators, denominators, weighting procedures, derived variables, and the specific respondent-level variables used to calculate each indicator, together with any other information needed to reproduce each reported result. - Baseline-endline comparative findings report. By July 31, 2027, the consultant will submit one finalized report containing comparative analysis between endline and baseline data on respondents and the survey indicators. The report should describe the methodology and any limitations affecting comparability; assess the demographics of the surveyed menstruators at endline and how they compare to baseline; present changes in key indicators overall and by relevant subgroups; and include an intersectional feminist analysis of differences in findings across populations experiencing overlapping forms of discrimination and exclusion. This report should focus on providing an overall analysis of findings across all nine survey countries, followed by a brief analysis of main findings by country. All deliverables will be reviewed by Fòs Feminista and, as appropriate, relevant consortium partners. Deliverables should consistently apply an intersectional feminist lens and examine differences for people situated at the intersection of discriminatory power structures. Any translation or back translations needed to produce deliverables in English will be conducted by the consultant and their local networks. 2.3 Consultant Profile The ideal consultant has: Prior involvement in the design and implementation of the baseline population-based representative survey, with demonstrated capacity to replicate its methodology, instruments, sampling approach, and field procedures to ensure comparability between baseline and endline results. Fluent verbal and written communication skills in both English and French, with demonstrated ability to test and administer surveys in the local languages of Benin, Cameroon, Côte d'Ivoire, Dominican Republic, Guinea, Haiti, Nigeria, Pakistan, and the Philippines. Specialized expertise in population-based representative survey development, testing, and administration in the Global South, with a preference for survey experience in the 9 countries of the project. Extensive background in designing and implementing rigorous assessments of sexual and reproductive health, rights, and justice, with the expertise to assess menstrual discrimination with an intersectional feminist lens. Demonstrated ability to incorporate ethical considerations and protections, as well as local adaptations of deliverables for each country. Strong knowledge of the sexual and reproductive health, rights, and justice landscape in Sub-Saharan Africa, Asia, and the Caribbean, with a particular focus on menstrual health and dignity. Ability to collaborate effectively in multicultural settings across multiple time zones and using remote digital formats. Ability to adapt to challenges and opportunities as they arise. Familiarity with Agence Française de Développement requirements or reporting is a plus. III. INSTITUTIONAL ARRANGEMENT 3.1 Project Duration All deliverables related to the endline survey shall be completed by July 31, 2027. 3.2 Work Location This consultancy will be conducted remotely, with the ability to apply the representative survey in Benin, Cameroon, Côte d'Ivoire, Dominican Republic, Guinea, Haiti, Nigeria, Pakistan, and the Philippines. The contracted consultant must be willing to adjust to different time zones. 3.3 Reporting The consultancy will report to Fòs Feminista 's Business Intelligence, Evaluation, and Research Unit. IV. APPLICATION PROCESS For consideration, please submit a résumé or portfolio that demonstrates expertise in representative survey development, implementation, and analysis, as well as a proposal for the consultancy. The proposal must include the proposed methodology and approach, anticipated level of effort and timelines for deliverables, and a financial offer in US dollars, which includes rates plus all taxes and liens that this type of consultancy requires. All application materials shall be submitted in English. We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only those candidates selected for interviews will be contacted. V. SAFEGUARDING COMMITMENTS Fòs Feminista is committed to ensuring that the health, rights, and wellbeing of all children, young people, and vulnerable populations who work and engage with Fòs Feminista 's Team Members and Associated Persons are respected and protected in their interactions with them, so it requires all its Team Members and Associated Persons to share this commitment. The successful consultant must: Sign and adhere to Fòs Feminista 's International Safeguarding Policy and Safeguarding Code of Conduct, including the minimum operating standards for protection from sexual exploitation and abuse (PSEA). VI. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER STATEMENT Fòs Feminista provides equal opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to age, race, color, disability, national origin, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital and partnership status, genetic information, veteran status, or any other protected category under federal, state, and local law. items.description: Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com . Reddit’s Ads Data Science team is looking for a highly experienced Staff Data Scientist to advance the intelligence powering the advertiser experience on Reddit. In this role, you'll take deep ownership of a high-impact problem space within advertising, specializing in measurement, identity, and signal quality. This is a high-impact, high-autonomy role where you'll influence strategic direction, set a high technical bar, and drive cross-functional initiatives across one or more critical focus areas in the Ads organization. Responsibilities: Design the Future of Ads Identity: Develop/employ probabilistic models for identity resolution. Design the methodology that links on-platform and off-platform actions to maximize addressability while honoring privacy. Advance Lift Methodologies & Experimentation: Own the statistical rigor behind Reddit’s Brand and Conversion Lift products. Innovate experimental design and develop infrastructure that supports large-scale, high-velocity, low-bias testing for advertisers. Maximize Signal for Predictive Performance: Define the strategy for new signal sources. You will mathematically quantify the value of these signals and work with modeling teams to incorporate them into predictive models, directly improving bidding efficiency and ROAS. Define Ground Truth & Evaluation Frameworks: Solve the industry-wide challenge of validating identity and measurement. Design the objective functions and truth sets used to train our models and measure the incremental impact of our identity graph. Lead Through Cross-Functional and Technical Influence: Collaborate deeply with engineering, product, and sales to align on strategic goals, translate insights into action, and drive execution. Set a high technical bar by mentoring others and championing best practices across modeling, experimentation, and measurement. Qualifications: Required: Advanced degree (Master's or Ph.D.) in Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, Economics, or Operations Research For M.S. holders: 10+ years of industry experience in applied science or data science roles For Ph.D. holders: 6+ years of industry experience in applied science or data science roles Deep understanding of the ads ecosystem Demonstrated expertise in at least one of the following areas: Measurement & Experimentation at Scale (with focus on lift and attribution) Identity Graph Creation & Resolution Methodology and Infrastructure Predictive Modeling with Signal Loss Advanced proficiency in statistical programming (Python or R) and SQL. Experience with machine learning or optimization techniques Strong understanding of experimental design, causal inference, or A/B testing methodologies Exceptional problem-solving and communication skills, with a track record of influencing product and engineering partners Experience working in fast-paced, ambiguous environments with cross-functional teams Benefits: Comprehensive Healthcare Benefits and Income Replacement Programs 401k with Employer Match Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support Family Planning Support Gender-Affirming Care Mental Health & Coaching Benefits Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off Generous Paid Parental Leave #LI-Remote In select roles and locations, the interviews will be recorded, transcribed and summarized by artificial intelligence (AI). items.description: Company Overview Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram. Company Operating Rhythm At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance. Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do. Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5. The Opportunity Deepgram is looking for a Software Test Engineer to design, build, and maintain automated test frameworks and exploratory test suites across our products, models, APIs, and data platforms. You enjoy breaking systems, probing edge cases, testing real-world and adversarial inputs, and automating repeatable validation so regressions are caught quickly. You translate product requirements and model metrics into automated regression tests, evaluation pipelines, data-quality gates, load tests, and release criteria. You partner with QA, Research, Product, Data, and Engineering to plan testing, execute human and automated evaluations, support user acceptance testing, and communicate risks clearly. When you find an issue, you provide precise reproduction steps, inputs, parameters, expected and actual results, and supporting data. What gets you excited? Building scalable automation that gives Deepgram confidence that its products, models, and data workflows work reliably for customers. What You'll Do Define and execute well-designed test plans across Deepgram's products, APIs, SDKs, model-powered features, and data platforms, ensuring production software is robust, reliable, and performs well. Design, build, and maintain automated test suites and frameworks for functional, integration, end-to-end, regression, API, browser, and service-level testing across batch and streaming workflows. Translate product requirements and customer acceptance criteria into clear test strategies, repeatable test cases, and enforceable release gates. Build and maintain representative, customer-focused, and adversarial test datasets, fixtures, and test environments that exercise real-world inputs, edge cases, failure modes, and system limits. Validate model-powered behavior—including speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and other AI features—using appropriate metrics, expected outputs, human review, and regression coverage, while partnering with Research and model-evaluation specialists as needed. Build testing infrastructure, including test harnesses, reusable scripts, test-data tooling, result-aggregation pipelines, dashboards, and visualizations that make quality signals easy to understand and act on. Integrate automated tests, quality checks, canaries, and release validation into CI/CD so regressions are detected continuously rather than through manual testing alone. Partner with Engineering, Product, Research, Data, Infrastructure, and DevOps to understand system behavior, dependencies, variations, performance limits, and deployment risks, and to establish appropriate test coverage. Test data ingestion, processing, annotation, and quality-control workflows, validating data integrity, completeness, representativeness, deduplication, leakage, and downstream readiness. Execute staging and production validation, load and reliability testing, cross-browser and customer-workflow testing, and user acceptance testing in partnership with internal stakeholders and customer QA teams. Maintain and improve the test-case repository, automation coverage, test documentation, and release-readiness reporting so teams have a clear view of what was tested, what passed, and what remains risky. Write precise, actionable bug reports with reproducible steps, inputs, parameters, expected and actual results, logs or artifacts, and clear severity; participate in triage and escalate issues when necessary. Help raise the bar through code reviews, test-design reviews, technical discussions, and strong engineering, automation, and QA practices. What We're Looking For BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, AI, Applied Math, or a related field, or equivalent experience. 5+ years of professional software or QA engineering experience, with a track record of shipping test infrastructure or evaluation systems (senior candidates with significantly deeper experience welcome). Solid backend/scripting experience in a language such as Python, Rust, Go, or similar. Experience designing and building automated test pipelines, evaluation frameworks, or data-processing systems. Strong analytical skills and comfort reasoning about metrics, thresholds, and statistical variation in results — able to distinguish real regressions from noise. Ability to take charge of ambiguous technical challenges and communicate effectively across research, engineering, and product teams. Nice to Have / Ways to Stand Out Hands-on experience testing or evaluating modern AI systems such as LLMs, RAG pipelines, agents, or multimodal models, including analyzing model behavior and failure modes. Experience with voice, audio, speech recognition, or real-time systems, and familiarity with metrics such as WER, MOS, latency, and time-to-first-byte. Experience building or improving test, evaluation, benchmarking, or ML infrastructure used by multiple teams or external users. A strong appreciation for test and evaluation quality, including correctness, reproducibility, determinism, and consistency across environments. Experience building test tooling for React Native, mobile applications, or other cross-platform environments that extends validation beyond the desktop. Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, containers, ephemeral test environments, CI/CD systems, and monitoring tools such as Grafana, canaries, and anomaly detection. Experience serving as a technical bridge across teams or platforms—including product, QA, evaluation, training, inference, data, or agent frameworks—with the communication skills to build alignment and influence decisions. Prior involvement in open-source projects through contributions, reviews, maintenance, or community engagement. Experience with voice, audio, speech recognition, or real-time systems, and familiarity with metrics like WER, MOS, or latency/TTFB. Prior involvement in open-source projects, through contributions, reviews, maintenance, or community engagement. Experience acting as a technical bridge across teams or platforms (evaluation, training, inference, agent frameworks), combining architectural understanding with clear communication and influence. Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, containerized/ephemeral environments, and monitoring tooling (e.g. Grafana, canaries, anomaly detection). Notice : We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @ deepgram.com email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to careers@deepgram.com.
