items.title: Staff GTM Analyst (USA Only, 100% Remote)
items.summary: This job description was written by a person About Us Since 2013, we’ve been building a CRM that gets out of your way and helps your team sell more, faster. Now we’re building AI into every part of it, so Close does the busywork and your team does the selling. No manual data entry,…
items.description: This job description was written by a person About Us Since 2013, we’ve been building a CRM that gets out of your way and helps your team sell more, faster. Now we’re building AI into every part of it, so Close does the busywork and your team does the selling. No manual data entry, no 10-click workflows. Just communication-first, AI-powered sales software designed to help you succeed and scale. We're bootstrapped and profitable which means we answer to our customers and play by our rules. We're proud of our 120-person, 100% remote team, focused on building Close so that no small, scaling business fails because it can't figure out sales. About the Role Our GTM org has a lot of questions. Most of the questions we care about can’t be answered by spinning up a cute dashboard. Is branded search creating new customers or capturing demand that already existed? Did the homepage redesign improve conversion, or did our traffic mix change? If we’ve got some wild ideas for our next bet, where should the money go? These kinds of big-picture questions require someone who can interrogate the metric, trace it through the warehouse, understand the business context, and turn it into action. This person will be our first Staff GTM Analyst. You’ll work alongside GTM leadership to make consequential decisions while still staying hands-on in the nitty gritty of all the data. The best part: the way we answer these questions is changing. Effective SQL is just a few tokens away, dashboards can be Claude-ed in minutes, and teammates increasingly expect to find their own answers. You’ll build the semantic layers, context, and guardrails that make self-service possible, even trustworthy, then determine where an analyst’s expertise is indispensable. You are An experienced analyst. You have roughly 8 years of hands-on, highly technical analytics experience. Most importantly: you’re backed by the pattern recognition that comes with having seen all sorts of hairy problems. You’re at the point in your career where you can take an ambiguous business question, dive head-first into the data, turn your findings into a decision, and bring everyone else along with you. A bridge between the technical and the business. You can build a model in dbt, work directly in Snowflake, and translate it into something actionable. You’ll partner closely with our Lead Analytics Engineer but you need to be willing and able to dive in and self-serve. Fluent in the quirks of GTM data. Attribution, channel definitions, UTMs, bots and broken tracking are known quantities. You don’t need to have been a dedicated GTM Analyst, but you should certainly know your way around this part of the business. Pushing the boundary of what AI means for analytics. AI is writing your first-draft SQL, analysis, and reporting and you’ve shifted that energy to bringing analysis into the future: building the semantic layers, context, and guardrails that let the team self-serve trustworthy answers. A trusted cross-functional leader. Teammates across functions and levels listen to you. You immerse yourself in the context of their needs and bridge gaps in understanding. Fiercely independent and accountable. You welcome a vague ask with aplomb. You’ll scope the problem, find the dependencies, bring in the right people, and drive the work through the analysis, recommendation…all the way to a fix. More concerned with impact than output. A polished dashboard is useful only when it changes what we do. You prioritize the questions that can materially improve acquisition, conversion, retention, and revenue. You will Make our GTM data trustworthy. You’ll define metrics, model the funnel from first touch through paid conversion, and reconcile discrepancies across Snowflake, Segment, Amplitude, GA4, and our ad platforms. Explain what we’re seeing. Why are trials up while paid conversion isn’t? Why are Snowflake and Amplitude disagreeing? Which channel is driving volume but producing low-quality customers? You’ll dig into the data until we understand what changed and why. Help decide what to do next. Are we on track to hit our goals? What would another investment in paid media produce? You’ll forecast, model the tradeoffs, and empower leadership to make the best possible decision. Own the outcome. Whether you uncover something small like broken campaign tracking or you’re focused on moving a major business metric, you’ll bring in the right people and shepherd the team to the data-driven outcome. Define the next era of Data at Close. You’ll help us move from a queue of reactive requests to a system where an agent spots changes, assembles the context, and gets the right insight to the right person at the right time. Benefits Compensation: Competitive pay plus an organization-wide goal-based bonus Paid Time Off: ~5 weeks of PTO to start. Plus a 1-week all-company Winter Holiday Break and paid US holidays. You'll earn 2 extra days for every year you're with Close. 80% Work Option: Work with your manager to choose between a standard 5-day week or a 4-day week at 80% pay Parental Leave: Paid leave for primary and secondary caregivers Sabbatical: A 1-month paid sabbatical every 5 years with the team Healthcare (US residents): Two medical plans with Close covering 99% of your premium, plus Dental, Vision, HSA, FSA, and company-paid Long-Term Disability 401k (US residents): We match your contributions up to 6%, vested immediately Our Values Build a house you want to live in - Examine long-term thinking and action No BS - Practice transparency and honesty, especially when it’s hard Invest in each other - Build successful relationships with your coworkers and customers Discipline equals freedom - Keep your word to yourself and others Strive for greatness - Constantly challenge yourself and others Learn More Listen to our CEO and Founder, Steli Efti, tell the story of Close’s journey in the $0-30m Blueprint . Watch our culture video from our 2023 team retreat in Milan. Every year our entire team gathers in person to build connection, foster cross-functional collaboration, and have fun. In 2027, we're headed to Dusseldorf, Germany! Explore our product. Check out a demo ! Our Hiring Process We ask a few role-specific questions as part of our application process. These questions are designed to help us learn more about you from the start, so please answer each one thoughtfully. We see this as an opportunity to get to know you beyond your resume. We use AI tools daily at Close and expect candidates to do the same. In evaluating your application, we aim to get a sense for you - the way you think, how you communicate, the work you've done. Applications that read as fully AI-generated will not be considered. Regardless of fit, you can expect to hear back from our team with an update on the status of your candidacy. If you progress to the interview process, you'll receive a full outline of the role-specific steps in your first touchpoint with us. We do our best to make the hiring process clear and human.

items.summary: Why Mozilla? Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we're shaping the next 25 years of technology…
items.description: Why Mozilla ? Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we're shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we're doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren't beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. About this team and role: Mozilla Finance is responsible for strategic resource allocation, overseeing day-to-day financial operations as we scale our mission impact with new and existing products, technology, and business models. Core Services brings together the functions Mozilla runs on: Legal, People, Data Science, Trust & Safety / Customer Experience, Strategy, IT, Cloud Engineering & Ecosystems, and Security - teams supporting every part of the Company. We are seeking a detail-driven Senior Financial Analyst, Core Services to execute the recurring planning, reporting, and analysis that supports this portfolio. This role will be responsible for preparing the forecast, reconciling actuals through close, maintaining headcount and vendor tracking, and producing the reporting that reaches budget owners and the COO. This role reports to the Finance Manager, Core Services, who leads business partnership with the functional leaders, and works closely with teams across the organization. To succeed, you will need to work accurately across a broad portfolio, translate variances into explanations a non-finance audience can act on, and balance competing cycle deadlines with outstanding attention to detail. This position requires a resourceful self-starter who takes recurring processes from start to finish and improves them along the way. What you'll do: Prepare the Core Services forecast each cycle. Build and load cost center detail in Pigment, validate inputs, reconcile against the prior cycle, and document what moved along with the drivers behind it. Assemble the monthly budget update. Prepare variance to plan, drivers, and open items for budget owners and the COO, ready for the Finance Manager to carry into leader conversations. Partner with Accounting through monthly close. Tie out actuals, accruals, and forecast, and resolve coding and timing issues at the source rather than correcting for them downstream. Maintain headcount tracking. Keep position-level tracking and the headcount-to-plan bridge current, coordinating with People and hiring managers on start dates and backfill assumptions. Track vendor and cloud spend. Monitor POs, commitments, renewals, and run-rate changes across the group. Take in cloud cost information prepared by the Cloud Engineering team, carry it into Core Services and consolidated Company reporting, and review it for anomalies and initial questions. Apply AI and automation to recurring work. Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort across the forecast, close, and reporting cycle, improving the speed and reliability of what the team produces. Experiment with tools and share what works. Support Core Services teams day to day. Field data and reporting questions directly, escalating items that call for a partnership discussion. What you'll bring: Core Experience 5+ years of work experience in business unit FP&A, corporate FP&A, strategic finance, or a comparable analytical finance role, including hands-on work through a full budget and forecast cycle with close and variance analysis. Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or another quantitative field, or equivalent experience. Technical Skills Advanced spreadsheet and financial modeling skills. You care about formula cleanliness, auditability, and accuracy. Experience with enterprise planning tools (Pigment, Adaptive, Workday, etc.) and accounting systems (NetSuite preferred). Grounding in accounting fundamentals, including accruals and the monthly close cycle. Enough familiarity with cloud cost or FinOps concepts to interpret reporting prepared by a technical team and question what looks off. Interest in applying AI, automation, and systems thinking to reduce manual effort in recurring finance work. Ability to balance multiple competing priorities and cycle deadlines without loss of accuracy. Communication & Collaboration Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain a variance concisely to a non-finance audience. Ability to work across functions, distilling detail into structured summaries that leaders can act on. Positive attitude, intellectual curiosity, and ability to learn quickly. Nice to have: Experience supporting technical or G&A functions in a shared-services finance environment, where the internal team is the customer. Experience building automations or AI-assisted workflows within a Finance context — or the drive and resourcefulness to learn. Experience with BI tools, SQL, Python, Power Query, or other data querying and programming languages. Success Factors You will likely be happy and productive in this role if you… Possess an ownership mentality. You get things done accurately with minimal oversight, proactively flagging risks to timelines. Have low ego and high flexibility. You approach problems with your opinion on the best solution, but can accommodate and adjust to differing viewpoints. Are resourceful. You identify alternative solutions and resources to continue progress. Are looking to build depth across a complex portfolio before moving into a lead partnership seat. What you'll get: Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute) Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday One-time home office stipend Annual professional development budget Quarterly wellbeing stipend Considerable paid parental leave Employee referral bonus program Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country) About Mozilla Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online. Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions. We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us at hiringaccommodation@mozilla.com to request accommodation. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race (including hairstyle and texture), religion (including religious grooming and dress practices), gender, gender identity, gender expression, color, national origin, pregnancy, ancestry, domestic partner status, disability, sexual orientation, age, genetic predisposition, medical condition, marital status, citizenship status, military or veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable laws. Mozilla will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics or any other unlawful behavior, conduct, or purpose. Group: D #LI-REMOTE Req ID: R3237 Hiring Ranges: US Tier 1 Locations $102,000—$136,000 USD US Tier 2 Locations $94,000—$125,000 USD US Tier 3 Locations $87,000—$116,000 USD

Great owners are great partners. Drive Impact, Urgently: We measure impact, not effort. Compensation & Perks: For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth. items.title: Category Manager (f/m/x) - remote
items.summary: Founded in 2017, refurbed is Europe’s fastest-growing marketplace for refurbished products, active in 23 European countries and having surpassed €2Bn in GMV — all while being profitable.
items.description: Founded in 2017, refurbed is Europe’s fastest-growing marketplace for refurbished products, active in 23 European countries and having surpassed €2Bn in GMV — all while being profitable. With beautiful headquarters in Vienna, we operate as a remote-first company and have been recognised as a Top DACH Employer by Kununu for four consecutive years. Our mission is to make sustainable consumption the easy choice by enabling customers to buy products up to 40% cheaper while significantly reducing CO₂ emissions. If you thrive in an environment that values momentum, ownership, and impact, you’ll feel at home here. We’re a fast-paced, high-performance team that works hard and challenges itself everyday. To enable this high-performance every team member enjoys full autonomy over their location (we’re remote-first). We're looking for a Category Manager to help us scale the attractiveness of our assortment across Europe. For the categories you own, you'll drive their growth strategy, leverage data to identify the biggest opportunities across supply, demand, and the on-site experience, and ensure we consistently deliver a competitive and attractive offering to customers. You'll report to the Category Management Team Lead and work closely with the rest of the Supply team (Business Development and Account Management), as well as the Marketing and Product teams. WHO YOU ARE: 4+ years of relevant experience in a category management or commercial analytics role, in a dynamic e-commerce and/or marketplace environment. Highly analytical and structured — you turn data into clear insights and prioritised actions. Strong commercial acumen — you understand marketplace supply and demand dynamics. Experienced in project management — you thrive working with cross-functional teams and drive impactful results across them. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills. Growth mindset — persistent, proactive, and a hands-on problem solver. AI-advocate — you use the latest tools and technologies to work smarter and faster. NICE TO HAVE: Experience in Consumer Electronics / Secondary Market. Ability to work with data beyond dashboards — e.g., Python and/or SQL. WHAT YOU WILL DO: Define the mid-term category growth strategy, including targets, assortment priorities, and category-specific opportunities to unlock growth. Identify and close assortment gaps (subcategories, brands, top-selling products) by working closely with the respective business developers and account managers. Constantly assess category performance, stock availability, and attractiveness; trigger sourcing and commercial actions to improve performance where needed. Prioritise initiatives to improve the on-site category experience, product presentation, and customer journey with our product team, based on competitor insights and customer data. Automate processes so you spend more time understanding insights and crafting recommendations rather than doing analysis. Act as the category expert and point of contact for internal teams. WHY YOU WILL ENJOY WORKING WITH US: Our Culture and Values: Decisions should be made based on facts and not by hierarchy levels? We sure think so! We embrace giving and receiving feedback, testing and welcoming new ideas, as well as sharing our knowledge across the company. You fail sometimes? Well, so do we! We’re all just human, let’s learn from our mistakes to improve in the future! No matter who you love, where you’re from, who you pray to, whether you pee sitting down or standing up – we are a bunch of talented people who enjoy spending our time making a difference! Personal & Professional Development: You'll have access to a dedicated learning budget within your department to support your growth, whether it's courses, conferences, or other learning opportunities that matter to you. We partner with Likeminded, offering you private sessions with experts for your personal growth and mental health. We frequently host internal workshops, allowing our teams to further develop their skills in different areas and enhancing collaboration across departments. Flexibility: We care about a healthy work/life balance. We not only function and support a fully remote setting but also offer the possibility to work from our beautiful office in the vibrant heart of Vienna – we love dogs, so feel free to bring your furry little buddy too 😊 We trust you to do the best job, so we don't care so much when you do it – you are able to self-organize. You will also be invited to take part in our office weeks, happening three times a year, where you will have the chance to work side by side with your colleagues and enjoy the team-building events and on-site workshops …and much more! See for further insights! Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Customer Solution Architect Team Lead (AMER)
items.summary: Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.We’re seeking a Customer Solution Architect Team Lead to captain a high-performing team of Customer Solutions Architects and help drive…
items.description: Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. We’re seeking a Customer Solution Architect Team Lead to captain a high-performing team of Customer Solutions Architects and help drive the adoption of Supabase across a diverse range of customers: from agile startups building towards their first launch to established brands with highly scaled workloads. This role will support the East Coast region across the Americas. As the CSA Team Lead, you will be responsible for both people management and customer outcomes - supporting team execution while developing repeatable best practices across pre-sales discovery, proof-of-value onboarding, and technical success. What You’ll Do At Supabase, CSA Leads oversee a portfolio of high-value customers by empowering their team to deliver technical excellence and long-term customer success. You'll work directly with the team to: Hire, coach, and grow a global team of CSAs who serve as trusted technical advisors to our customers. Collaborate with Sales, Product, and Engineering to define and scale the CSA motion across the full customer journey—from discovery through adoption and renewal. Create structured onboarding, training, and development plans for CSAs to level up in technical storytelling, Postgres optimization, and customer success strategy. Ensure CSAs consistently deliver successful outcomes, unblock adoption, and drive value for paid Team and Enterprise accounts. Work directly with strategic customers when needed—especially during complex escalations, architectural deep dives, or critical onboarding milestones. You'll be joining our team to support Supabase Team & Enterprise customers, where you will be expected to lead and innovate around the following areas of responsibility: Pre-Sales Discovery: Lead and review technical discovery led by CSAs to uncover business and technical objectives, set appropriate expectations of the Supabase platform, and define the criteria for success. Guide CSAs in designing and presenting platform demonstrations tailored to high-value customers, helping them clearly articulate the value of the Supabase platform and team. Collaborate with Growth team members to size deals, provide anticipated usage estimates, and identify potential workloads supported by the Platform. Proof-of-Value Onboarding Support your team in defining and executing proof-of-value scopes that balance business outcomes with low-friction onboarding. Ensure CSA-owned timelines, success criteria, and engagement tactics result in a high proof-to-conversion success rate. Build reusable onboarding flows (email sequences, docs, templates, webinars) that accelerate time-to-value for new customers. Customer Success & Expansion Help your team build detailed account plans focused on both short-term adoption and long-term expansion opportunities. Provide ongoing technical coaching for CSAs conducting architecture reviews, schema design evaluations, and performance tuning for production workloads. Partner cross-functionally to advocate for customer feedback, share emerging customer needs with Product & Eng, and communicate roadmap milestones back to customers. Trust & Platform Advocacy Coach CSAs to act as internal and external champions of Supabase, building trust with customers through consistency, clarity, and deep product expertise. Uphold a standard of excellence in customer engagement, ensuring Supabase becomes embedded in the way our customers build. Preferred Experience 6+ years of experience in Solutions Architecture, Technical Account Management, or Database Engineering. 2+ years of people management or team leadership experience , ideally in a high-growth, technical startup environment. Strong background with relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred), with a deep understanding of schema design, indexing, and query performance. Hands-on experience building modern web applications using frameworks like React, Svelte, Vue, or Node.js. Clear, confident technical communicator and storyteller. Must be able to distill complex technical topics into actionable outcomes for customers and team members alike. Experience navigating stakeholder alignment, conflict resolution, and collaborative problem-solving across teams. Familiarity with tools such as HubSpot, BigQuery, and internal BI dashboards. What We Offer Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. About the Team Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. 280+ team members 55+ countries 20+ languages spoken $500M raised 500,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities. Hiring Process We keep things simple, async-friendly, and respectful of your time: Apply – Our team will review your application. Intro Call – A short video chat to get to know each other. Interviews – Up to four calls with: Team Leads Future teammates Someone cross-functional from product, growth, or engineering (depending on the role) Someone from our leadership/founding team Decision – We may follow up with a final question or go straight to offer. All communication is remote and we aim to move fast.

items.title: Director of MEAL
items.summary: About Imagine WorldwideAll children have immense potential, but hundreds of millions don’t have access to the learning they need.
items.description: About Imagine Worldwide All children have immense potential, but hundreds of millions don’t have access to the learning they need. Imagine Worldwide ’s mission is to empower millions of children across Sub-Saharan Africa with the literacy and numeracy skills they need to reach their full potential. We provide an innovative education technology solution and implementation model to the global literacy/numeracy learning crisis using the onebillion application and various toolkits and systems to support implementation. Nine Randomized Controlled Trials (RCTs) across multiple countries and settings have shown dramatic learning gains, increased school attendance, and gender parity, all for less than $7 per child per year. Imagine Worldwide partners with governments, organizations, and communities to provide child-directed, tablet-based learning that is accessible, effective, and affordable. We are a California-based (United States) nonprofit organization operating across seven Sub-Saharan African countries. Learn more on our website. Role Overview The Director of MEAL will play a critical role in carrying out Imagine’s mission to scale tablet-based learning solutions that enable children to become literate and numerate. They will join a highly committed and collaborative team that is working together to empower every child everywhere to achieve their full potential. They will lead our monitoring, evaluation, and learning (MEAL) strategy, build high-performing MEAL teams in our countries, and drive data-driven decision-making across program implementation. They will oversee MEAL managers in our portfolio countries, ensuring that the MEAL function delivers rigorous monitoring, analysis, and organizational accountability. This role provides thought leadership on measurement and evidence generation to drive decisions in real time to improve the learning experience and outcomes for children as well as operational effectiveness across Imagine’s global footprint. Key Responsibilities The Director of MEAL will report to the Head of Delivery and work in close collaboration with all global function teams and country delivery teams. The role will collaborate closely with the Director of Analytics to ensure data tools are fit-for-purpose. The Director’s responsibilities will include - but will not be limited to: MEAL Leadership Oversee MEAL frameworks, indicators, and measurement plans across countries. Own and continually refine Imagine’s Theory of Change, ensuring monitoring, evaluation, and learning strategies are aligned with how Imagine enables improvements in learning outcomes Develop and maintain Master Data Management (MDM) definitions, procedures, standards, data review rhythms, and reporting deadlines in collaboration with all relevant stakeholders. Maintain an up-to-date repository of program metrics for internal performance reporting, proposals, reports, and external parties, donor materials, and communications. Ensure that program data is trusted, accessible, actionable, and aligned with organisational impact goals. Ensure program dashboards, visualizations, and data platforms are intuitive, accessible, and optimized for leadership, country, and function teams to promote data-driven decision-making across the organization Ensure alignment of all data sources (LMS, platform analytics, MEAL tools, partner systems) with master data standards. Establish robust data governance and quality assurance protocols for timely, accurate, and ethical decision-grade data collection. Collaborate with the Director of Analytics to ensure interoperability and a unified data architecture that enables a single source of truth across all systems. Program Data Analyses and Reporting Lead the development of dashboards, performance reports, and analytic models supporting the Delivery teams, i.e. Programs, Global Supply Chain, and Regional Supply Chain. Develop, test, and refine hypotheses related to the Theory of Change and challenge assumptions, using insights gained to drive program innovation and strategic learning: Formulate and pursue high-value programmatic questions that deepen understanding of product, program performance Oversee statistical analysis, segmentation, forecasting, and experimental design eg. A/B tests Collaborate with Directors to co-create data analysis plans for new initiatives, ensuring rigor and relevance Translate insights into clear narratives, visualisations, and recommendations for diverse audiences: Synthesize insights for the country teams, Senior Leadership Team, and Board, translating evidence into decisions that strengthen strategy, scale, and impact. Produce high-quality reports with accurate, compelling impact metrics and qualitative insights for funders, government, and external stakeholders, contributing to global knowledge on what works for edtech foundational learning program implementation Partner with Communications to ensure external messaging on our website, newsletters, annual reports, media, government reporting, social media is accurate, evidence-based, and reflective of Imagine’s impact Collaborate with Research and Technology on tool selection or development, survey implementation, and qualitative inquiry and analysis. Participate in cross-organizational initiatives, championing a culture of learning, accountability, and excellence. Capacity Building Champion a culture of continuous learning—ensuring insights flow back into programme and product improvement. Build a strong data culture and develop data fluency across functions and country teams Drive uptake and utilization of dashboards and data resources by upskilling teams, and embedding the use of data in standardised ways of working, and raising delivery excellence. Build organisation-wide data literacy, including training on dashboards, data definitions, and quality practices. Support team members in interpreting and presenting financial and impact data clearly for internal and external audiences Develop, coach, and mentor all staff, strengthening data analysis skills, strategic thinking, and problem-solving. Requirements The successful candidate will possess the following competencies, experiences, and qualities: Honours Degree or Post Graduate Diploma in Data Science, or Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability and Learning (MEAL), or related fields. Master's Degree qualification preferred. A minimum of 10 years’ experience in data-related roles, of which 5 years must have been at a senior level with demonstrated experience in leading and implementing enterprise data management interventions Experience working in data management and comfort working with impact metrics Experience with building a data-driven culture in an organization to support better decision-making Experience working with remote or hybrid teams across multiple countries Experience working in the non-profit or social sector is an advantage Specific skills (required) Exceptional people skills and proven experience that include: Demonstrate proficiency in data analysis, data cleaning, and data quality frameworks Excellent communication and storytelling skills for both technical and non-technical audiences Ability to build and maintain effective stakeholder relationships across the organisation Ability to lead, coach, and inspire a team of professionals Ability to work and collaborate effectively in multicultural environments and teams Ability to handle sensitive information with confidentiality Strong organizational skills and superior attention to detail Ability to display a high level of adaptability/flexibility Compensation & Benefits Salary is competitive and commensurate with experience. Location The Director of MEAL must be based in Africa. The Director will frequently collaborate and coordinate with operations teams across Africa, the US, and the UK. The role is primarily home-based, with adhoc international travel for in-person team meetings, field support, or training, as needed. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis * * * Imagine Worldwide is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. items.title: Transactional Revenue Intelligence & Systems Analyst
items.summary: Role MissionKoronet grows when our customers succeed in buying, selling, and operating.
items.description: Role Mission Koronet grows when our customers succeed in buying, selling, and operating. Your job is to build the systems and intelligence that identify where we can add value, what blocks that growth, and how to scale our impact. You will work as a solo operator, not a passive analyst. You will build dashboards, decision-making tools that empower teams to act faster and smarter and execute scalable campaigns. You are responsible for transforming raw data into clear, actionable insights and driving real business outcomes at scale. How we work We’re one team with one goal: delivering actual value. We share what we learn from customers, help our colleagues succeed, and focus on outcomes, not just checking boxes like 'completed call' or 'closed ticket.' Transactions at Koronet Transactions connect how our customers actually work with what our platform can do. We sit between customer feedback and product development, turning what we see in the field into real product improvements. We don't just 'do tasks'—we look for ways to solve problems and use what we learn to make the whole platform better for everyone. What you will do Build and maintain dashboards and tools for Transactions, Success, Product, and leadership. Turn business questions into reliable decision systems: define the problem, find the evidence, and measure the result. Connect data from calls, feedback, email, and market research to understand how customers buy, list, and sell. Spot patterns across customers to identify where Koronet can add value—whether through better processes, product changes, or new integrations. Drive the marketplace growth model by helping customers improve their sourcing, catalog reliability, and digital sales. Create feedback loops to track if campaigns and product changes actually drive adoption, transaction volume, or efficiency. Design, launch, and execute campaigns to expand and make buying and selling digitally in our ecosystem easier. Track impact on and ensure data quality by investigating inconsistencies rather than guessing. Turn customer insights into clear evidence for other teams to use. Identify and fix internal bottlenecks with automation and better workflows. How you will use tools: You will be a solo operator using automation, data analysis, and research tools to move faster. Define the problem, inputs, and goals clearly. Use research and prototyping to build better workflows. Measure results against real customer outcomes. Know when to use automation and when to rely on human judgment or customer context. Success Criteria: You drive business results at scale through your campaigns and indirectly enabling teams Customer-facing teams have stronger context to drive customer behavior. Product receives clear, prioritized evidence of customer problems and their impact. Insights compound over time into better enablement and product decisions. Your dashboards are trusted because they are accurate and useful, not because they are complex. You accelerate other teams without becoming a bottleneck. A few things this role isn't! A passive reporting or dashboard-making role. A product manager making roadmap promises. The final decision-maker on strategy. An AI developer hired only to build agents. What do we expect from you Strong analytical judgment and commercial curiosity. Able to solve ambiguous problems using data, spreadsheets, SQL, or code. Comfortable working across structured and unstructured data. Excellent communication skills; you can turn complex data into useful narratives for other teams. Interest in marketplaces, B2B SaaS, and operational systems. Humble, rigorous, and team-first: you surface uncertainty and improve the system rather than defending your first guess. Fluent in English (must). Experience in the floriculture industry will be considered a strong plus. What We Offer: An independent, flexible, and versatile role within a fast-growing international organization. Flexible / Remote working environment. We encourage continuous learning and professional growth. Why Join Koronet : Global and Remote-First: Work with a diverse team across the Americas and Europe, with flexibility to work from anywhere. Ownership Culture: We foster an environment where each team member takes ownership and is empowered to contribute to the company's success. Growth & Development: We support continuous professional growth and offer financial assistance for technical certifications and other learning opportunities. Compensation: Competitive salary and an indefinite contract, with salary negotiable based on experience. If you're passionate about making an impact and growing with a dynamic, remote-first company, we want to hear from you! Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Freelance Data Scientist with Ontology and Graph expertise
items.summary: adesso Belgium is looking for a data scientist (2) to support our customer in building an AI Agent Platform Data Foundations.
items.description: adesso Belgium is looking for a data scientist (2) to support our customer in building an AI Agent Platform Data Foundations. Customer info: Our customer is an international, independent provider of indirect procurement services. Requirements Preferred start date: 1xASAP and 1x January 2027 Duration: 12 months Rate: depending on your location Time Zone: CET Your role Build the data and context layer that powers the customer's procurement AI agent platform — canonical models, knowledge graph, semantic/taxonomy layer, and the retrieval and evaluation pipelines agents depend on. This is production infrastructure from day one, not a proof of concept: versioned, tested, and built for multiple tenants. You will work on: Data products & canonical modeling — Design and deliver the first reference data products (Supplier Master, Spend Cube, Contract Register) end to end, from source ingestion through the canonical model. Knowledge graph & ontology — Stand up and operate the platform and working graphs (ontology, reference data, tenant separation); own the graph-plus-vector retrieval design, deciding per source whether data is represented as entities/relationships, embeddings, or both. Master data & semantic layer — Build matching rules, golden records, and stewardship processes for Suppliers, Contracts, and Categories; contribute to the business glossary and taxonomy-to-ontology mapping. Extraction & evaluation — Build document-extraction pipelines (e.g., from SharePoint sources) with confidence scoring and human review for uncertain cases; build and maintain labelled evaluation datasets and accuracy benchmarks against agreed thresholds. Connector framework — Build source connectors (starting with Fabric data products and master data golden records) so new sources can be onboarded without modifying the graph core or query service. Quality feedback loop — Implement the mechanism routing agent overrides, failures, or low-confidence retrievals back to data owners so data products improve over time rather than decay. Engineering practice — Work exclusively in the GitHub/Azure environment; ship via pull request with CI (build, tests, security scan, evaluation fixtures); version all schemas, connector contracts, and extraction configs. Required Experience Hard skills: Demonstrated experience taking a knowledge graph system to production (not just prototyping) — schema design, query performance, tenant/data isolation - Using Neo4J and Python Strong background in semantic modeling: ontologies, taxonomies, business glossaries, and their relationship to graph and canonical data models. Hands-on experience with semantic web standards and technologies including OWL/OWL2, RDF, RDFS, SPARQL , ontology lifecycle management, taxonomy alignment, and semantic reasoning. Experience building data products and master-data pipelines (entity matching, golden-record consolidation, stewardship workflows). Experience designing and implementing hybrid retrieval architectures combining graph databases (e.g., Neo4j) and vector databases to support semantic search, RAG, and AI agent workloads. Experience with retrieval architectures combining graph and vector/embedding approaches. Experience building and maintaining labelled evaluation datasets and measuring extraction/model accuracy against a threshold. Proficiency with modern data/ML engineering practices: version control, CI/CD, automated testing, containerized deployment Experience with Microsoft Fabric and SharePoint-based document extraction pipelines. Soft skills: Fluent in ENG Open to travelling if needed (EU), this position is fully remote Collaborative mindset, ideally with a proven similar work experience Why join adesso Belgium ? Work in an international group with strong local expertise in Belgium. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver trusted, compliant, reusable data products . Flexible freelance setup with the support of a growing adesso Belgium community. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Product Manager — Data & Analytics Location: Remote, with GMT+8 working-hour overlap required Reports to: CEO Employment Type: Full-time About the Opportunity Nodeworthy is supporting a Web3 technology company that helps blockchain projects execute large-scale token-distribution and ecosystem-growth campaigns. The company is expanding its digital-asset infrastructure and developing new data and intelligence products. We are looking for a Product Manager to own a product area end to end—from converting leadership direction into a clear roadmap to working closely with engineering and using market and user research to guide product decisions. This is a high-ownership role for someone comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where priorities can evolve and complete information may not always be available. What You’ll Own Product Strategy and Roadmap Own and prioritise the product roadmap based on user needs, commercial objectives and available data. Translate leadership direction into clear product priorities and delivery plans. Evaluate trade-offs and make sound prioritisation decisions with incomplete information. Define and monitor metrics that measure product adoption, performance and business impact. Product Development Translate product requirements into PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria and actionable delivery plans. Partner closely with engineering and data teams to define clear, technically feasible requirements. Guide products and features from problem definition through development, launch and iteration. Ensure stakeholders remain aligned on product scope, objectives and delivery expectations. Research and Discovery Conduct market, competitor and user research. Turn research findings into actionable product and positioning recommendations. Speak with users and stakeholders to identify pain points, workflows and unmet needs. Convert feedback into well-defined product improvements rather than standalone feature requests. Product Operations Establish lightweight processes for product discovery, prioritisation and delivery. Maintain clear product documentation and decision records. Improve visibility across product progress, risks and dependencies. Support a distributed team working across technical and commercial functions. Requirements What We’re Looking For Business-level proficiency in written and spoken English and Mandarin is required, as the role involves regular coordination with internal team members and external stakeholders who primarily communicate in Mandarin. At least 3 years of product management experience. Experience in crypto, fintech, data, analytics or developer tools is strongly preferred. Strong interest in digital assets and familiarity with the broader cryptocurrency ecosystem. Demonstrated experience shipping products or features from problem definition through launch. Strong written communication and the ability to create clear, structured product documentation. Comfortable working directly with engineers and discussing technical or data-driven products. Strong ownership, sound judgement and the ability to operate effectively amid ambiguity. Able to work remotely with meaningful overlap during GMT+8 working hours. items.description: Location: can be remote,within +/-3 hours CET Contract: Consultancy contract, one year, 120 days (with possible extension) Starting date : asap Deadline to apply: 22nd of October 2026 I. MSF INTERNATIONAL Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international, independent, medical humanitarian organisation that delivers emergency aid to people affected by armed conflict, epidemics, healthcare exclusion and natural disasters. MSF offers assistance to people based only on need and irrespective of race, religion, gender or political affiliation. MSF International is the legal entity that binds MSF’s 24 sections, 27 associations and 18 branch offices together. Registered in Switzerland, MSF International provides coordination, information and support to the MSF Movement, as well as implements international projects and initiatives as requested. II. POSITION BACKGROUND MSF develops medical-operational guidelines to support staff in providing quality health care and rapid emergency response in humanitarian contexts. MSF international guidelines are regularly updated and published in digital and print. They are based on extensive practical experience from MSF programs, recommendations published by the World Health Organization and other leading medical institutions, and evidence based on research and scientific literature. The International Guideline Publications (IGP) team was established to ensure the quality production of MSF guidelines. There are currently around 30 international guidelines in the MSF guidelines library, accessible at medicalguidelines.msf.org, some produced in multiple languages (English, French, Spanish, Arabic) and a selection with open access to the public. This consultancy is focused on the edition of the revision of MSF’s HIV guidelines, with a maximum of two guidelines being edited at the same time within this consultancy assignment. III. PLACE IN THE ORGANISATION This consultancy is part of the International Guidelines Publication (IGP) team of MSF International . The consultant reports directly to the IGP Manager and works in close collaboration with guidelines team members, particularly the other medical editors in the team, as well as the HIV medical platform and other internal stakeholders. IV. OBJECTIVES OF THE POSITION Editorial oversight and quality assurance: ensure MSF's international HIV guidelines are high-quality, scientifically sound, and consistent with existing guidelines. Confirm they comply with MSF International guideline standards and respond to the specific needs of health care professionals working in resources limited settings. Quality improvement: Apply quality standards set when editing the guidelines. Stakeholder collaboration and engagement: collaborate effectively with author-coordinator, IGP team members as well as internal experts throughout the editing process. Validation and approval: verify all validation process steps to secure approvals from relevant experts and MSF’s Medical Directors. Development process oversight: oversee the entire development process of the revisions from project planning, to content review to final publication. V. MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Preparation and planning Participation in the selection of author coordinator(s) for new guidelines, upon request; In collaboration with the author coordinator(s), outline the division of tasks and responsibilities of the author coordinator(s), editor and other key collaborators as well as their functional links, following the standards set; Contribute to an arbitration processes where necessary; Brief and support author coordinators on editorial processes, authorship policy, and production workflows, supported by the IGP editors and manager; Share the Authorship policy with author coordinator(s), and key collaborators; Provide input on and validate structure of the guideline, following the concept note approved by MSF’s Medical directors; Provide input on and validate draft table of content, and timeline documents, based on the concept note approved by MSF’s Medical directors; Ensure timely involvement of and input from MSF and external experts in the planning document. 2. Medical content editing Provide input throughout the writing process and review draft chapters for completeness, coherence, practical use, and adherence to guidelines; Ensure the content is evidence-based with accurate references, and the quality of it, and ensure coherence of data, figures, and protocols. Check if the text is complete, concise and coherent and in line with the agreed table of content and Guide for producing guidelines and suggest improvements for clarity and readability. Evaluate the presentation of content and ensure it aligns with the Guide for Producing Guidelines and Style guide and, in collaboration with the Designer, if it is suitable for both print and digital formats. Verify drug dosages, treatment protocols, and medical terminology for accuracy and consistency. Ensure a consistent tone, terminology, structure, and formatting throughout the document. Validate references, footnotes, glossary, and illustrations for accuracy and compliance. Ensure contributors are correctly listed according to the authorship policy. 3. Coordination Confirm that all assigned experts have contributed their input and participate in arbitration processes when necessary. Coordinate with the Translation coordinator for copy editing and process feedback effectively. Submit the final version to Medical Directors for review and support the presentation of the guideline. Assist in incorporating feedback from Medical Directors and provide a list of changes. Submit guidelines to the Designer for publication in both print and digital formats. Check the final text to be sent to the Translator coordinator and send it over; Liaise with the Translation coordinator and assist in resolving language or terminology issues. 4. Reporting Provide regular information on the progress of activities to IGP manager; Actively participate in monthly update meetings. Requirements Required qualifications and experience Medical diploma as doctor Background or experience in HIV is considered an asset Minimum 5 years' proven experience in medical content editing, ideally within public health, HIV content, humanitarian, or clinical settings. Equivalent skills must be clearly demonstrated through relevant professional experience; Minimum of 5 years field experience with MSF or other international organizations working in similar contexts, ideally in HIV programmes; Familiarity with medical guideline development, systematic reviews, and evidence-based publishing. Proficient in editing scientific and medical content, with demonstrated ability to apply consistent referencing, citation formatting, and adherence to rigorous scientific writing standards; Experience working with multidisciplinary teams and coordinating complex editorial processes. Key skills and competencies Strong command of written English Advanced skills in medical writing, editing, and fact-checking. Ability to synthesize complex scientific information into clear, structured, and practical applicable content. Excellent organizational skills, project management an asset. Attention to detail and commitment to editorial quality. Strong interpersonal and communication skills. Collaborative mindset and ability to support others. Ability to work and report independently IT literacy Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. At MSF, we are committed to an inclusive culture that encourages and supports the diverse voices of our employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, nationalities, races, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics. MSF is committed to preventing abuse, inappropriate behaviour, lack of integrity and financial misconduct in its work and care spaces. MSF expects all staff to share this commitment and promote an environment where abuse and misconduct is not tolerated. We are committed to removing barriers for people with specific accessibility needs. If you need an adjustment to the recruitment process to be considered for the role, please let us know from the beginning of the selection process. Note: All offers of employment will be subject to reference checks and to appropriate screening checks. By submitting an application, the job applicant confirms his/her/their understanding of these recruitment procedures. Originally posted on Himalayas

This role is responsible for improving operational efficiency, enhancing customer experiences, streamlining internal processes, and enabling scalable growth through automation. You will work closely with sales, marketing, customer success, operations, and leadership teams to build intelligent workflows, automate repetitive tasks, improve lead management, and maintain accurate customer data. This is an ideal opportunity for someone passionate about automation, AI, integrations, and building efficient business systems. Employment Type & Location This is a full-time, remote-first position with global flexibility. Team members can work remotely from anywhere or collaborate from a Dynime office when needed. You'll configure CRM platforms, automate sales and marketing processes, integrate business applications, and build workflows that reduce manual work while improving accuracy and efficiency. items.description: All Other Remote Headquarters: Dubai, United Arab Emirates URL: https://aceventures.ai/ Location: Remote, based in the UAE or Europe. Engagement: full-time independent contractor (own visa and invoicing setup required). About the role You will be the right hand to a Dubai-based founder who runs a group of companies in performance marketing and consumer brands and splits his time between Dubai and Europe. Your job is to take every administrative task off his plate, business and personal, so his time goes to decisions and deals rather than logistics. We are looking for an A player. This is a fast-moving environment with high expectations: priorities change daily, decisions are made quickly, and the standard is that things get done properly the first time. You need to be driven, want to work hard, and take pride in running a tight operation for someone who moves fast. This is a hands-on, high-trust role. You will handle calendars, travel, bookings, paperwork, payments, vendors and follow-ups across several companies and several countries. You should be the kind of person who closes loops without being chased and notices problems before they land on his desk. What you will own Business administration Manage calendar and inbox: triage, prioritise, draft replies, schedule and reschedule across time zones Prepare, chase and file documents: contracts for signature, invoices, KYC and compliance requests from banks and partners, company renewals (trade licences, visas, insurance) Coordinate with accountants, lawyers, banks and agencies; track deadlines so nothing lapses Keep shared drives, access lists and company records organised and current Take notes in meetings when asked, track action items and follow up with the people responsible Travel and bookings Plan and book flights, hotels, villas, ground transport and restaurants, often on short notice and with changes mid-trip Manage loyalty programmes, entry requirements, visas and travel documents Coordinate pet travel logistics when required Personal administration Handle personal bills, subscriptions, insurance, vehicles and property matters in Dubai and Europe Manage household staff and service providers (cleaning, maintenance, vets, groomers, trainers) Research and arrange appointments, gifts, events and reservations Run errands remotely: returns, deliveries, renewals, forms What success looks like By day 30: You own the calendar and inbox end to end, know every company entity, bank and key contact, and have a live tracker of renewals and deadlines. By day 60: You have handled at least one full international trip solo, including changes mid-trip, and taken over all personal bills and subscriptions. By day 90: The founder is not touching admin. You flag issues before they become urgent and propose fixes rather than questions. What we are looking for 3+ years as an executive assistant, personal assistant or chief of staff to a founder, senior executive or private individual Based in the UAE or Europe, already holding the right to live and work there, and able to invoice as a freelancer or through your own company Fluent written and spoken English is required; any additional languages are a plus Proven experience booking complex international travel and handling last-minute changes calmly Comfortable with numbers and paperwork: expenses, invoices, bank forms, compliance requests Strong with Google Workspace, WhatsApp, Slack, Notion or similar, and quick to learn new tools Skilled with AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT: you use them daily for drafting, research, summarising and structuring work, not as an occasional experiment Track record of automating your own repetitive tasks (for example with Zapier, Make, n8n, spreadsheet scripts or AI agents) without being asked to Discreet by default; you will see sensitive financial, legal and personal information Self-directed: works from a list, chases without reminders, confirms when something is done Calm under pressure, allergic to loose ends, direct in communication, and comfortable working mostly alone with a founder who moves fast and changes plans often This role is not for you if You need a fixed 9 to 5 with no interruptions, you prefer to wait for instructions rather than propose a plan, or you are uncomfortable handling someone else's money, documents and personal life with total discretion. Tools we use Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive), WhatsApp and Slack for daily communication, Notion for tasks and documentation, Claude for drafting, research and workflow automation, and standard travel and booking platforms. Experience with UAE government portals (GDRFA, DED, Dubai Now) and European banking is useful but not required. Working hours and availability Core hours: 09:00 to 18:00 Gulf Standard Time (UTC+4), Monday to Friday When the founder is in Europe, core hours shift to Central European Time Reachable for urgent travel or booking issues outside core hours and on weekends; this is balanced with flexible time off during quiet periods Occasional in-person time in Dubai or Europe (a few days per quarter) is a plus, not a requirement Confidentiality and trust You will have access to passports, payment cards, company accounts and private correspondence. The engagement is conditional on a signed NDA, reference checks and a background check. Access is granted step by step during the probation period. Compensation and terms Fee: EUR 3,500 to 5,000 per month (or AED equivalent), depending on location and experience, invoiced monthly Performance bonus: up to EUR 2,000 per month on top of the fee, assessed monthly against agreed targets (deadlines met, zero missed renewals or bookings, response times, issues caught before they became urgent) Engagement: independent contractor. You must already hold the legal right to live and work where you are based and be set up to invoice (freelance permit, sole trader, autónomo or your own company). No visa sponsorship is provided. Software and travel costs covered when in-person time is needed Three-month probation period How to apply Apply with your CV, your earliest start date, and short written answers (a few sentences each) to the following: Describe a trip you booked that went wrong and how you fixed it. You receive a bank compliance request with a 48-hour deadline and the founder is on a long-haul flight. What do you do? Have you managed personal or household matters, not just business, for a principal before? Give an example. Describe one repetitive task you automated for yourself or a previous principal: what the task was, which tools you used, and how much time it saved. What time zone are you in, and what hours are you realistically available? Shortlisted candidates complete a 30-minute practical task (plan a sample trip from a short brief) before a video interview. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/ace-ventures-executive-personal-assistant-to-the-founder-remote-uae-or-europe

items.title: Integrated Campaign Strategist
items.summary: Are you a dreamer, innovator, thinker and a do-er who believes in contributing to something that makes difference?
items.description: Are you a dreamer, innovator, thinker and a do-er who believes in contributing to something that makes difference? Make an impact. Join PMI. How will you make a difference to PMI? PMI is looking for an Integrated Growth Marketing Strategist to own the end-to-end, cross-channel activation strategy, bringing email, web, social, paid media, and content together into one cohesive approach rather than separate channel plans. This role maintains a strong understanding of business performance, customer behavior, lifecycle trends, market dynamics, and seasonal opportunities to proactively identify and recommend initiatives that drive growth. The Strategist defines how audiences are reached and activated across the full channel mix, how channels and formats work together to achieve campaign objectives, and how performance is measured and optimized holistically. With a deep understanding of both B2B and B2C audiences, the Strategist translates business and growth objectives into integrated activation strategies and provides clear direction to channel owners and agency partners for execution. This is a senior individual-contributor role with direct accountability for growth and activation performance. The Strategist works closely across Marketing and other key functions to connect campaign performance to measurable business outcomes across the full customer funnel. What you’ll bring to the role: Campaign Activation Strategy & Channel Design Own the end-to-end, cross-channel activation strategy for integrated campaigns — treating paid media, email, web, social, and content as one holistic system rather than separate channel plans. Translate campaign and lifecycle objectives directly into a single, integrated activation plan — defining channel mix, format investment, and audience segmentation across channels, rather than aggregating plans built independently by channel owners. Direct channel owners and the agency in executing against the strategy; incorporate their channel-specific expertise and ideas into the strategy without ceding ownership of it. Identify opportunities for personalization, segmentation, and audience relevance across the full activation plan. Paid Media Strategy & Agency Oversight Set paid media strategy and activation design — platform selection, format strategy, targeting approach — for campaigns executed by the agency. Review and approve agency media plans against activation strategy and growth goals; provide strategic direction and briefs, not just timeline coordination. Hold the agency accountable to performance and strategic fit, partnering on in-flight optimization and test-and-learn/new-channel pilots. Growth & Performance Goal Ownership Maintain a strong pulse on overall business performance, audience behavior, market dynamics, and seasonal or cultural moments to identify and recommend campaign initiatives and optimizations that can drive growth, engagement, conversion, or lifecycle impact. Set and own performance goals for campaign activation and growth marketing — conversion, funnel/pipeline impact, channel efficiency (e.g., CAC, ROAS, cost-per-conversion), and lifecycle impact. Proactively track and report on activation and growth performance; drive optimization recommendations rather than only summarizing results after the fact. Partner with Product Marketing, which owns product performance and usage metrics, to maintain a shared view of business impact from awareness/activation through product adoption. Cross-Functional & Executive Coordination Serve as the central strategic lead across dependencies, roles, and timelines for integrated campaigns. Facilitate campaign kickoffs, checkpoints, and retrospectives; represent activation strategy and growth performance directly to senior stakeholders, including CMO/VP-level review of media plans and channel investment. Partner with Regional Marketing to align global and regional execution requirements. Operational Excellence & Process Leadership Define and evolve the operating model, templates, and workflows for activation strategy and growth performance — not only apply existing ones. Ensure campaign documentation is clear, accurate, and consistently maintained across a broader and more complex set of workstreams. Identify and lead process improvements that reduce friction between strategy, channel owners, and agency execution. Role Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field. 8–10 years of experience in integrated marketing, growth marketing, or performance marketing, including direct ownership of paid media strategy and planning (not solely coordinating with a paid media function). Proven track record of driving strong campaign performance across the end-to-end customer lifecycle, directly contributing to business performance and growth.Demonstrated experience setting and being accountable to growth/performance targets, not only reporting on channel activity. Experience managing agency relationships at a strategic level — briefing, directing, and holding agencies accountable to performance — rather than coordinating deliverables and timelines. Comfortable working in a matrixed, cross-functional environment with senior stakeholder visibility. Familiarity with marketing automation platforms, CRM systems, analytics/performance dashboards, and project management tools. Activation Strategy Ownership: Designs channel-agnostic activation strategy — not just coordination — across paid, owned, and earned channels. Business & Customer Acumen: Demonstrates strong curiosity about broader business performance, customer behavior, and audience needs, understanding how to build effective growth strategies across both B2B and B2C contexts. Paid Media & Performance Marketing Acumen: Deep fluency in paid channel formats, targeting, platforms, and performance metrics (CAC, ROAS, conversion). Growth Goal Ownership: Sets, owns, and is accountable for growth/activation performance targets. Agency Strategic Management: Directs and holds agency partners accountable at a strategy level, not only an execution level. Cross-Channel Judgment: Understands how channels work together and makes format/investment tradeoffs across them. Executive Communication: Clearly represents strategy and performance to senior stakeholders, including CMO/VP-level review. Analytics Literacy: Interprets performance dashboards and translates data into optimization decisions. Content & Messaging Awareness: Ensures narrative consistency across all campaign components. Adaptability: Comfortable working in fast-paced, dynamic environments with shifting priorities. Proficiency in PMI's business language (English). Some travel, possibly up to 15%, conditions permitting. Requirements include ability to travel nationally and globally and may occur over weekends or holidays. What you can expect from us We value and nurture an environment of inclusivity and diversity, and a culture of communication and collaboration. Your health, safety and well-being come first, and we believe that you should have time for your work, but you should also have time for you.. Join us and you’ll get: an excellent total package, with compensation and benefits based upon your geographic location. skill development opportunities, to help you grow now and into the future. access to a global network, to enrich your professional experience. flexible options to help balance work time and your time award and bonus opportunities. The salary offer will be based on several factors, including the candidate’s demonstrated skills, qualifications and relevant experience. Let’s help make the world work better for everyone. Apply today! Project Management Institute, Inc. is committed to providing equal employment opportunities without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religious creed, national origin, physical or mental disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
