items.description: Join phData, a remote-first data and AI consultancy company with employees across the United States, Latin America, and India. We partner with industry leaders, including Snowflake, AWS, Anthropic, Glean, and dbt, to solve the complex data and AI challenges that slow large enterprises. We’re growing fast, and we give our people real ownership over their work. We hire top performers and trust them to deliver results. Why phData? Snowflake Implementation Partner of the Year — 7 consecutive years, and 2026 Snowflake AI Partner of the Year AWS Premier Tier Services Partner — the highest tier of recognition in the AWS Partner Network 2025 Fivetran Partner of the Year (4th consecutive year) 2025 dbt Labs Partner of the Year (3x winner) with Visionary partner status 2026 KNIME Customer Excellence Partner of the Year Preferred Partner in the Anthropic Claude Partner Network #1 Partner in Snowflake Advanced Certifications 600+ Expert Cloud Certifications (Sigma, AWS, Azure, Dataiku, and more) Recognized as an award-winning workplace in the US, India and LATAM We are looking for an AI Services Lead to join our Client Services team, with a focus on our partnership with Anthropic. This is a role where you help land the Anthropic account and then own everything that comes after. You are in the room from the beginning, shaping the deal, setting the vision, and building the roadmap that turns an initial commitment into a multi-year AI transformation. You don’t inherit an account. You build it. You carry both the delivery and the growth. You are the client’s most trusted advisor on what AI can do for their business, and you hold yourself personally accountable for making that real. Key Responsibilities Lead activation for newly landed Anthropic-focused accounts, rapidly moving them from initial interest into well-scoped, active engagements that align with client AI/data maturity. Own end-to-end delivery oversight for your accounts, staying close enough to identify technical and delivery risk early. Build and maintain documented account plans and use-case backlogs that turn initial pilots or workshops into multi-phase, multi-workstream AI transformation programs. Become a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders (IT and line-of-business), shaping AI and data roadmaps that leverage Anthropic and related capabilities to drive measurable business outcomes. Partner with Anthropic’s field team and internal Sales, Marketing, and Delivery leadership to identify, shape, and close expansion opportunities across your portfolio of accounts. Provide strategic leadership during executive meetings, QBRs, and roadmap discussions, positioning phData as a trusted advisor to both business and technology stakeholders. Mentor team members and foster a culture of learning, feedback, and continuous improvement. Contribute to internal playbooks, account planning frameworks, and repeatable patterns for driving AI & Data outcomes. Share best practices and client insights to improve phData’s engagement model and delivery excellence. About You You are a commercially minded, technically fluent client leader. You thrive in ambiguity, move fast, and don’t wait for permission to drive outcomes. The traits below aren’t aspirational; they describe who you already are: Extreme Ownership: You consider “business as usual” in your account plan a failure. Stagnant accounts are a personal problem you refuse to tolerate. You push action, create momentum, and treat every week without a clear next use case as a gap you need to close. Order Maker, Not Order Taker: Your clients don’t tell you what to build next. You tell them. You come to every conversation with a point of view, a hypothesis, and a draft plan. You believe that showing up without a proposed path forward is showing up unprepared. Attention to Detail: You believe that great work doesn’t happen without the details being right. The account plan is live. The backlog is current. The delivery status is accurate. You don’t let things drift because drift erodes trust. Trust is the only currency that matters in this role. Systems Thinker: You don’t accept a recurring problem as bad luck. When the same delivery risk surfaces in the third engagement, you assume the structure is producing it and you go change the structure. You trace how a scoping decision in week two becomes a delivery problem in month five, and you fix it upstream before it becomes a persistent problem. Required Qualifications 6–10+ years of experience in a hybrid delivery/sales role within consulting or professional services, with responsibility for scoping service engagements and accountability for project success. Alternatively, you’ve held direct accountability for strategic account growth and executive engagement. Demonstrated experience owning both delivery quality and account growth on the same engagement. Track record in scoping and delivering $50K–$1M services engagements History building account plans and roadmaps that carry a single pilot into a broader rollout (for example, multiple phases or multi-workstream programs). Comfort stepping into an account shortly after it is landed and immediately owning activation and expansion, even if you did not source the account or own the channel relationship. Strong relationship-building skills with senior client stakeholders (IT and line-of-business) and a track record of becoming a trusted advisor to leaders such as CIOs, CTOs, or CDOs. Ability to structure complex problems and drive them to resolution in a matrixed environment. Willingness to travel up to 50% based on client needs. Technical / Functional Skills Real, hands-on AI/data competency sufficient to identify use cases, and delivery risk for agentic AI/LLM and data solutions (for example, RAG, MCP-style servers, agent orchestration, evals, and data architecture). Direct experience with Anthropic (Code, Cowork, or Enterprise) or a comparable LLM/agentic AI platform. Preferred Qualifications Preferred qualifications help candidates stand out but are not required for success in this role. Demonstrated success turning a single AI or data pilot into a multi-year, multi-million-dollar program. Prior experience operating as a trusted advisor with senior technology and line-of-business leaders on AI/data strategy, roadmap design, and delivery risk. Experience building formal, documented account plans and use-case backlogs specifically for generative AI or agentic AI rollouts. Why phData? Impactful Work: Partner with leading organizations on meaningful data and AI initiatives. Collaborative Culture: Work with a supportive, high-performing global team that values transparency, autonomy, and continuous improvement. Growth Opportunities: Access to challenging projects, mentorship, and structured development pathways. Values-Driven: We prioritize doing the right thing for our clients, our teams, and our community. Benefits at phData US: Remote-First Work Environment 401k plan with company match Dental and Vision insurance Home Office Equipment Stipend Annual stipend for Learning and Development Competitive comp, excellent benefits, Flexible PTO plan plus 10 Holidays (and other cool perks) phData celebrates diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Our approach helps us to build a winning team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and abilities. So, regardless of how your diversity expresses itself, you can find a home here at phData. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, religion, national origin, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, genetic information, disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. If you would like to request an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at People Operations.

items.description: TopSpeed.com is a leading automotive website that provides in-depth reviews, news, and analysis on the latest cars, motorcycles, and automotive trends. The site covers a wide range of topics, including new vehicle releases, performance upgrades, industry insights, and car culture. TopSpeed caters to enthusiasts and casual readers alike, offering detailed specs, expert opinions, and engaging content on everything from sports cars and luxury vehicles to electric cars and motorcycles. We are seeking talented and knowledgeable freelance writers with a passion for the motorcycle world. As a freelance writer for TopSpeed, you will create well-researched, original articles that cater to a broad audience, from car enthusiasts to everyday readers. Your Responsibilities: Deliver content that is informative, entertaining, and aligns with TopSpeed’s voice Be a dedicated and consistent contributor to the site. Follow TopSpeed’s general Editorial Guidelines while producing unique and high-quality content. Produce articles in a timely manner to ensure that the latest industry news and most interesting content are always available to TopSpeed’s loyal readers. What We Offer Competitive compensation. Flexible schedule. Remote freelance position to work from a location of your choice. Exposure to TopSpeed’s large and passionate audience, which reaches 6+ million visitors per month, providing you an exciting opportunity to make a genuine impact. Experience and Skills Degree in journalism or a related field. 2 years of experience in producing automotive related content. In-depth familiarity with and fierce passion for the automotive industry, especially the latest news. Experience with SEO practices. Experience with a custom CMS, preferred. How to Apply If you are interested in this role, please send us the following documentation by uploading it in the relevant fields below: Your CV A cover letter Links to published work Our hiring team will review your application and contact you if we believe that your experience could be a match for this role. Please note that a writing evaluation may be required as part of our application process. TopSpeed is part of the Valnet Publishing Group . Valnet, founded in 2012, is a global digital publishing and media investment Company that owns and operates over 25 authoritative brands across diverse verticals, including entertainment, sports, technology, automotive, gaming, lifestyle and travel. Valnet is committed to producing premium content, and we therefore require all our contributors to adhere to our Editorial Standards, including a prohibition on using Artificial Intelligence. **This is a work from home position**

items.description: At Constant Contact, we are seriously awesome people who take ownership and make an impact by operating with the mindset, integrity and courage of a small business owner. There’s something so profoundly rewarding about knowing that your work is empowering people everywhere to pursue their dreams . Here, we all play an integral part in helping business owners, entrepreneurs, non-profits and individuals to succeed by giving them all the help and tools they need to grow online. We’re energized by new challenges and new possibilities-and we’re just getting started! As an Upsell Consultant at Constant Contact, you’ll work with current and former customers to help them get greater value from our suite of digital marketing products. Through value-based conversations, you’ll seek to understand each customer’s needs, educate them on relevant tools and features, and recommend package upgrades and add-on solutions that support their marketing goals. You’ll also execute winback strategies by connecting with former customers, understanding why they left, and identifying opportunities to regain their business. We’re seeking energetic, driven, and results-oriented individuals who are passionate about helping small businesses succeed. This is a hybrid role requiring 3 days per week in our Waltham, MA office. What you’ll do: Make a high volume of outbound calls to warm leads and former customers. 100+ dials a day Identify opportunities for package upgrades and add-on solutions that increase customer value, spending, and retention. Apply a foundational sales methodology to conduct value-based conversations, understand customer needs, and recommend solutions that support their marketing goals. Educate customers on relevant products, features, packages, and add-on functionality. Execute winback strategies by engaging former customers who left 90 or more days ago, understanding why they left, and identifying opportunities to regain their business. Navigate customer questions, concerns, and objections throughout the sales process. Maintain accurate and timely records of customer interactions, follow-up activities, and sales outcomes in Salesforce. Consistently achieve established sales quotas and monthly conversion, productivity, and quality targets. Apply coaching and performance feedback to strengthen sales effectiveness and results. Deliver a positive and professional customer experience during every interaction. Who you are: Bachelor’s degree or at least one year of relevant sales experience, preferably in an inside-sales, technology, or high-volume environment. Passionate about helping small businesses succeed. Motivated to deliver results and achieve individual goals and targets. Able to understand customer needs and communicate the business value of software solutions. Comfortable navigating customer questions, concerns, and objections. An exceptional and persuasive verbal and written communicator. Organized and able to manage a high volume of customer interactions and follow-up activities. Coachable, adaptable, and willing to adjust your approach based on feedback and results. Able to develop and maintain strong knowledge of Constant Contact’s product suite and support processes. Experience working with small businesses is preferred. Experience using Salesforce, Google Workspace, or similar platforms is preferred. **The on target earnings for this role are $68,000+ Why You’ll Love Us: We celebrate one another’s differences. We are proud of our culture of diversity and inclusion, and we’re always working hard to strengthen and improve this culture. We have programs in place that bring us together on important issues and provide educational opportunities for all employees. Join the experts. If you’re passionate about supporting businesses and organizations, you won’t find a better spot to share your talent. We’re dedicated to improving the quality of our product from a customer standpoint and have a true desire to enable the success of businesses, non-profit organizations, and community groups. You’ll have opportunities to grow your career. We encourage and support our team members to learn different aspects of the business, take on stretch assignments, seek coaching opportunities and professional development opportunities. A generous paid time off policy and a competitive benefits package that supports the health and well-being of you and your family At Constant Contact, we’re all about work flexibility and are proud to serve our customers as a hybrid workforce. Our hybrid work model combines the convenience of remote work with access to our great office locations to collaborate in-person, participate in live trainings, and socialize with colleagues. Application Deadline: 30 days. We may fill this job opening prior to the deadline if a candidate is selected by us. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, national origin, citizenship, age, disability, sexual orientation, genetic information, veteran status or any other status protected under applicable law. If you require accessibility assistance applying for open positions, please contact talentacquisition@constantcontact.com. items.description: Job Title Project Monitoring Officer Location Global Position Type Paid - Regular Job Description The Project Monitoring Officer plays a critical role in supporting SIL's expanding Resource Development strategy by ensuring the effective coordination, monitoring, and reporting of projects that support organizational and staff fundraising efforts. As SIL continues to grow its network of donors, grantors, and funding partners, this position serves as a central hub for collecting and managing project information, facilitating collaboration across departments, and ensuring that project proposals and reports meet the highest standards of quality, accuracy, and donor compliance. This globally focused role is responsible for overseeing the systematic collection, analysis, tracking, and reporting of project data to support grant management, fundraising initiatives, and strategic decision-making. The Project Monitoring Officer works closely with project leaders, fundraisers, and organizational stakeholders to develop compelling proposals, monitor project progress, measure outcomes, and provide timely reporting that strengthens donor relationships and demonstrates impact. Additionally, the position serves as a key liaison between SIL and ETEN Alliance, fostering strong partnership engagement, coordinating cross-functional initiatives, and ensuring alignment of shared goals and reporting requirements. The ideal candidate is highly organized, analytical, relationship-oriented, and motivated by supporting successful fundraising outcomes that enable SIL to advance its mission and expand its global impact. Responsibilities Project Intake, Proposal Development, and Stakeholder Coordination Serve as the primary point of contact for Areas, SCOs, and project leaders regarding project intake, proposal development, and reporting requirements. Manage project intake processes to ensure submitted projects have appropriate leadership endorsement, align with organizational priorities, demonstrate funding potential, and support measurable outcomes. Review and strengthen project concept notes, project descriptions, impact statements, and budgets to meet donor and funding partner expectations. Coordinate with project leaders and stakeholders to gather information necessary for proposal development and donor communications. Facilitate ongoing communication regarding project expectations, reporting requirements, accountability measures, and funding opportunities. Collaborate with internal departments to collect project stories, impact narratives, testimonials, and related content for donor reports, annual reports, websites, email campaigns, and stewardship communications. Project Registry and Reporting Management Maintain a comprehensive project registry and filing system that serves as the central repository for project information, proposals, reports, donor requirements, and related documentation. Manage project tracking systems, including funding coordination, proposal status, reporting schedules, and project documentation. Maintain reporting calendars and proactively communicate reporting deadlines to project leaders and funding recipients. Coordinate the collection, review, and submission of financial and narrative reports in accordance with donor agreements and organizational requirements. Support the development, formatting, editing, and distribution of project proposals and progress reports using approved organizational templates and standards. Ensure project files remain current, organized, and accessible to authorized stakeholders. Track donor requirements, reporting obligations, giving page support needs, and process improvements to enhance operational effectiveness. Funding Administration Support Coordinate project-related donation processing activities with gift administration and finance teams. Support accurate allocation of project funding, indirect cost recovery, and funding transfers. Maintain project funding records and update project tracking systems accordingly. Communicate project awards, funding decisions, reporting expectations, and compliance requirements to project recipients. Monitor project financial activity to support accurate reporting and donor accountability. Alliance Partnership Management Serve as a primary liaison between related partners. Maintain regular communication and engagement processes that support strong partner relationships and coordinated action. Represent SIL priorities, constraints, and outcomes in partnership discussions while ensuring partner expectations are clearly communicated internally. Establish and maintain systems to track funded activities, grant commitments, deliverables, and reporting obligations. Curate, validate, manage, and analyze project and operational data associated with funded activities. Generate reports, dashboards, and data insights to support grant reporting, organizational learning, performance evaluation, and strategic decision-making. Facilitate proposal development, grant reporting, project implementation tracking, and compliance monitoring across multiple departments and partner organizations. Ensure partnership commitments, deliverables, and reporting requirements are completed accurately and on schedule. Skills and Abilities Strong project coordination and project management capabilities while managing multiple priorities Excellent organizational, planning, and deadline-management skills. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work effectively with diverse stakeholders across multiple countries, cultures, and departments. Proficiency in preparing, editing, formatting, and reviewing proposals, reports, and project documentation. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to accuracy. Competence in data collection, tracking, reporting, and analysis. Demonstrated initiative, follow-through, and commitment to continuous improvement. Education Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Nonprofit Management or related field preferred Travel Requirements Occasional domestic and international travel may be required, including attendance at approved in-person meetings, training events, and partner engagements. Weekly Hours 40 Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Macedonia / Georgia / Moldova / Romania / Greece / Croatia / Kosovo / Serbia URL: http://belkins.io In 2017, Belkins started as an appointment-setting agency with just one service offering. Fast-forward to today, and we've transformed into Belkins Group — a vibrant ecosystem of services and products that define the cutting-edge landscape of the SalesTech and MarTech industries. For seven years running, we’ve been the top appointment-setting agency, achieving amazing results across 50+ industries worldwide. Our results speak for themselves: with over 1,000 clients and a global portfolio, we’ve set up more than 200,000 appointments, delivering a $10 return for every $1 spent. We’re experts in B2B appointment setting, providing essential services for companies ready to take their growth to the next level. By diving deep into lead research and using customized, omnichannel strategies, we turn opportunities into real success. Joining Belkins means signing up for a journey of unstoppable growth and success, driven by curiosity, dedication, and a commitment to excellence. We are looking for a results-driven SDR to join our intake pod - the team that runs new clients through their first three months at Belkins. Each pod is built around an Account Strategist who owns client strategy through the pilot, supported by a Delivery Lead, Content Strategist, Researcher, and Email Deliverability Specialist. This structure means the technical side of outreach is handled for you - your focus is on calling and converting prospect responses into booked appointments. You will work across multiple pilot-stage client projects at once (typically 3-4), running high-volume cold calling via power dialer and personally managing all replies from automated email and LinkedIn campaigns. Because every account is brand new, the meetings you book in the first weeks carry extra weight - they're often a client's first real proof that the engagement is working. Things You’ll Be Doing: Cold Calling Running outbound calling campaigns via power dialer (Koncert) across multiple (3-4) pilot-stage client projects at once - every account brand-new, so there's no history to lean on and no slow ramp-up; Handling objections live, on the call, and steering each conversation toward a booked appointment, not just working through a script; Tracking connect rate and call-to-meeting conversion, flagging performance issues to your Account Strategist before they become a pattern - with only three months on the clock, a slow week can't go unnoticed. Reply Handling — Email & LinkedIn Personally owning every reply that comes in from automated email (Reply.io / Inbox AI) and LinkedIn (Expandi) campaigns -responding within 4–8 working hours, handling objections in writing, and nurturing prospects until they convert into confirmed meetings; Scheduling appointments and sharing meeting details with the team via Slack. Campaign Oversight & Reporting Monitoring key metrics across every project - connect rate, reply rate, conversion rate - as your own numbers, not someone else's dashboard. Feeding structured feedback to Research, Content, and EDS so lead quality and messaging actually improve, not just flagging that something isn't working. Keeping CRM hygiene tight in HubSpot and sharing a weekly recap your Account Strategist can actually use. What You Bring: 2+ years of outbound SDR experience with a strong cold calling background ; Fluent English - written and spoken - comfortable working across US and European time zones; Metrics-driven: you track your dials, connect rates, and conversion numbers and know how to improve them; Strong objection handling and a consistent track record of landing next steps; Comfortable working brand-new accounts with no track record yet, and able to manage multiple pilot-stage client projects in parallel without losing quality or pace; Reliable CRM hygiene and disciplined follow-up across all open threads; Self-starting and proactive - you hold your pace without needing external pressure. How We Hire: Recruiter Interview (~30 minutes) — with Yuliia or Inna. Practical Task (~60–90 minutes) — a written exercise covering outbound thinking, objection handling, and lead prioritization. Hiring Manager Interview (~45–60 minutes) — a conversation with the SDR Enablement Manager covering the details of your work, performance analytics, and a live cold-call roleplay. Final Interview (~60 minutes) — with the Managing Director and HR Business Partner to assess company fit and explore your values and working style. items.description: Who we are At Twilio , we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences. Our dedication to remote-first work , and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands. . Hiring and how we work We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings. . See yourself at Twilio Join the team as Twilio’s next Director of Global Campaigns. About the job As the head of the Twilio Global Campaign team, you are responsible for owning, developing and executing the major campaigns that drive awareness and opportunities for Twilio. This role is highly cross functional, working closely with both internal marketing partners across regions, sales, product, and company leadership to design end-to-end campaigns that deliver on business objectives. You possess a proven track record of leading multi-channel global campaigns with success, collaborating with stakeholders, and finding opportunities to strategically uplevel Twilio’s campaign engine. The ideal candidate has an advanced understanding of how campaigns resonate with a global audience, not just one country. You are skilled in understanding the modern AI-driven buyer journey at each stage of the funnel, have the ability to translate messaging frameworks into effective campaigns, and thrives in a collaborative environment. You recognize the value of running an integrated campaign motion, and have the ability to think both strategically and execute at an operational level with ease. Your performance will be measured by your ability to execute and achieve measurable results including building brand awareness, developing a system of content and assets that is valuable to all regions, and building campaigns that accelerate growth velocity. Responsibilities In this role, you will: Set a strategic vision for global campaign structure, operations, and execution for our top 5 campaign motions. We are looking for someone who is very strategic in terms of knowing the audience, how to create content that resonates, tactics to reach that audience, and ideas that are visionary and tactical. Be accountable to company leadership on the effectiveness of all global campaigns and programs Strong project management skills and ability to use data to guide decision-making and resource allocation. Design and execute strategic end-to-end campaigns that both engage and convert prospective buyers with a focus on specific buyer and vertical segments Partner with product marketing, content strategists, brand strategists, creative designers and other regional campaign teams to create campaign themes and messaging that translate into impactful marketing campaigns. Act as the central point of contact to direct all campaign work across teams to ensure timely results Build strong relationships with key cross functional stakeholders across multiple organizations to ensure campaign enablement and engagement A global systems approach. Develop scalable, repeatable campaign playbooks that can be scaled quickly with a large variety of content that works in all regions Track program results , measure program success and report metrics to customer success, sales and marketing stakeholders and executives. Then analyze campaign performance, surface insights and provide recommendations for optimizing results AI-Driven Enablement: We want you to infuse AI frameworks into all aspects of the campaign model. Ideally you would disrupt the norms and evolve the team and programs to be progressive. And equip teams across the organization with the tools, guidelines, and frameworks to create high-quality content at scale, including standards, reusable templates, and AI-assisted workflows that improve consistency, speed, and quality. Budget Management: Manage and allocate budget for campaign production resources across all campaign and persona needs, including original content, video production, localization, and agencies to ensure efficient and high-quality execution and return on investment Global team leadership: Manage a team with a global remit that spans all regions from the US to Europe to Asia, while working with company and brand leadership to execute all top-of-funnel campaigns. Qualifications Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table! Required: Management experience: ability to inspire a team of strategists and show a vision of what is possible and where our teams should focus efforts Deep understanding of marketing funnel tactics and metrics by stage, PLG model and funnel Understanding of enterprise buying cycles, sales processes and stakeholders, especially in B2B tech Self-starter who excels in a fast-paced, collaborative, and innovative high-growth environment Ability to manage multiple work streams and has presence with the team and leadership Strategic thinker with strong attention to detail 8+ years working as a campagin strategist in B2B or tech Proven experience building and delivering on integrated programs and managing all tools, processes, and assets Exceptional communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to drive alignment, set expectations and drive to success Works well with cross-functional teams and executives, to ensure consistent content is delivered across the company A champion for fostering a culture of trust through feedback, communication, and transparency Desired: Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to influence and build effective working relationships with all levels of the organization. Familiarity with localization tactics to ensure our content is accessible and inclusive across multiple countries. Experience with primary research strategies and types of content creation Strategic ability to see opportunities across campaigns and programs where new types of content and programs will thrive. Experience building world-class brands through premium content Experience with a variety of AI, design, analytics, and video tools. Proficiency in digital marketing tools and platforms such as Tableau, Salesforce, AEM, Google Analytics, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Meta Ads Manager, Canva Location This role will be remote based in Ireland or the UK Travel We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings. What We Offer Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location. Twilio thinks big. Do you? We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic . Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts. So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions. . Stay alert to recruitment fraud We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps. . Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

items.title: Travel Expert | Reviewer
items.summary: We’re recruiting Travel professionals and experienced trip planners to review and improve realistic travel scenarios used to train AI travel assistants.
items.description: We’re recruiting Travel professionals and experienced trip planners to review and improve realistic travel scenarios used to train AI travel assistants. Your job isn’t to “write itineraries.” It’s to think like a real trip planner and spot what makes a travel situation real, feasible, and decision-changing — then upgrade weak scenarios so they actually test the model. ‼️ AI is not allowed. If we spot AI use, we’ll block the application. ⚠️ This application form must be completed entirely in English. 🚨 READ ALL THE DESCRIPTION BELOW TO UNDERSTAND THE APPLICATION FORM. WHO CAN APPLY Travel professionals and experienced trip planners 3+ years of relevant travel planning experience (professional or high-volume personal) English level: Advanced / Fluent (required) WHAT YOU’LL DO IN THE APPLICATION (QUICK SCREENING TEST) You will review two pre-generated travel tasks . For each task, you’ll answer simple 1–5 ratings and give a short justification. Then, for the 2nd task , you’ll rewrite it to make it stronger . WHAT “STRONG” MEANS (SIMPLE DEFINITION) A strong task includes one decisive feasibility constraint that can flip the plan if ignored (missed train, missed check-in, closed attraction, wrong station, etc.). We call this a Knife : A Knife is a constraint that changes what itinerary is actually viable . Quick test: if you remove it, the “best plan” would meaningfully change. Examples of Knives in Travel Last train / last entry / check-in cutoff times Closures and holidays that change what’s possible Ambiguous locations (airport/station names that can be confused) Sequential dependencies (if A slips, B becomes impossible) Mobility constraints that change routing feasibility WHAT YOU WILL RATE (1–5) IN THE FORM You’ll give 3 ratings per task: Overall Quality (1–5) How clear and testable the task is (can you judge PASS/FAIL)? Knife / Hidden Context Strength (1–5) Is there a decisive feasibility constraint — or is the “hidden context” just extra color that doesn’t change the plan? Checklist Quality (1–5) Does the checklist truly test feasibility + the Knife with clear criteria? (Strong checklists include verification steps and forbid inventing logistics, written as PASS/FAIL — not “be helpful.”) You’ll also write a short justification (2–4 bullets) explaining your ratings. WHAT YOU WILL REWRITE (FOR THE 2ND TASK ONLY) You will rewrite these parts to make the task stronger: Scenario (3rd person) — more realistic + naturally sets up the feasibility risk Prompt (user message) — natural, human, does not reveal the Knife Hidden Context (1–3 bullets) — must include exactly 1 decisive Knife Checklist (4–6 items) — each item must be PASS/FAIL, covering: feasibility/verification (minimum unknowns to check) the Knife (the decision-flipping constraint) no invented logistics (no made-up schedules/hours/availability) branching plan (Plan A / Plan B) when feasibility depends on one missing answer safety only when there is real risk Checklist item example: PASS if it flags what must be verified (tickets/hours/cutoffs) before committing; FAIL if it confidently invents times or availability. Important: Don’t “leak” the Knife in the prompt (no “IMPORTANT”, no all-caps, no “the key detail is…”). IF SELECTED (PROJECT WORK) You’ll review batches of pre-generated travel scenarios: Rating realism and feasibility risk Identifying weak or missing constraints (Knives) Improving tasks so they better represent real travel moments where wrong advice causes missed connections, wasted money, or ruined plans COMPENSATION Payment will be US$ 30 per approved task, converted and paid in your local currency. Each task takes approximately 40 minutes, which corresponds to an effective rate of about US$ 45 per hour. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR You can recognize what’s realistic vs. generic in travel planning You understand what truly flips feasibility (cutoffs, closures, dependencies, ambiguous locations) You can upgrade a “fine” scenario into a strong feasibility test without making it artificial Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Brand Protection & Marketplace Compliance Analyst
items.summary: Position Type : Full-time Location: Philippines (Remote) Schedule: Mon-Fri, EST About the Company Our client is a global leader in swimming pool technology, specializing in robotic pool cleaners, pool safety products, water treatment solutions, and related pool equipment for residential and commercial customers. With a strong international presence and a network of distributors, subsidiaries, and partners across multiple markets, our client serves customers worldwide through a variety of sales and distribution channels. About the Role Our client is looking for a Brand Protection & Marketplace Compliance Analyst to monitor online marketplaces and digital channels across North America and Europe. The role focuses on identifying unauthorized sellers, marketplace and distribution violations, misuse of brand assets, and other compliance issues. You will conduct online research, analyze seller and product data, maintain accurate records, and prepare reports that provide actionable insights to the business. Responsibilities Monitor Amazon, eBay, Walmart, BestBuy, Home Depot, AliExpress, Temu, and other major marketplaces. Research products and identify new or unauthorized sellers. Classify sellers and verify their authorization status. Identify MAP, distribution, territory, and marketplace compliance issues. Monitor unauthorized use of logos, images, trademarks, and product content. Collect evidence such as URLs, screenshots, seller information, and product details. Maintain accurate seller databases and internal records. Prepare daily reports and monthly Voice of Consumer reports. Build and maintain dashboards tracking brand-protection metrics. Identify opportunities to improve research and reporting processes. Competencies and Qualifications Must-Have 3+ years of experience in data analysis, online research, e-commerce, compliance, or a related field. Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables. Strong research, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Excellent attention to detail and data accuracy. Strong written English and reporting skills. Ability to work independently and follow SOPs. Familiarity with Amazon and other e-commerce marketplaces. Nice-to-Have Brand protection or marketplace compliance experience. Experience with PROWL, Helium 10, Salesforce, or similar tools. Knowledge of MAP, distribution, or channel compliance. Experience with dashboards and reporting. Experience using AI research and translation tools. Key Qualities Detail-oriented Analytical Investigative Highly organized What We Offer 100% Remote Work â Work from anywhere in the Philippines. Career Growth Opportunities â Gain hands-on experience, and continuous learning. Collaborative & Innovative Team â Work alongside skilled professionals who value excellence. Application Process We understand that searching for a new job can be challenging, and weâre here to support you every step of the way. Our goal is to make the process as transparent and respectful as possible. The interview process includes a Recruiter Interview, Client Interview, and Assessment. As part of the process, candidates complete a hands-on task during the technical interview. Throughout each stage, we keep you informed and provide feedback as quickly as possible, ensuring you feel valued and supported throughout your journey with us. items.description: The Opportunity: Data privacy has become one of the most strategic challenges facing modern enterprises — sitting at the intersection of AI governance, data operations, and customer trust. As companies adopt AI at scale, they need new ways to automate privacy and manage risk without slowing innovation. DataGrail has launched the first agentic privacy platform, and we're entering a pivotal phase of growth as we scale toward the next stage of the business. As a Senior Demand Generation Manager, you'll own both halves of the pipeline engine: the campaigns that create demand, and the systems that capture, route, score, and measure it. You'll lead paid media across channels like Google, LinkedIn, and YouTube and drive the event calendar, including trade shows, webinars, and executive roundtables. You'll shape HubSpot as an architect, not just a user, and build the reporting that tells our leadership team whether any of it worked. This isn't a blank slate: paid channels are already live with an agency in place, the event calendar is established, and HubSpot and attribution already exist. You're inheriting a functioning engine, with plenty of authority to make it even stronger. It's a small team with a large surface area, so roughly two thirds of your time goes toward driving demand through campaign strategy, paid media, and events, and the other third goes toward building the systems that make that demand measurable and repeatable through HubSpot architecture, lifecycle programs, and attribution. In this role, one person connects both sides of the engine, creating a much tighter link between what we invest, what we learn, and what ultimately produces pipeline. You'll have real authority to change what isn't working from day one, and on a team this size, a fix you make on Tuesday can be live by Friday. By the end of the year, you'll be the person leadership trusts for a straight answer on whether campaigns and events are actually working. What You'll Do Translate GTM priorities, ICP definitions, and quarterly pipeline targets into integrated campaigns across paid, events, and email, then build and ship them yourself. Own paid media end to end, building, launching, and optimizing campaigns across Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, and YouTube while partnering with our agency on execution. Drive the event calendar, including trade shows, webinars, and executive roundtables, sharpening targeting and follow-through while focusing investment on what delivers results. Carry a quarterly qualified-pipeline number and defend coverage, quality, and conversion with sales leadership, not just volume. Architect HubSpot as an owner, managing workflows, lifecycle stages, lead scoring, campaign objects, and the Salesforce sync. Build and defend the metrics that matter, including CPL, cost per qualified opportunity, event-sourced pipeline, and multi-touch attribution. Partner with Sales, Product Marketing, and RevOps internally, and agencies, venues, and sponsors externally, to run multiple concurrent campaigns and events without dropping a thread. What You'll Bring A track record of hands-on HubSpot ownership, having personally architected and administered an instance, including workflows, lifecycle, scoring, campaigns, and the Salesforce sync. Direct paid media execution, with hands-on experience building, optimizing, and pacing campaigns in Google Ads and LinkedIn Campaign Manager, not just briefing an agency. Salesforce fluency, with the ability to navigate objects, fields, and reports and reason about how marketing data lands in the CRM and why it breaks. B2B SaaS demand generation experience, ideally within a considered, multi-stakeholder sales cycle. Experience owning event strategy and execution, including trade shows, webinars, and executive-level programs like roundtables or dinners. Comfort owning a function end to end, balancing strategy with hands-on execution in an individual contributor role. Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to effectively manage internal stakeholders and external vendors and partners. Bonus Points Experience in privacy, data governance, security, compliance, or another regulated, technical software category. Marketo or Pardot experience alongside HubSpot. Familiarity with account-based marketing or intent-data tools. Comfort using AI to speed up operational work, such as campaign QA, data hygiene, or reporting synthesis. Experience being the first or founding owner of a demand gen or marketing ops function, from the ground up with hands-on responsibility for building and scaling it. What Success Looks Like Within 90 Days You'll: Learn DataGrail's product, buyer personas, and ICP quickly enough to start contributing, not just observing, and meet the marketing, sales, RevOps, and customer success teams to understand what's running and where the friction is. Take full ownership of the paid channels and the agency relationship, and identify specific over- or under-spending by channel. Drive the event calendar and process, and produce a keep, fix, or cut recommendation for each program. Audit HubSpot and existing reporting, and deliver a written list of what's fragile, missing, or misleading in current attribution and lifecycle reporting. Ship at least one visible fix to a live, underperforming channel or process Within 180 Days You'll: Show measurable improvement, with before and after comparisons, on two to three of the biggest inefficiencies identified in the 90-day audit, whether that's rebalanced paid spend, improved event-to-pipeline conversion, or cleaner attribution. Run paid media and events with full autonomy, proposing and executing budget and calendar changes without waiting on sign-off. Ship at least three new or rebuilt nurture and re-engagement tracks, with early performance data on each. Rebuild or upgrade the dashboards used for weekly pipeline calls. Build a working rhythm with Sales, RevOps, and Product Marketing so hand-offs, routing, and lead flow don't require chasing people down. Within 365 Days You'll: Own a program for paid media, events, and HubSpot that runs noticeably better than the one you inherited, with clear before and after numbers on channel efficiency and cost per qualified opportunity. Be the person others trust when they want to know how well our campaigns and events are actually performing. Have made real budget and channel calls, moving spend into what works and cutting what doesn't, with pipeline impact you can point to. Have built a foundation that doesn't need rebuilding when volume doubles. Have identified where the team needs more support, whether that's tooling, headcount, or an agency change, and made the case for it. Please note that the base compensation range below is a guideline and the final compensation will be based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, and competencies. Our compensation ranges apply to all US-based job postings regardless of state. All full-time regular employees are eligible for equity, health, dental & vision insurance plans, remote-first working environment, 401k savings plan, parental leave, wellness benefits, flexible time off, paid holidays, and a work from home stipend. Benefits are subject to change. Compensation Range $140,000—$165,000 USD About Us: DataGrail is the Agentic Data Privacy Platform. We help the world’s leading brands such as HubSpot, FanDuel, Dexcom, Major League Soccer, and Okta automate privacy and control risk with secure, human-governed AI that scales. Powered by Vera, the complete privacy AI agent, and underpinned by an unrivaled 2,500+ integrations and no-compromise security architecture, DataGrail is built to solve complex privacy challenges that others can't. DataGrail is rated 4.8/5 stars on G2 and is a two-time recognized privacy leader by IDC. DataGrail provides equal opportunities for everyone that works for us and everyone that applies to join our team, without regard to sex or gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, pregnancy, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, any service, past, present, or future, in the uniformed services of the United States (military or veteran status), or any other consideration protected by federal, state, or local law. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

items.description: US Marketing Lead Location: United States Reports to: VP of Marketing Employment type: Full-time About Teton Teton is building the autonomous operating system for care. Our technology gives senior living and care teams greater visibility into resident wellbeing, movement, sleep, and care delivery, helping them respond faster, work more efficiently, and provide more personalized care. We are growing quickly across the United States and are looking for a US Marketing Lead to own our regional marketing strategy and execution. The Role The US Marketing Lead will be the territory owner for Teton’s growth and brand presence in the United States. You will translate Teton’s global positioning and company priorities into a focused US marketing plan that creates demand, strengthens our reputation, and helps the sales team win. This is a hands-on role for someone who can set the regional strategy, build campaigns, produce sales materials, support events, coordinate PR, and measure what is working. You will work closely with US Sales, Customer Success, Product Marketing, Events, Growth, and external partners. You will report to the VP of Marketing and serve as the primary marketing partner for the US commercial team. What You’ll Own US Marketing Strategy Develop and execute the US marketing plan in alignment with company revenue goals and global marketing priorities. Identify the audiences, markets, partnerships, and channels most likely to drive growth. Adapt Teton’s global campaigns and positioning for the US senior living and care market. Maintain a clear regional campaign calendar, budget, and set of priorities. Bring insights from customers, prospects, competitors, and the market back into the broader marketing organization. Demand Generation and Campaigns Partner with Growth Lead to build and run integrated campaigns across email, paid media, content, webinars, events, partnerships, and other relevant channels. Create campaigns around Teton’s most important customer problems and product capabilities. Own regional email strategy, segmentation, nurture programs, and campaign follow-up. Work with Growth to improve lead generation, conversion, and account engagement. Develop targeted programs for priority accounts, operator groups, and strategic market segments. Ensure leads are properly captured, routed, followed up on, and measured in HubSpot. Sales Enablement Serve as the primary marketing partner to the US sales organization. Develop and maintain US-specific sales decks, case studies, one-pagers, proposals, follow-up materials, and campaign assets. Translate product capabilities into clear operational and commercial value for senior living operators. Equip sales with the proof points, customer stories, and market insights needed to move opportunities forward. Support account-based campaigns for strategic prospects and active opportunities. Gather regular feedback from Sales and Customer Success to identify gaps in messaging, content, and enablement. Events, Webinars, and Partnerships Partner with the Events lead to determine which US conferences, webinars, executive gatherings, and field programs deserve investment. Build pre-event, on-site, and post-event campaigns that generate meetings and measurable pipeline. Support speaker submissions, presentations, sponsorships, customer participation, and event messaging. Develop regional partnerships with associations, media organizations, technology partners, and other industry stakeholders. Ensure events are connected to broader campaigns rather than treated as standalone activities. Content, Customer Stories, and PR Identify strong US customer stories and work with Customer Success to turn them into case studies, testimonials, videos, and campaign assets. Develop content that reflects the priorities and language of US senior living operators. Work with internal subject-matter experts to produce thought leadership, educational content, reports, and webinars. Coordinate with Teton’s PR partners on announcements, contributed articles, awards, speaking opportunities, and media relationships. Help establish Teton and its leadership as credible voices in the US senior living market. Product Positioning and Market Intelligence Localize global product positioning for US audiences while maintaining consistency with Teton’s overall narrative. Develop messaging for different US customer segments, buyer roles, and stages of the sales process. Monitor competitors, category trends, customer needs, and changes in the senior living market. Partner with Product Marketing and Product to support launches and communicate new capabilities effectively. Ensure US market feedback is reflected in future campaigns, content, and product messaging. Measurement and Reporting Define regional goals and report on campaign performance, lead generation, pipeline contribution, event results, and channel effectiveness. items.summary: About MonetizeMoreMonetizeMore is a global pioneer in ad technology, powering ad monetization for over 150,000 websites and apps globally.
items.description: About MonetizeMore MonetizeMore is a global pioneer in ad technology, powering ad monetization for over 150,000 websites and apps globally. We combine proprietary technology with sophisticated optimization strategies to secure and maximize publisher revenue. We are a 100% remote, culture-first organization driven by four core values: Integrity, Enterprising, Kaizen (Continuous Improvement), and Collaboration . We empower our global team with absolute location autonomy and flexible global schedules. We care about the impact you deliver, not the hours you log on. About the Role The company is seeking an experienced, systems-driven Business Operations Manager to transform informal workflows into owned, structured, and scalable operational systems. As the primary connective layer across departments, this role focuses on process kaizen, SOP governance, and end-to-end operational enablement—ensuring teams execute efficiently without reinventing processes. The Business Operations Manager will manage the central project management infrastructure and partner directly with Product and executive leadership. Key responsibilities include preparing cross-functional teams for product launches, streamlining enterprise client workflows, and establishing organization-wide standards for accountability and visibility. As a data- and AI-fluent operator, the candidate will design structured spreadsheet models, integrate AI tools to accelerate documentation, and continuously optimize reporting systems. Core Responsibilities 1. Process Kaizen & SOP Governance Run a continuous improvement cadence across the process landscape; killing, combining, or improving SOPs weekly. Own the process vault and ensure every process is signed off by its owner and governed for adoption, not just documented. 2. Project Management & Visibility Own and maintain BE's project management tracker; ensuring all projects, to-dos, and tickets are tracked, visible, and actioned. Drive adoption beyond BE, building the foundation for a company-wide model with long-term integration into BL L10s. 3. Product Rollout Support Support product release processes, structuring the operational side of launches so teams are enabled ahead of go-live. Work closely with the incoming Group PM to formalize this process as a repeatable model. 4. Cross-Departmental & Enterprise Client Enablement Act as an operational connective layer across business lines and enterprise client workflows; surfacing blockers, coordinating data and documentation needs, and keeping cross-functional commitments visible and actioned. 5. Data & Spreadsheet Management Own data pulls and spreadsheet-based reporting for BE initiatives; Building and maintaining structured, reliable models that others can use without re-deriving logic. Comfort with formulas, structured data, and dashboard hygiene is core to the role, not incidental. Who You Are The Experienced Operator: You have 4+ years of experience in a process, project management, or business operations role. Ad tech, SaaS, high-data-volume or WordPress ecosystem experience is a plus, as is experience working with Salesforce (SFDC). The Systems Builder: You default to structure, and you know the difference between owning a process and doing the work inside it. Given a messy or untracked workstream, your instinct is to define ownership, standardize steps, and build the scaffolding (trackers, SOPs, cadences) that lets other functions execute reliably. Data- and AI-Fluent: You're comfortable pulling, cleaning, and structuring data in spreadsheets without hand-holding, and you've used AI tools in your actual workflow to speed up documentation and process work. Comfortable with Ambiguity: You can walk into an undefined workstream, ask the right questions, and leave it with clear ownership and a repeatable process. Direct Communicator: You flag problems early and plainly. You don't let a stalled ticket or an unsigned SOP sit quietly. What We Offer True Flexibility: Work from anywhere in the world with an flexible schedule that fits your lifestyle. Professional Development: Continuous opportunities for career growth, learning allowances, and direct impact on a fast growing company. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process! About the role The CFO’s mission is to continue building upon Grüns ' already strong finance and data function — evolving it into a best-in-class engine that empowers the entire organization to make faster, smarter decisions. Leading a team of three strong leaders, this role is about leading the strong teams below them to democratize financial intelligence across the Grüns organization: self-serve dashboards, on-demand reporting, and real-time visibility that puts decision-making power in the hands of every team member. The CFO is a relentless, collaborative business partner, never satisfied with where the business is on revenue scale or profitability, always pushing for the next point of EBITDA margin improvement across all functions and driving efficiency to fuel continued revenue growth. They will ensure Grüns scales with confidence while meeting all external requirements seamlessly in the background. This role is part of our remote HQ! We have a fully remote, high-trust work environment - and also come together on a biannual basis for amazing off-sites where we can connect IRL. What success looks like: If we look ahead a year from now, the right person in this role would have: Leveraged what we’ve built so far, found areas for improvement, and fully operationalized a goal accountability framework that keeps business initiatives tied to financial outcomes, ensuring the leadership team is consistently tracking toward revenue and profitability targets. Driven meaningful EBITDA margin improvement across all functions and improved LTV:CAC efficiency to fuel continued revenue growth. Delivered self-serve dashboards, templatized reporting, and real-time P&L visibility across functions so every team has the data access they need without relying on ad-hoc requests. Business decisions are democratized and exponentially quicker. Created the conditions for a high-performing, motivated team empowering vs. micromanaging, actively developing leaders, and driving strong results and performance without burnout. Built the systems and processes to meet all external reporting and compliance requirements seamlessly, keeping the team focused on growth. We're looking for someone with: Relentless Growth Mindset: Always asking what it takes to get to the next level, whether that's another point of margin, better efficiency, or a faster path to revenue growth - a genuine internal drive to make the business the best it can be. Finding new opportunities across the business and proposing these opportunities to the CEO and functional leads. Integrity and Business-First Thinking: Prioritizes the truth over “looking good”. Navigates competing stakeholder interests honestly and thoroughly rather than taking the path of least resistance. Empowering Leadership: Leads by giving people the tools, clarity, and confidence to make great decisions vs. controlling the work directly. Actively develops their functional leaders, makes their team better than they were before. Drives sustainable high performance. Paper Wall Pusher: Treats perceived constraints as hypotheses, not facts. When told something takes six weeks or "this is how it's done," they ask why and push for faster, smarter, or different. Actively hunts for process bloat and inherited ways of working to find improvements. AI-Native Operator: Uses AI natively in their own workflow and actively builds AI fluency into the team's operating model. Sees AI as a core lever for scaling the function's impact without scaling headcount. Direct, but kind: Direct and honest in every conversation, saying what needs to be said, even when it's uncomfortable. Deeply committed to the business and the people in it. Experience: 10+ years leadership experience in a high-growth, profitable businesses; some level of physical inventory experience (CPG, retail, e-commerce, or similar) is a must Experience leading the functions in scope - finance, accounting, data, and BizOps functions Experience within a high-growth company that is adapting to public company practices Compensation & Benefits: At Grüns , we're committed to providing a competitive total compensation package — grounded in market data that considers our size, stage, industry, and location. For this role, the base salary is $350,000 + incentive compensation, paired with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and growth of our team. A bit about us... At Grüns , we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you. Like you, we were disappointed. There’s an infinite number of “nutrition” companies, all focused on what’s best for them — not what’s best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We’ve seen it all. So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious. What we care about... Be the Best: We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation. Own It: We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners. Drive Impact, Urgently: We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most. Compensation & Perks: For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth. Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage -- for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns subscriptions, and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about! items.description: Software Engineering Surescripts serves the nation through simpler, trusted health intelligence sharing, in order to increase patient safety, lower costs and ensure quality care. We deliver insights at critical points of care for better decisions - from streamlining prior authorizations to delivering comprehensive medication histories to facilitating messages between providers. Job Summary: The Principal Infrastructure Engineer is crucial to ensuring the stability, efficiency and security of the products we operate as crucial components of the nation's healthcare ecosystem. As a member of our Operations team, a Principal Infrastructure Engineer is expected to have knowledge and experience spanning many disciplines with the ability to lead, communicate and execute as a subject matter expert on specific topics or systems. This role may be called upon to troubleshoot deeply technical problems, architect a solution for a new cloud-native application or write an Ansible module to support deployment of new security tooling. At the Principal level, our Platform Engineers are expected to be able to speak on a broad variety of topics and successfully lead projects both internal to our Systems or Operations teams as well as in collaboration with diverse groups of technical and non-technical team members. This position has a specific focus on systems performance tuning and analysis that is becoming even more crucial as we begin operations in Google Cloud Platform. Sizing, tuning troubleshooting and performance monitoring now draw a direct line to the budget as we transition to the minute-by-minute pricing models of the cloud. Knowing where we can gain efficiency and where we cannot sacrifice performance has become a crucial part of our architectural discussion and on-going operational health. Responsibilities: Participate in development of strategic goals and plans for new and existing systems infrastructure. Research, design, architect, and implement new technologies and solutions that span on-premise and cloud platforms in a method consistent with our security policies and infrastructure-as-code principals. Implement performance tuning strategies to optimize system performance, resource utilization, and overall efficiency. Collaborate with other teams to design and implement scalable and resilient infrastructure solutions. Assist in support of issues impacting the performance or reliability of production transactions. Recommend/implement policies, procedures, and technologies to ensure system security through secure system access, monitoring and control. Participate as necessary in routine security evaluations. Implement automation solutions for system provisioning, configuration management, and performance tuning. Ensure compliance with policies, standards, licensing agreements, configuration guidelines, and best-practices for maintaining regulatory compliance. Ensure all systems and processes are well-documented and comply with internal policies and industry standards. Qualifications: Basic Requirements: Bachelor's degree in IT, computer science, information sciences or related field or equivalent experience 8+ years of experience in systems engineering role Experience in a production operation environment with high uptime requirements. Familiarity with configuration management tools (Ansible preferred). Knowledge of virtualization and containerization technologies - Vmware (vSphere / ESXi 8x) and Kubernetes preferred Proficiency in scripting languages (Bash, Powershell, Python, Perl). Experience with performance, logging and monitoring tools (Zenoss, Splunk, Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, etc.) Strong background in system metrics analysis and monitoring. Experience working in cloud environments (GCP preferred) Preferred Qualifications: Experience operating in an environment with sensitive health data Experience with RedHat, RockyOS and Windows Certifications like RHCE or Google Cloud Architect/Engineer Understanding of network operations, network troubleshooting and the ability to understand the output of packet captures Experience as a Team Lead, or non-people manager leadership role. Surescripts embraces flexibility through its Flexible Hybrid Work model for most positions. This model allows employees to work virtually while still utilizing our offices as collaboration centers. With alignment and agreement from your leadership, you can come and go from the office as needed. To be considered for employment, applicants must have a valid U.S. work authorization allowing work without restrictions with Surecripts in the U.S. At this time, we are unable to provide support or provide sponsorship for immigration benefits such as work visas. Additionally, we do not participate in academic training programs or work-study programs through an academic institution that require employer endorsement of F-1/CPT or F-1/STEM. What You're Like You're relentless in getting stuff done. You apply your expertise in an Agile/DevOps world with other talented people. You're curious about new technology and use your curiosity as fuel to deliver meaningful solutions. And you're into incremental efforts that ultimately reap huge results. What We're Like We're a smart team that loves to work toward a common goal: delivering innovative, industry-leading solutions that improve patient care. We pride ourselves on quality work grounded in transparency and accountability. Our goal is to make a positive impact on healthcare, be it on quality, cost, or patient safety. What the Work is Like Is your thinking cap on? (Do they still make those?) Here, our challenge is to connect disparate, cross-functional skills to create the desired result. We focus on important milestones, work to understand diverse technologies and develop relationships with various groups of people with varied perspectives. Why Wait? Apply Now We're a midsize company. This means you're not just another employee ID number. Here, you can build real relationships and feel supported by truly awesome people with diverse backgrounds and talents in an innovative and collaborative work culture. We strive to create an environment where you can be yourself, share your ideas and work your way. We offer opportunities for employee development, as well as competitive compensation packages and extensive benefits. At Surescripts, base pay is one part of our Total Rewards Package (which may also include bonus, benefits etc.) and is determined within a range. The base pay range for this position is $161,600 - $197,600 per year. Your base pay may vary within or outside of this range depending on a number of factors, including (but not limited to) your qualifications, skills, experience, and location. Benefits include, but are not limited to, comprehensive healthcare (including infertility coverage), generous paid time off including paid childbirth and parental leave and mental health days, pet insurance, and 401(k) with company match and immediate vesting. To learn more, review the Keep You and Yours Healthy , Balancing Work and Life , and Where Talent Takes Shape links under the Better Benefits. Better Work. Better Life section of our careers site. Additionally, this job requires certain mental demands, including the ability to use judgement, withstand moderate amounts of stress and maintain attention to detail with, or without, a reasonable accommodation. items.title: Fraud Analyst
items.summary: Who are we? TripledotStudios is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world.
items.description: Who are we? Tripledot Studios is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world. We are a multi-award-winning organisation, with a global 2,500+ strong team across 12 studios. Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users. Tripledot’s guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others. We’re building a company we’re proud of. One filled with driven, incredibly smart and detail-orientated people, who LOVE making games. Our ambition is to be the most successful games company in the world, and we’re just getting started. The role is working within our studio: PuzzlePlay Puzzleplay is Tripledot’s new player rewards platform, designed to make playing our games even more fun and engaging. By playing our casual, free to play mobile games, users can earn points, complete challenges, and win real prizes. It’s our way of giving back to players and rewarding them for doing what they already love. Puzzleplay is a key part of our growth strategy, combining smart engagement mechanics with high-quality game content. Role Overview Puzzleplay at Tripledot Studios is looking for a data analyst to own the fraud side of its user segmentation work. The team is building a system that combines fraud and activity signals to understand users and inform revenue-share decisions. You'll work with the analyst responsible for gameplay signals, alongside product and data colleagues, to keep that system useful as fraud patterns change. Fraud patterns keep changing, so you'll regularly revisit the signals behind the segments and help the product team decide which verification methods make sense in each market. This role is open to candidates based in Europe; Warsaw is preferred, where several of the people you'll work with are based. Key Responsibilities Review fraud signals regularly, adding, removing and refining them to distinguish suspicious activity from legitimate users. Signals under consideration include IP spoofing, VPN use and unusual play patterns. Own the fraud-related segments of the user segmentation system, from deciding how signals should be interpreted to monitoring how well the categories work over time. Work with the product team on fraud verification tools for different markets. The team currently uses FaceTec for facial verification and may need other methods, such as ID scanning or phone verification, in other countries. Investigate users flagged for manual review, including ambiguous cases in the Tremendous queue, and look for ways to improve the review process. Identify gaps in the available signals and recommend third-party tools for the product roadmap where they would help. Required Skills, Knowledge and Expertise Hands-on experience using data to investigate fraud and shape detection or prevention decisions, not just working alongside a fraud team. Experience designing or improving fraud signals, user segments or review processes, with an interest in how those decisions change as tactics evolve. The ability to work with product and other teams to turn analysis into operational fraud controls. Originally posted on Himalayas
